Libitiku

Leviticus

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka kaluwasan te Libitiku iyan ka “Ka in-umew rin” ne iyan ka me talagpanubad eyew te pegpatuman te me balaud ne imbehey te Manama kandan.

The meaning of Libitiku is “The (one) he called” whose the sacrificers in_order for fulfilling the laws that were_given by God (MS Manama) to_them.

Impalintutuuwan te me etew ne si Muwisis ded ka migsulat te seini ne libru diye te Bubungan ne Sinay te timpu te nangekampu sikandan diye, su egkabasa seini diye te: 1:1, 4:1, 6:1,24, wey te 8:1.

It's_believed by the people that Muwisis was the (one who) wrote this book there on the Mount Sinay at the time that they camped(pl) there, because this can be read there in: 1:1, 4:1, 6:1,24, and in 8:1.

Ka Libitiku ne baseen meyitenged seini te eleg ne egbatasanen te me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew eg-isipen sikandan ne malinis te Manama. Ka sabeka ne paahi ne eg-isipen sikandan ne malinis te Manama iyan ka pegpanubad te igkeupii te Manama.

The document Libitiku is concerning the correct customs for the descendants of Israil in_order for them to be_considered clean by God. One way that they will_be_considered clean is to sacrifice what_ever God desires.

Ne eyew egkaay-ayaran iya ka pegpanubad, mig-alam ka Manama te etew ne si Aarun wey te me kabuhalan din.

And so_that the sacrificing was_done_carefully indeed, God chose a person that's Aarun and his descendants.

Ka nenasulat te seini ne baseen

What's written(pl) is this document (LIT reading)

The laws about offerings and sacrifices \ior 1:1–7:38\ior*

Ka peghalad engki Aarun wey te me anak din ne me lukes eyew egkeyimu ne me talagpanubad \ior 8:1–10:20\ior*

The dedication of Aarun and of his male children in_order to become_sacrificers \ior 8:1–10:20\ior*

The laws about cleaning and not clean \ior 11:1–15:33\ior*

The day of forgiving of sin \ior 16:1‑34\ior*

Ka me balaud meyitenged te pegpamatulus te pegkeetew wey te pegsimba \ior 17:1–27:34\ior*

The laws about making self holy and about worshiping \ior 17:1–27:34\ior*

Ka egtutungen ne igpanubad

The sacrifices that are burned

11 In-umew te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan[fn] wey ingkahiyan, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne emun due egpanubad te mananap diye te Magbebaye, keilangan ne iyan din igpanubad ka karniru, wey ke kambing naa. 3 Ke baka ka igkeupii rin ne igpanubad eyew egtutungen, keilangan ne turu seini ne ware nabalbalangi. Igpanubad din sika ne baka diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan eyew egdawaten te Magbebaye. 4 Igdagket din ka palad din diye te ulu te baka ne egtutungen ne igpanubad wey egdawaten te Magbebaye ka pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale. 5 Ne eggilangen din ka turu ne baka diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. Ne ka langesa rue, iglingut igsawig te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun diye te altar ne eg-unturan te igpanubad, ne diye te gumawan ne egkatangkaan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 6 Ne egluwitan te migpanubad ka mananap wey egpanggupalen din e seini. 7 Ne egtetemeg e diye te altar ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun wey eg-ay-ayaran dan te egtemeg ka me kayu. 8 Ne igpaayad-ayad dan e igpanahu diye te altar ne intemehan ka impanggupal ran wey iglagkes dan degma ka ulu wey ka tabe. 9 Piru eglu-luan pad te etew ne egpanubad ka me tahu te getek wey ka me paa te baka. Mesi egkeimpusan e, egtutungen e te talagpanubad ka intiru ne igpanubad diye te altar, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.

11 Muwisis was called by the Lord there in the Tent that's a Meeting_place[fn] and said, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that if/when there_is (someone) sacrificing animal to the Lord God, it's_necessary that he/she sacrifice a sheep, or goat. 3 If he (LIT he/she/it but BTed as he/his for short from now on) desires that a cow be burned as a sacrifice, it's_necessary to be a male and without defects. He will_sacrifice that cow there in the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place so_that (it) will_be_accepted by the Lord. 4 He touches his palm there onto the head of the cow that's to_be_burned as a sacrifice and the Lord would accept the blood_shed in_order to clean a sin. 5 And he will_slaughter the male cow there in front of the Lord. And the blood of that, will_be_splashed by the sacrificer that's a descendants of Aarun around the altar that the burnt_thing is_sitting_on, that's there on the doorway in_front_of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. 6 And the one_sacrificing skins the animal and he chop_ it _up. 7 And the sacrificers who are descendants of Aarun set_fire at the altar and they carefully burn the wood. 8 And they carefully put what_they chopped_up on the altar that's lighted_with_fire and also including the head and the fat. 9 But the person who is_sacrificing will_wash the contents of the stomach and the feet of the cow. When finished, the sacrificers will_burn the entire sacrifice on the altar, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord God.

10 “Ne emun ke karniru wey ke kambing naa ka egtutungen ne igpanubad te sabeka ne etew, keilangan ne lukesan seini wey ware nabalbalangi. 11 Eggilangen din seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad ne diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. Ne ka langesa te sika ne igpanubad, igsawig diye te me kakiliran te altar te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun. 12 Ne egpanggupalen e seini te etew ne egpanubad wey egpaay-ayaran e seini igpanahu te me talagpanubad diye te altar ne intemehan wey iglagkes dan degma ka ulu wey ka tabe. 13 Piru eglu-luan pad te etew ne egpanubad ka me tahu te getek wey ka me paa te karniru. Ke egkeimpusan e, egtutungen e te talagpanubad ka intiru ne igpanubad diye te altar, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.

10 “And if it's a sheep or goat that's burned as a sacrifice for one person, it_needs to be a male and not be_defective. 11 He slaughters it in the north (LIT left_side) of the altar which is the burning_place for sacrifice that's there to the front of the Lord God. And the blood of that sacrificed, will_be_splashed by the sacrificers that are descendants of Aarun there to the sides of the altar. 12 And the person who is_sacrificing it will_chop_ it _up and the sacrificers orderly place_ it _on_top of the altar lighted_ with _fire and they includes also the head and fats. 13 But the person who is_sacrificing will_wash the contents of the stomach and the feet of the sheep. When (it is) finished, the entire sacrifice will_be_burned by the sacrificer there on the altar, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord God.

14 “Emun ke manuk-manuk ka egtutungen ne igpanubad te sabeka ne etew, keilangan ne seleppati seini wey ke tukmu naa. 15 Eg-uyanen seini te talagpanubad diye te altar wey eggulibiren din ka lieg taman te egkatempug, ne egtutungen din e ka ulu diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. Ne igpatihis din ka langesa diye te kakiliran te altar. 16 Ne egpamulbulan din seini wey eg-aween din ka abenan wey igdegpak din seini diye te tahuanan te abu ne diye te lenged te altar dapit te igsile. 17 Egpeglimangen din te eggen-gen ka pakpak wey egbintengen din seini taman te egkapekang, piru kene din de egpeteen. Ne egtutungen din e seini langun diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.

14 “If it's a bird being_burned as a sacrifice of one person, it_needs to be a turtle_dove or a spotted_dove. 15 It should be brought to the sacrificer at the altar and he will_twist the neck until it_breaks_off, and he will_burn the head on the altar that the burnt_thing is_sitting_on. And he will_pour_out the blood there at the side of the altar. 16 And he will_pluck it and he will_remove the crop and throw this there in the container for ashes there on the_near of_the altar in the east side. 17 He will_hold opposite wings and tear it but he won't do it completely. Then, he will_burn it all there on the altar for placing_ burning_things _on, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord God.

Ka peghalad te egkakeen diye te Magbebaye

The offering of the food there to the Lord God

21 “Ke due egkeupian ne eghalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te egkakeen,[fn] keilangan ne amana ne meupiya ka harina ne ighalad din wey eg-itisan din sika te mentika wey egsewuhan din te meemut ne insinsu. 2 Ne eg-uyanen din sika diye te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun. Ne eggamak ka talagpanubad te harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika wey te langun ne insewug ne meemut ne insinsu. Ne egtutungen sika diye te altar isip pegsuman-suman te Magbebaye, wey meemut sika diye te Magbebaye. 3 Ka egkasame te inhalad, kandan e te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun wey amana ne matulus sika su baad ma te inhalad diye te Magbebaye.

21 “If there's (someone) who wants to offer to the Lord God of food,[fn] it's_necessary that he offer very good flour and he pours_ cooking_oil _on_that and mix_it with fragrant incense. 2 And he brings that to the sacrificers that's a descendants of Aarun. And the sacrificer will_take_a_handful of very good flour that got_ cooking_oil _mixed_in and of all the mixed_in fragrant incense. And that will_be_burned there on the altar as remembering the Lord, and that (will be) fragrant to the Lord. 3 The remainder of what's_offered, is theirs for the sacrificers that are descendants of Aarun and that's holy because this portion was_offered to the Lord God.

4 “Ke due eghalad te paan ne inggilutu diye te hilutuanan te paan, keilangan ne iyan din eggilutuen ka harina ne amana ne meupiya wey kene egsewuhan te patulin. Egkaayun ne ighalad ka makepal ne paan ne insewuhan te mentika wey ke manipis naa ne paan ne inlakulasan te mentika. 5 Ne emun due eghalad te paan ne diye hilutua te kale, keilangan ne iyan din eggilutuen ka harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika piru ware sewuhi te patulin. 6 Egteptepiken din sika wey eg-itisan te mentika—sika ka egkakeen ne ighalad.

4 “If there's (someone who) offers bread that's baked in a baking_place for bread, it's_necessary that he cooks with flour that's very good and not with_ rising_agent _mixed_in. It's_possible to offer thick bread with_ cooking_oil _mixed_in or thin bread that's smeared_with cooking_oil. 5 And if there's (someone who) offers bread that's cook in frying_pan, it's_necessary that what_he cooks is the flour that's very good that's got_ cooking_oil _mixed_in but not with_ rising_agent _mixed_in. 6 He splits that and pours_ cooking_oil _over_it—that is the offering that's food.

7 “Ke diye hilutua te kale ka paan ne ighalad, keilangan ne iyan eggilutuen ka harina ne amana ne meupiya wey egsewuhan te mentika. 8 Eg-uyanen din seini diye te talagpanubad wey ka talagpanubad e ka eg-uyan due diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen eyew ighalad diye te Magbebaye. 9 Ne egkuwa ka talagpanubad te seeye se paan ne inhalad e wey egtutungen din seini eyew te pegpapitew ne ka langun nakahalad e te Magbebaye, wey meemut sika diye te Magbebaye. 10 Ka egkasame te ighalad, kandan e te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun wey matulus seini su baad ma te inhalad diye te Magbebaye.

7 “If the bread that's to_be_offered was_cooked in a pan, it's_necessary that what_is_cooked is flour that's very good and with_ cooking_oil _mixed_in. 8 He will_bring this to the sacrificer and the sacrificer (will be) the (one) to_bring (it) there on the altar that's a place_for_placing (things) to_burn in_order_to offer_it to the Lord. 9 And the sacrificer will_take those bread that's offered already and he will_burn_it in_order_to show that all were already offered to the Lord, and that is fragrant to the Lord. 10 The remainder of the offering, is theirs for the sacrificers that are descendants of Aarun and it's holy because (it's a) portion of what_was_offered to the Lord.

11 “Ka langun ne egkakeen ne ighalad, keilangan ne ware patulin, su kene kew egkaayun ne egtutung te patulin wey ke teneb naa ke eghalad kew diye te Magbebaye. 12 Egkaayun ne ighalad niyu diye te Magbebaye ka an-anayan ne me behas te me pinamula niyu piru kene egkaayun ne egtutungen sika diye te altar isip halad ne meemut. 13 Asini niyu ka langun ne egkakeen ne ighalad. Keilangan ne kene egkaawe ka asin su ka asin palinneu te kasabutan niyu te Magbebaye.

11 “The all offerings that's food, needs to have_no rising_agent, because you(pl) can't burn rising_agent or honey in your(pl) offerings to the Lord. 12 It's_possible that you(pl) offer the first fruits to the Lord but it's_ not _possible that this be_burnt on the altar as a fragrant offering. 13 Salt(pl) all your(pl) offerings that's food. It's_necessary that the salt not be removed because the salt is a sign of your(pl) agreement with the Lord.

14 “Ke eghalad kew diye te Magbebaye te an-anayan ne me behas te egketuen ne me pinamula, iyan niyu ihalad ka inggaling wey ke insandag naa ne me trigu. 15 Itisi niyu sika te mentika wey sewuhi niyu te meemut ne insinsu. Sika ka egkakeen ne ighalad. 16 Ne egtutungen te talagpanubad ka duma ne inggaling ne egpuun te egkakeen ne ighalad ne insewuhan te mentika lagkes ka langun ne meemut ne insinsu ne insewug. Egtutungen sika ne ighalad eyew te pegpapitew ne ka langun nakahalad e diye te Magbebaye.

14 “If you(pl) offer the first fruits of the plucked plants to the Lord, what_ you(pl) _offer (should be) the ground or roasted wheat. 15 Pour(pl)_ rubbing_oil _on that and put(pl)_fragrant incense_in_it. That is the food offering. 16 And the sacrificer will_burn the other ground from the food offering with cooking_oil mixed_in (and) including all the fragrant incense that's mixed_in. This will_be_burned as offering in_order_to show that all were already offered to the Lord.

Ka igpanubad diye te Magbebaye para te keupianan

The sacrifice there to the Lord for well_being

31 “Ke due egpanubad te baka diye te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew igpanubad para te keupianan, keilangan ne ware seini nabalbalangi, turu ma wey se beyan. 2 Igdagket din ka palad din diye te ulu te baka wey eggilangen din seini diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne ka langesa te baka, iglingut igsawig te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun diye te me kakiliran te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 3 Te sika ne igpanubad, egkuwa ka talagpanubad te me baad ne egtutungen din para te Magbebaye, ne iyan ka langun ne tabe diye te getek, 4 ka me iihian wey ka nandeket ne me tabe kayi, wey ka atey ne indeketan te tabe. 5 Ne egtutungen sika te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun, diye te altar ne eg-unturan te igpanubad, duma te igmanubad ne egtutungen, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.

31 “If there_is (someone) sacrificing a cow in_order_to sacrifice for well-being, it's_necessary that this not have_defects, whether it's a male_animal or a female_animal. 2 He will_touch his palm on the head of the cow and he will_slaughter it there in the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. And the blood of the cow, will_be_splashed by the sacrificer who's a descendants of Aarun there to the sides of the altar that's for putting_ burning (things) _on. 3 On that sacrifice, the sacrificer will_get a portions of what_ he's _burning for the Lord, which (are) the all fat there to the stomach, 4 the kidneys and the fat that attached of it, and the liver which is attached with fat. 5 And this is burned by the sacrificers who are descendants of Aarun, there on the altar that's for putting_ burning (things) _on, along_with sacrifices that are burned, and burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord God.

6 “Ke karniru wey ke kambing naa ka igpanubad te etew diye te Magbebaye eyew igpanubad para te keupianan, keilangan ne ware seini nabalbalangi, lukesan ma wey se beyan. 7 Ke nati te karniru ka igpanubad din, eg-uyanen din seini diye te Magbebaye. 8 Igdagket din ka palad din diye te ulu te karniru wey eggilangen din seini diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne ka langesa te lukesan ne karniru, iglingut igsawig te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun diye te me kakiliran ne altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 9 Ne egkuen din ka tabe, ka tabe ne diye te ikug ne impekpek te egtempug, wey ka langun ne tabe ne diye te getek wey ka diye te bituka, 10 ka me iihian wey ka nandeket ne me tabe kayi, wey ka atey ne indeketan te tabe. 11 Egtutungen seeye langun te talagpanubad diye te altar eyew igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.[fn]

6 “If it's a sheep or a goat sacrificed by a person in_order to sacrifice for well-being, it's_necessary that this not have_defects, whether it's a male_animal or a female_animal. 7 If it's a lamb (LIT sheep young) that he will_sacrifice, he should bring it to the Lord. 8 He will_touch his palm on the head of the sheep and he will_slaughter it there in the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. And the blood of the ram, will_be_splashed by the sacrificer who's a descendants of Aarun there to the sides of the altar that's for putting_ burning (things) _on. 9 He will_take the fat and the fat that's on the tail that's chopped_at_base, and all the fat there to the stomach, and there to the intestines, 10 the kidneys and the fats that attached of it, and the liver which is attached with fat. 11 This all is_burned by the sacrificer there on the altar in_order to_be_sacrificed to the Lord.[fn]

12 “Ke kambing ka igpanubad din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye, 13 igdagket din ka palad din diye te ulu te kambing wey eggilangen din seini diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne ka langesa due, iglingut igsawig te me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 14 Ne puun te igpanubad, egkuwa ka talagpanubad te egtutungen ne igpanubad para te Magbebaye ne iyan ka tabe diye te bituka, 15 ka me iihian wey ka nandeket ne me tabe kayi, wey ka atey ne indeketan te tabe. 16 Egtutungen seeye langun te talagpanubad diye te altar eyew igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.[fn] 17 Eggimuwen niyu seini ne tulumanen te ware egtamanan lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu, minsan hendei kew eg-ugpe ne kene kew keen te tabe wey ke langesa naa.”

12 “If a goat is what_ he _will_sacrifice there in front of the Lord, 13 he will_touch his palm on head of the goat and he will_slaughter_it there in the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. And the blood of it, will_be_splashed by the sacrificer who's a descendant of Aarun surrounding the altar that's for putting_ burning (things) _on. 14 And from what_is_offered, the sacrificer will_take burn offering for the Lord God which (are) the fat from the intestines, 15 and the kidneys and the fats that's attached of it, and the liver which is attached with fat. 16 All that will_be_burned by the sacrificer there on the altar in_order to sacrifice there to the Lord God.[fn] 17 This will_be_made a regulation by_you(pl) without ending including the all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed, wherever you(pl) live and don't(pl) eat fat or blood.”

Ka me halad ne iglinis te sale

The sacrifices that_will_clean sin

41 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne emun ke due etew ne nakasale te minsan nekey te me suhu te Magbebaye ne ware tuyui, seini ka eggimuwen dan:

41 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendant(s) of Israil that if there_is (someone who) sinned any of the commands of the Lord that's unintentional, this is what_ they _should_do:

3 “Emun ke iyan egpakasale ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ne egpakalagkes ka kabuhalan ni Israil, keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandin diye te Magbebaye te turu ne nati te baka ne ware nabalbalangi eyew igpanubad ne iglinis te sale din. 4 Ne diye din seini eg-uyana te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey igdagket din ka palad din te ulu te turu ne nati te baka, wey eggilangen din seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 5 Egkataman, egkuwa ka Labew ne Talagpanubad te langesa te turu ne baka wey eg-uyanen din seini diye te seled te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 6 Ne ig-eled din te langesa ka kemel rin wey igpabesik din seini te kapapitu diye te tangkaan te kurtina ne indingding te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng ne diye ka Magbebaye. 7 Ne egpulitan din degma te langesa ka me sungey-sungey te altar ne tutunganan te insinsu ne diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne diye te seled te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne ka egkasame ne langesa, ig-itis din diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen ne diye te gumawan te Balungbalung. 8 Ne egkataman, eg-aween e te talagpanubad ka langun ne tabe te turu ne baka ne igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale—ka langun ne tabe ne diye te getek, 9 ka me iihian wey ka nandeket ne me tabe kayi, wey ka atey ne indeketan te tabe. 10 (Ne iling ded degma due ka eggimuwen diye te ayam ne igpanubad para te keupianan.) Ne egtutungen seini te talagpanubad diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 11 Piru ka nasame iling te laplap, ka langun ne sapu, ka ulu, ka me paa, ka me tahu te getek, wey ka tei, 12 eg-uyanen din seini diye te lihawangan te kampu, diye te dapit ne in-isip ne malinis ne tambuanan te abu wey diye din seini egtutunga.[fn]

3 “If it is the Prominent Sacrificers that sin then the descendant(s) of Israil become_included, it's_necessary that he bring a male cow calf not having_defects to the Lord in_order_to sacrifice_it that will_clean his sin. 4 And he will_bring it to the doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place and he will_touch his palm on the head of the male cow calf, and he will_slaughter it there in front of the Lord. 5 Then, the Prominent Sacrificer will_get_some blood of the male cow and he will_bring this to the inside of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. 6 And he will_dip his finger into the blood and splatter it seven_times in front of the curtain that blocks the Very Holy Room where the Lord is. 7 And he will_ also _wipe with blood the horns of the altar that's a burning_place for fragrant incense there in front of the Lord that's there inside the Tent that's a Meeting_place. And the remaining blood, will_pour by him there at the foundation of the altar for putting_ burning_things _on there in the doorway of the Tent. 8 And then, the sacrificer will_remove all the fat of the male cow that's being_shedded that's removes sin—all the fat there in stomach, 9 the kidneys and the fats that's attached of it, and the liver which is attached with fat. 10 (And like that also what's_to_do to a domestic_animal that will_be_sacrificed for well-being.) And this will_be_burned by the sacrificer there at the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. 11 But the remainder like skin, all its flesh, the head, the feet, the contents of the stomach, and the dung, 12 he will_bring this to the outside of the camp, to the place that's considered clean which place_where_ashes piled_up and he will_burn it there.[fn]

13 [xr]“Emun ke iyan nakasale ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil te minsan nekey ne me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne ware dan tuyui, nakasale ded sikandan minsan ka se kasuluhan kandan ware nakanengneng te seini ne sale. 14 Ke nanengnengan dan e ne nakasale bes sikandan, keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandan te turu ne nati te baka eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale dan diye te tangkaan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 15 Egkataman, igtel-eb te me igbuyag te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil ka me belad dan diye te ulu te baka wey eggilangen dan seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 16 Ne egkuwa ka Labew ne Talagpanubad te langesa te turu ne nati te baka wey eg-uyanen din seini diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 17 Ig-eled din te langesa ka kemel rin wey igpabesik din seini te kapapitu diye te tangkaan te kurtina ne indingding te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng ne diye ka Magbebaye. 18 Ne egpulitan din degma te langesa ka me sungey-sungey te altar ne tutunganan te insinsu ne diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne diye te seled te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne ka egkasame ne langesa, ig-itis din diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen ne diye te lenged te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 19 Egkataman, egkuen din ka langun ne tabe te turu ne nati te baka, wey egtutungen din seini diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 20 Ka inggimu rin te turu ne baka ne impalangesa ne ig-awe te sale, iling ded degma ka eggimuwen din te seini ne turu ne baka. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale te kabuhalan ni Israil wey egpasayluwen sikandan te Magbebaye. 21 Egkataman, eg-uyanen din seini diye te lihawangan te kampu wey egtutungen din seini iling te pegtutung din te seeye se impanubad te sale din. Sika ka peglinis te sale te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil.

13 [xr]“If it's the all descendants of Israil that sinned whatever commands of the Lord God, that they didn't intend_it they still sinned even if most of them were_ not _aware of this sin. 14 When they knew that they had sinned [surprise], they need to bring a male calf of a cow in_order_for blood_letting that removes sin there in front of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. 15 And then, the elders of all the descendants of Israil will_cover the head of the cow with their hand(s) and they will_slaughter it in front of the Lord. 16 And the Prominent Sacrificer will_get_some blood of the male calf of a cow and bring this to the Tent that's a Meeting_place. 17 He will_dip his finger into the blood and splatter it seven_times there in front of the curtain that blocks the Very Holy Room where the Lord is. 18 And he will_ also _wipe_on with blood the horns of the altar that's a burning_place for fragrant incense in front of the Lord who's inside the Tent that's a Meeting_place. And the remaining blood, he will_pour on the foundation of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on that's there in the near of doorway of the Tent that's a Meeting_place. 19 Then, he will_get(pl) all the fats from the calf of the male cow, and he will_burn this on the altar that's a place_for_putting_ burning_things _on. 20 What_ he _did with the male cow that was_blood_shed that's removes sin, so also he will_do to this male cow. Like that the sacrificer should do in blood_shedding in_order to clean a sin of the descendant(s) of Israil and they will_be_forgiven by the Lord. 21 Then, he will_take this to the outside of the camp and he will_burn this like the burning of what_ he _sacrificed for his sin. This is the cleaning of the sins of all the descendant(s) of Israil.

22 “Ke iyan nakasale ka pangulu te minsan nekey ne me suhu te Magbebaye ne ware tuyui, nakasale ded degma sikandin, 23 ne nanengnengan din e ne nakasale bes sikandin. Keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandin te igpanubad din ne lukesan ne kambing ne ware nabalbalangi. 24 Igdagket din ka palad din te ulu te lukesan ne kambing wey eggilangen din seini diye te gilanganan te egtutungen ne igpanubad ne diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye, eyew ig-awe te sale din. 25 Ne ig-eled te talagpanubad ka kemel rin diye te langesa te igpanubad te peg-awe te sale wey egpulitan din ka me sungey-sungey te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. Ne ka nasame ne langesa ig-itis din diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 26 Ne egtutungen din ka langun ne tabe te ayam diye te altar iling te pegtutung din te tabe te igpanubad para te keupianan. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale te pangulu wey egpasayluwen sikandin te Magbebaye.

22 “If it's the leader that has_sinned without intending whatever commands of the Lord, he has_ also just _sinned, 23 when he becomes_aware that he has_sinned [surprise]. It's_necessary that he bring his sacrifice that's a male goat that doesn't have_defects. 24 He will_put his palm on the head of the male goat and he will_slaughter it there at the slaughtering_place for burning sacrifices there in front of the Lord, in_order to remove his sin. 25 The sacrificer will_dip his finger into the blood of the sacrifice for removing sin and he will_wipe_on the horns of the altar for putting_ burning_things _on. And the remaining blood he will_pour there at the foundation of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. 26 And he will_burn all the fat of domestic_animal there on the altar like his burning of the fat that was_sacrificed for well-being. Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean the sin of the leader and he will_be_forgiven by the Lord.

27 [xr]“Emun ke iyan nakasale ka lerew ne etew te minsan nekey ne me suhu te Magbebaye ne ware din tuyui, nakasale ded sikandin. 28 Ke nanengnengan din e ne nakasale bes sikandin, keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandin te igpanubad din ne beyan ne kambing ne ware nabalbalangi. 29 Igdagket din ka palad din te ulu te beyan ne kambing wey eggilangen din seini diye te gilanganan te egtutungen ne igpanubad. 30 Ne ig-eled te talagpanubad ka kemel rin diye te langesa wey egpulitan din ka me sungey-sungey te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. Ne ka nasame ne langesa, ig-itis din diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 31 Eg-aween din ka langun ne tabe te beyan ne kambing iling te peg-awe te tabe te seeye se igpanubad para te keupianan, wey egtutungen din sika diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen wey ka lansi due igkeemuti te Magbebaye. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale te etew wey egpasayluwen sikandin te Magbebaye.

27 [xr]“If the (one who) sinned (is an) ordinary person of whatever commands of the Lord without intending_to, he/she has sinned still. 28 When he becomes_aware that he has_sinned [surprise], it's_necessary that he bring his sacrifice that's a female goat that doesn't have_defects. 29 He will_put his palm on the head of the female goat and he will_slaughter it there at the slaughtering_place for burning sacrifices. 30 And the sacrificer will_dip his finger into the blood and he will_wipe_on the horns of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. And the remaining blood, he will_pour there at the foundation of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. 31 He will_remove all the fats from the female goat like the removing of fat of that sacrifice for well-being, and it will_be_burned by him there on the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on and the burning smell of that will_be_fragrant to the Lord. Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean a sin of a person and he will_be_forgiven by the Lord.

32 “Piru ke iyan din igpanubad ka nati te karniru eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale din, iyan din eg-uyanen ka beyan ne ware nabalbalangi. 33 Igdagket din ka palad din te ulu te nati te karniru, wey eggilangen din seini diye te gilanganan te egtutungen ne igpanubad. 34 Ne ig-eled te talagpanubad ka kemel rin te langesa te karniru, wey egpulitan din ka me sungey-sungey te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. Ne ka nasame ne langesa, ig-itis din diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 35 Eg-aween din ka langun ne tabe te nati te karniru iling te peg-awe te tabe te seeye se igpanubad para te keupianan, wey egtutungen sika te talagpanubad diye te altar duma te egtutungen ne igmanubad para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale wey egpasayluwen sikandin te Magbebaye.

32 “But if it's a lamb (LIT sheep young) that he sacrifices in_order to remove his sin, what_ he _should_bring is a female that doesn't have defects. 33 He will_put his palm on the head of the lamb (LIT sheep young), and he will_slaughter this at the slaughtering_place for sacrifices to_be_burned. 34 And the sacrificer will_dip his finger into the blood of the sheep, and he will_wipe_on the horns of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. And the remaining blood, he will_pour there at the foundation of the altar that's for putting_ burning_things _on. 35 He will_remove all the fat from the lamb (LIT sheep young) like the removing of fat of that sacrifice for well-being, and the sacrificer will_burn it there on the altar along_with burning sacrifices for the Lord God. Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean a sin and he will_be_forgiven from by the Lord.

Ka igpanubad eyew ig-awe te sale

The sacrifice in_order to remove sin

51 “Ke due etew ne kene egpamalehet diye te hukumanan ke nekey ka nakita rin, wey ke nanengnengan din naa, nakasale sikandin wey due egkaneem-neem din ne legpad.

51 “If there's a person that doesn't witness/prove to the judging_place what_ he/she _has_seen, or he/she knows, he/she has_sinned and there_is punishment that_ he/she _will_experience.

2 “Ke due etew ne nakasamsam te minsan nekey ne in-isip ne malindit, iling te ayam ne napatey,[fn] nakasale sikandin wey eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit minsan ke ware sikandin nakamaan-maan ne nakasamsam bes sikandin.

2 “If there's a person that touches anything that's considered dirty, like a dead animal,[fn] he/she has sinned and he/she is considered dirty even if he/she didn't became_aware that he/she [surprise] touched (it).

3 “Ke nakasamsam sikandin te egpakamalindit te etew[fn] ne ware sikandin nakataha ne egmalindit bes sikandin, egpakasale e sikandin ke egpakamaan-maan e sikandin.

3 “If he/she touched something_that_can_dirty a person[fn] and he/she didn't know that he/she [surprise] had_become dirty, he/she has_sinned when he/she becomes_aware_of this.

4 “Ke due etew ne mahaan egsaad wey kene egsuman-suman ke meupiya wey ke mareet naa ka igsaad din ne iyan egpuunan ne eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit—egpakasale sikandin ke egpakamaan-maan e sikandin ne naseyyup sikandin.

4 “If there's a person who quickly promises and doesn't think if_what he is_going_to_promise (is) good or bad that causes him to_be_considered as dirty—he/she has_sinned when he/she becomes_aware that he made_mistake.

5 “Ke due etew ne egpakasale te minsan hendei te sika ne me sale, keilangan ne igpangguhud din sika. 6 Ne keilangan ne egpanubad sikandin diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te beyan ne nati te karniru wey ke kambing naa eyew igbayad te sale din. Ne igpanubad seini te talagpanubad eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale din.

5 “If there's a person that sins with any of that sin, he/she needs to story this. 6 And it's_necessary that he/she sacrifice a female young sheep or goat to the Lord God in_order to_pay for his/her sin. And this is_sacrificed by the sacrificer for blood_shed in_order to remove his sin.

7 “Piru ke ware nati te karniru ne igpakabehey rin, egkaayun ne iyan din naan de igpanubad ka daruwa ne tukmu wey ke daruwa naa ne seleppati eyew igbayad te sale din: ka sabeka igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale wey ka sabeka igpanubad ne egtutungen. 8 Eg-uyanen din seini diye te talagpanubad wey iyan din iggun-a igpalangesa ka ig-awe te sale. Eggulibiren de te talagpanubad ka lieg te igpanubad piru kene din egpeteen. 9 Ne igpatihis din ka duma ne langesa te impanubad diye kakiliran te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen, wey ka nasame ne langesa, ig-itis din ig-amin diye te pabunsuranan te seeye ne altar. Igpalangesa seini eyew ig-awe te sale. 10 Egkataman, igpanubad te talagpanubad ka ikarangeb ne manuk-manuk ne egtutungen, sumale te me tulumanen te pegpanubad te sika ne igpanubad. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale wey egkapasaylu e ka sale din.

7 “But if no young sheep that he/she can give, it's_possible that what_ he/she _sacrifices (are) two doves or two pigeons in_order to_pay for his/her sin: the one (is for) blood_shed that's removes sin and the one (is a) sacrifice that's burned. 8 He/She takes this to the sacrificer and the one he sacrifices first (is) the (one) for blood_shed that's remove sin. The neck of the sacrifice is just twisted by the sacrificers but he doesn't sever_it. 9 And he will_be_poured_out some of the blood of the sacrifice there on the side of the altar for putting_ burning (things) _on, and the remainder of the blood, he will_pour it entirely there on the foundation of that altar. This is blood_shed in_order to remove sin. 10 Then, the sacrificer will_sacrifice the second bird to_be_burned, according to the customs of sacrificing that sacrifice. Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean a sin and his/her sin will_be_forgiven.

11 “Piru ke ware pad iya man-e tukmu wey ke daruwa naa ne seleppati ne igpakabehey rin, egkaayun ne iyan din naan de ighalad ka senge-kilu ne harina ne amana ne meupiya. Keilangan ne kene din egsewuhan te mentika wey ke meemut naa ne insinsu, su halad seini te peglinis te sale. 12 Eg-uyanen din ka harina ne amana ne meupiya diye te talagpanubad wey eggamak ka talagpanubad dutu eyew te pegpapitew ne ka langun nakapanubad e te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey egtutungen din ka inggamak din duma te me halad diye te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen ne para te Manama. Halad seini ne ig-awe te sale. 13 Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te minsan nekey ne sale te etew. Ne ka same, kandin e te talagpanubad iling te egkakeen ne ighalad.”

11 “But if there's_no spotted_dove or turtle-dove that he/she can give, it's_possible that what_ he/she _sacrifices (is) one kilogram of flour that's very good. It's_necessary that he/she doesn't mix_in cooking_oil or fragrant incense, because this is an offering for cleaning (from) sin. 12 He/She will_bring the very good flour to the sacrificer and the sacrificer will_take_a_handful of it in_order to show that all were already sacrificed to the Lord God, and he will_burn the one handful that he took along_with offerings there on the altar for putting_ burning (things) _on for the God. This is an offering for removing sin. 13 Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean whatever sin. And the remainder, it belongs to the sacrificer just like food offering from the plucked plants.”

Ka ig-awe te sale

The (thing) that's remove sin

14 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 15 “Ke due etew ne nakasupak te Magbebaye tenged su ware sikandin nakabehey te ighalad diye te Magbebaye, keilangan ne egpanubad sikandin te lukesan ne karniru ne ware nabalbalangi eyew igbayad te sale din. Ne keilangan ne ka kentiddad te karniru igpeiling te kentiddad te pelata ne intimbang diye te timbangan te me talagpanubad.[fn] Sika ka igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale. 16 Ne keilangan ne egbayaran din pad man-e ka ware din ikabehey diye te Magbebaye, wey egtimulan din pad seini te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu. Ne igbehey rin seini te talagpanubad ne iyan egpalangesa te sabeka ne lukesan ne karniru eyew te peglinis te sale din wey egkapasaylu e sikandin.

14 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 15 “If there's a person that disobeyed the Lord God because he can't able_to_give what's to_be_offered there to the Lord, he/she needs to sacrifice a male sheep that has no defects in_order to pay for his/her sin. It's_necessary that the cost of the sheep is_like the price of the silver that weight to the scales used by sacrificers.[fn] That's the sacrifice in_order to pay for sin. 16 And it's_necessary that he/she still pay what_ he/she didn't _give to the Lord, and it will_be_added_to with twenty (20) percent. And he/she should_give this to the sacrificer who will_do_a_blood_shedding of one male sheep in_order to clean his/her sin and he/she will_be_forgiven.

17 “Ke due etew ne nakasupak te Magbebaye, minsan ke ware din nataheyi, nakasale sikandin wey due egkaneem-neem din ne legpad. 18 Keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandin diye te talagpanubad te lukesan ne karniru ne ware nabalbalangi eyew igpanubad te talagpanubad te peg-awe te sale. Ne keilangan ne ka kentiddad te karniru, igpeiling te kentiddad te pelata ne intimbang diye te timbangan te me talagpanubad. Iling due ka eggimuwen te talagpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale te etew ne ware tuyui wey egkapasaylu e sikandin te sale din. 19 Sika ka igpanubad ne ig-awe te sale, su nakasale ma sikandin diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

17 “If there's a person who disobeyed the Lord, even if he/she didn't know, he/she has_sinned and there_is punishment that_ he/she _will_experience. 18 It's_necessary that he brings a male sheep without defects in_order to sacrifice by the sacrificer to remove sin. And it's_necessary that the price of the sheep be_made_like the price of silver that weight there to the scale by the sacrificers. Like that the sacrificer should do for blood_shedding in_order to clean his sin that's unintentional, and he will_be_forgiven of his/her sin. 19 That is the sacrifice to remove sin, because he/she sinned against the Lord God.”

61 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Ke due etew ne nakasupak te Magbebaye puun su inlimbungan din ka duma rin ne migtaleu kandin te kasangkapan wey ke impanakawan din naa wey ke inlupihan din naa, 3 wey ke nakakita naa sikandin te kasangkapan ne nasi din iheles, wey ke migpahunlibet naa te ware sikandin nekeyimu te minsan nekey ne sale, 4 wey emun ke nakasale iya sikandin, keilangan ne ig-uli din ka intakew rin wey ke sika se nakuwa rin te pegpanlupig din wey ke inggeles din naa ka impatahu kandin wey ka nalaag ne kasangkapan ne nakita rin, 5 wey ka minsan nekey ne inggeles din wey impahunlibetan ne ware diye te kandin. Keilangan ne ig-uli din seini diye te kamuney ne ware naawei minsan deisek wey egtimulan din pad te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu ka kentiddad dutu. Ig-uli din seini te sasangan e sikandin ne egpanubad eyew igbayad te sale din. 6 Ne eg-uyan sikandin diye te talagpanubad te sabeka ne lukesan ne karniru ne ware nabalbalangi eyew igbayad te sale din. Ne keilangan ne ka kentiddad te karniru igpeiling te kentiddad te pelata ne intimbang diye te timbangan te me talagpanubad. 7 Ne egpalangesa ka talagpanubad diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew iglinis te sale din, wey egkapasaylu e sikandin tenged te sale din.”

61 [xr]And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God again, 2 “If there's a person that disobeys the Lord because he/she cheats his companion that leaves_ his/her possessions _in_safe_keeping or if he steals_from_him/her or if he/she takes_advantage_of_him/her, 3 or if he/she sees possessions that he/she instead hides, or if he/she swears that he/she didn't do whatever sin, 4 and if he/she has indeed sinned, it's_necessary that he/she return what_ he/she _stole or he/she took_advantage_of or he/she hid what_was_stored with_him/her or the possessions that were lost that he/she saw, 5 or whatever he/she hid and swore wasn't there at his/her (place). It's_necessary that he/she return this to the owner without even a little removed and he/she should_add twenty (20) percent of the price of it. He/She should_return this at the time that he/she does the sacrificing in_order to_pay for his/her sin. 6 And he/she takes one male sheep without defect to the sacrificer in_order to_pay for his/her sin. It's_necessary that the cost of the sheep is_like the price of the silver that weight to the scale by sacrificers. 7 And the sacrificer sheds_blood there in front of the Lord God in_order to clean his sin, and he/she will_be_forgiven.”

Ka tulumanen te talagpanubad

The ritual/regulation for sacrificers

8 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 9 “Kahii nu si Aarun wey ka me anak din te seini ka me tulumanen meyitenged te egtutungen ne igpanubad. Ka egtutungen ne igpanubad kene eg-aw-aween diye te altar taman te egkapawaan wey keilangan ne kene egkeebukan ka hapuy diye te altar. 10 Ne igsaluub te talagpanubad ka kumbale ne linu wey ka malepet ne salual ne igbunbun te lebut, wey egkuen din ka naabu e ne intutung ne impanubad wey igtahu din seini diye te lenged te altar. 11 Emun ke egkeimpusan din e ka eggimuwen din, egliwanan din e ka ingkukumbale din wey eg-uyanen din e ka abu diye te lihawangan te kampu ne in-isip ne malinis. 12 Keilangan ne layun egkalegleg ka hapuy diye te altar wey kene egkeebukan. Ne tagse maselem eg-undulan te talagpanubad wey eg-ay-ayaran din te egtutung ka egtutungen ne igpanubad diye te hapuy. Ne iglagkes din te egtutung ka tabe te ayam ne igpanubad para te keupianan. 13 Keilangan ne layun egkalegleg ka hapuy diye te altar wey kene egkeebukan.

8 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 9 “Tell(sg) Aarun and his children these rules concerning burning sacrifices. The burning sacrifice will_ not _be_removed from the altar until dawn and it's_necessary that the fire there on the altar doesn't go_out. 10 And the sacrificer should_dress in cloth linen and the short pants that covers (his) genitals, and he should_get the ashes of the burned sacrifice and he should_put there at/on the near of the altar. 11 When_ he _finished what_he_does, he should_change what_ he's _wearing and he will_take the ashes outside the camp that's considered clean. 12 It's_necessary that the fire there on the altar always burn and not go_out. And each morning (it's) stoked by the sacrificer and he carefully burns the burning sacrifice there on the fire. And he includes the fat of the domestic_animal to sacrifice for the well_being. 13 It's_necessary that the fire always burns on the altar and doesn't go_out.

Ka me halad ne egpuun te egkakeen

The offerings from the food

14 “Seini ka me tulumanen meyitenged te egkakeen ne ighalad: Ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun ka eghalad te halad ne egketuen diye te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te tangkaan te altar. 15 Ne eggamak ka talagpanubad te inhalad ne harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika, wey egtutungen din sika diye te altar lagkes ka langun ne meemut ne insinsu ne insewug kayi. Egtutungen sika diye te altar isip pegsuman-suman te Magbebaye, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye. 16 Ka egkasame ne harina eggilutuen ne ware patulin wey egkeenen enni Aarun wey te me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan din. Ne keilangan ne diye dan de sika egkeena te lama te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan ne in-isip ne matulus ne inged. 17 Eggilutuen sika ne ware patulin. Imbehey sika kandan te Magbebaye su sika iya ka baad dan puun te egtutungen ne inhalad diye te Magbebaye. Amana ne matulus seini iling te halad te peg-awe te sale wey te halad eyew igbayad te sale. 18 Ne egpakakeen due ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Aarun lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan su sika iya ka baad dan puun te halad ne egtutungen ne ighalad diye te Magbebaye. Ne minsan hentew ne eggen-gen due keilangan ne matulus.”[fn]

14 “These (are) the regulations concerning the offering that's food: The sacrificers that are descendants of Aarun (are) the (ones who) offer the offering that's grain to the Lord God there in front of the altar. 15 And the sacrificer takes_a_handful of the offered flour that's very good and mixed_with cooking_oil, and he burns this on the altar including all the fragrant incense that's mixed_in. That will_burn there to altar as remembering the Lord, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord. 16 The remaining flour will_be_cooked without rising_agent and will_be_eaten by Aarun and by the sacrificers who (are) his descendants. It's_necessary that they eat that there in the yard of the Tent that's a Meeting_place that's considered holy place. 17 This is_to_be_cooked without rising_agent. This is_given to_them by the Lord God as a their portion from the offering that's burned that's offered to the Lord. This is very holy like the offering for removing sin and the offering in_order to pay for sin. 18 And all the descendants of Aarun including all the still following descendants are_able_to_eat this because that's indeed their portion from the offering that's a burned offering to the Lord God. And whoever touches this must be holy.”[fn]

Ka halad te talagpanubad

The offering of the sacrificer

19 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 20 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Aarun te seini ka ighalad dan keddi te Magbebaye ke egkeitisan e sikandan te lana eyew egkeyimu ne me talagpanubad: sabeka ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya. Ighalad dan sika isip halad ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula. Ne egbaaren dan ka harina te eghalad te maselem wey marusilem. 21 Egpirituwen sika diye te kale wey keilangan ne eg-ugseb ka mentika diye te harina. Emun egkalutu e, egteptepiken dan sika iling te halad ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye. 22 Ighalad langun sika ne egtutungen. Ne keilangan ne iyan eghalad due diye te Magbebaye ka tagse talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun ne in-itisan te lana eyew egsubal kandin te Labew ne Talagpanubad. Balaud sika ne ware egtamanan. 23 Egtutungen ka langun ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula ne ighalad te talagpanubad—kene sika egkeenen.”

19 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 20 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Aarun that this is what_they should_be_offered to me the Lord when they have_ oil _poured_over_them in_order to_become sacrificers: the offering (is) one kilogram of flour that's very good. They will_offer that as an offering from the plants that will_be_plucked. And they should_divide the flour to offer in the morning and the evening. 21 That should_be_fried in a pan and it's_necessary that the oil will_soak into the flour. When it's cooked, they break_ it _into_pieces like an offering from plants_that_will_be_plucked, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord. 22 All of that will_be_offered that be_burned. And (it's) necessary that the_one_who will_offer it to the Lord were (particularly) each sacrificer who's a descendant of Aarun that has_ oil _poured_over in_order to replace him as Prominent Sacrificer. That's law without ending. 23 All the grain crops from plucked plants that are_offered by the sacrificer should_be_burned—it can't be eaten.”

Ka tulumanen te igpanubad te peglinis te sale

The rule of sacrificing for cleaning (from) sin

24 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 25 “Kahii nu si Aarun wey ka me kabuhalan din ne seini ka me tulumanen meyitenged te igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale. Ka igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale keilangan ne eggilangen diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye diye te gilanganan te egtutungen ne igpanubad. Ka igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale amana ne matulus. 26 Ka nasame te impanubad keilangan ne egkeenen te talagpanubad ne iyan migpanubad due. Piru diye din de egkeena te lama te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey in-isip ne matulus. 27 Ka minsan hentew ne egsamsam te impanubad e, keilangan ne matulus. Ke nabesikan te langesa te impanubad ka malayat ne kumbale, keilangan ne egpi-pian sika diye te lama te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey in-isip ne matulus. 28 Ne emun kuren ne tane ka inggilutuan te impanubad, keilangan ne egpeseen. Piru ke kuren ne inggimu puun te burunsi, keilangan ne eg-unasan wey eglu-luan. 29 Egkaayun ne egkeen te ngalap ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Aarun ne me lukes ne talagpanubad. Amana ne matulus seini. 30 Piru kene egkaayun ne egkeenen ka ngalap te impalangesa ke in-uyan e ka langesa due diye te matulus ne sinabeng te Balungbalung eyew ig-awe te sale te etew; egtutungen iya sika wey kene egkeenen.

24 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 25 “Tell(sg) Aarun and his descendants that these rules about blood_shedding that's removes sin. The blood_shedding that's removes sin needs_to_be_slaughtered there in front of the Lord there at the slaughtering_place for burned sacrifices. The blood_shedding that's removes sin (is) very holy. 26 The remainder of what_was_sacrificed must_be_eaten by the sacrificer who sacrificed it. But he should_eat it there at the yard of the Tent that's Meeting_place, and consider as holy. 27 Whoever touches of what_sacrificed already, must be_holy. If the long clothing is_splashed by the blood of what_was_sacrificed, it's_necessary that (it's) just washed at yard of the Tent that's Meeting_place, and considered as holy. 28 And if the pot that what_was_sacrificed was_cooked_in is earthen, it's_necessary to_be_smashed. But if the pot is made from bronze, it's_necessary to be scraped and washed. 29 All the male descendants of Aarun who are sacrificers can_eat the meat. This is very holy. 30 But it's_ not _possible to eat the meat of_what_was_blood_shedded if the blood of it is brought to the holy room of the Tent in_order to remove sin of the person; it must_be_burned indeed and not eaten.

Ka igpanubad ne igbayad te sale

The sacrifice that pays for sin

71 “Seini ka me tulumanen meyitenged te igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale. Amana ne matulus seini ne igpanubad: 2 ka igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale, diye eggilanga te gilanganan te egtutungen ne igpanubad. Ka langesa te sika ne igpanubad, iglingut igsawig diye te me kakiliran te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. 3 Ne igpanubad ka langun ne tabe te ayam: ka malambu ne ikug, ka me tabe ne diye te getek, 4 ka me iihian wey ka nandeket ne me tabe kayi, wey ka atey ne indeketan te tabe. Sika ka egpangaween duma te iihian. 5 Egtutungen sika te talagpanubad diye te altar eyew igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Igpanubad sika eyew igbayad te sale. 6 Ka langun ne lukes ne kabuhalan te me talagpanubad, egpakakeen te nasame te impanubad. Ne keilangan ne diye dan de egkeena sika te matulus ne inged su amana sika ne matulus.

71 “These (are) the rules about sacrificing in_order to_pay for sin. This is a very holy sacrifice: 2 the sacrifice in_order to_pay for sin, should_be_slaughtered there at the slaughtering_place of the sacrifice that be_burned. The blood of that sacrifice, splash there to the sides of the altar that's a place_to_put the burning (thing). 3 And all the fat of the animal will_be_sacrificed: the fat tail, and the fats there in the stomach, 4 the kidneys and the fat that attached of it, and the liver which is attached with fat. That (what) will_be_removed together_with the kidneys. 5 The sacrificer burn that there on the altar in_order to sacrifice (it) to the Lord God. That's a sacrifice in_order to pay for sin. 6 All the males who are descendants of the sacrificers, can_eat the left_over of what_was_sacrificed. And it's_necessary that they should_eat that there in the holy place because that's very holy.

7 “Nekeg-iling de ka tulumanen te igpalangesa eyew ig-awe te sale wey te igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale; ka ngalap te impanubad, kandin e te talagpanubad ne iyan migpalangesa. 8 Ka laplap te ayam ne impanubad te minsan hentew eyew igpanubad ne egtutungen, kandin e te talagpanubad ne iyan migpanubad te ayam. 9 Ka langun ne halad ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula ne inggilutu diye te hilutuanan te paan, minsan ka inggilutu diye te kale, wey ke diye naa te kuren, kandin e te migpanubad. 10 Piru ka langun ne halad ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula ne ware hilutua ne insewuhan te mentika wey ke ware naa sewuhi, kandin e te me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun wey eg-ay-ayaran dan seini egba-baara.”

7 “The ritual on blood_shedding in_order for removing the sin and the sacrifice in_order to pay for sin is just same; the meat of what_was_sacrifice, belong to the sacrificer who blood_shed (it). 8 The skin of the domestic_animal sacrificed by anyone in_order to_be_sacrificed as burnt, belong to the sacrificer who blood_shed the domestic_animal. 9 All the food offering from plucked plants which are cooked there in the bread_cooking_place, even the one cooked there in the pan, or there in the pot, belong to the sacrificer. 10 But all the uncooked offering from plucked plants mixed with oil or unmixed, belong to the sacrificers who are descendants of Aarun and they will_divide it equally (LIT nicely).”

Ka igpanubad para te keupianan

The sacrifice for peace

11 “Seini ka me tulumanen meyitenged te igpanubad para te keupianan ne ighalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 12 Ke egpanubad sikandin te mananap para te keupianan eyew te pegpasalamat, keilangan ne egpatapikan din te nakalkalasi ne paan ne ware patulin—makepal ne paan ne insewuhan te mentika, manipis ne paan ne inlakulasan te mentika, wey paan ne inggimu puun te harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan ded te mentika. 13 Egpanguyanen din seini duma te igpanubad para te keupianan wey egtimulan din pad seini te paan ne due patulin eyew te pegpasalamat din. 14 Ne egkuwa sikandin te tigsalimbeka puun te nalein-lein ne paan ne ighalad eyew igdasag te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne iyan egpakakamuney due ka talagpanubad ne migsawig te langesa te igpanubad para te keupianan. 15 Ne ka ngalap te impanubad din eyew te pegpasalamat, keilangan ne egkeenen de te sika ne aldew, ware egsameen minsan deisek de taman te egkapawe. 16 Piru ke iyan din igpanubad ka para te keupianan eyew te pegtuman te saad wey ke pegpanubad naa ne egpuun te pusung, sikan de iya ne aldew egkeena ka ngalap due. Piru ke duen pad egkasame te egkapawe, egkaayun ded ne egkeenen. 17 Ne emun ke duen pad iya man-e egkasame te igkarangeb ne aldew, keilangan ne egtutungen e seini. 18 Ne emun ke due etew ne egkeen te ngalap te igkatatelu e ne aldew, kene egdawaten te Magbebaye ne Manama ka etew ne migpanubad wey egkeyimu ne ware karuan te pegpanubad din. Eg-isipen seini ne malindit wey ke due egkeen kayi egpakaneem-neem sikandin te legpad. 19 Ne emun egpakaragket ka ngalap te minsan nekey ne in-isip ne mallindit, kenad e sika egkeenen, su egtutungen e. Ne iyan de egpakakeen te impanubad seeye se malinis. 20 Piru ka etew ne in-isip ne malindit pad ne egkeen te ngalap te igpanubad para te keupianan, keilangan ne egdeldelen e sikandin puun te me karumaan din. 21 Ne emun due etew ne egpakahen-gen te in-isip ne mallindit—ka minsan nekey ne egpakamalindit te etew, ka mananap wey ka langun ne in-isip ne mallindit, ke egkeen sikandin te ngalap te igpanubad para te keupianan, ka sika ne etew, egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din.”

11 “These (are) the rituals about the offering for sacrifice for well-being there to_the Lord God. 12 If he sacrifice animal for peace offering as thanks giving, it is necessary that he include_with different_kinds of bread with no rising_agent—thick bread mixed with oil, thin bread smeared with oil, and bread from a very good flour also mixed with oil. 13 He will_bring it together_with the sacrifice for well-being and he will_add to it a bread with leavened in_order for his giving_thanks. 14 He needs to get one_each from the various bread to_be_sacrificed in_order to gift to the Lord God. The one_who_owns it (will be) the sacrificer who splashes the blood of the sacrificed for well-being. 15 And the meat of sacrificed_animal for thanksgiving, must be eaten on that day only, no left_over even just small_amount until the next_morning. 16 But if he sacrifices is the one for well-being in_order to fulfill the promise or a sacrificing that's from his heart indeed, the meat should be eaten on that day. But if there's a left_over in the next_morning, it is possible to eat it. 17 And if there's still left_over on the second day, it must be burned. 18 And if there's a person eats the meat on the third day, the Lord God won't accept the person who sacrificed and his sacrifice become no use. This is considered dirty and if there's somebody who eat it can experience punishment. 19 And if the meat touches to anything that's considered dirty, this won't be_eaten, because it would_be_burned. And only those who are clean can_eat what's sacrificed. 20 But the person who is still considered dirty who will_eat the meat of the sacrificed for well-being, he must be expelled from his relatives. 21 And if there's a person who can touch what's considered dirty—the whatever that can make_a_person_dirty, the animal and the all that's considered dirty, and_if he eats the meat of the sacrificed for well-being, that person, will_be_expelled from his relatives.”

Ka tulumanen meyitenged te tabe wey te langesa

The ritual concerning the fat and the blood

22 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 23 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil ne kene sikandan egkaayun ne egkeen te tabe te baka, te karniru wey ke kambing naa. 24 Ne ka tabe te mananap ne napatey re due wey ke inggimatayan naa te mahintalunan, egkaayun ne eggamiten niyu seini piru kene niyu keena. 25 Su ka egkeen te tabe te ayam ne igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egtutungen, egdeldelen e sikandin puun te me karumaan din. 26 [xr]Ne kene ne sikan de, minsan ke hendei kew egpekeugpe, kene kew iya egkaayun ne egkeen te langesa te manuk-manuk wey te ayam. 27 Ka egkeen te langesa, keilangan ne egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din.”

22 And the Lord God said to Muwisis again, 23 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that it's_not possible for them to eat a fat of the cow, of the sheep or goat. 24 And the fat of the animal that's dead of itself or the ones_killed_by the wild_animals, it is possible that you(pl) use it but don't eat (it). 25 Because the one eating fat of the animal that's sacrificed in_order to be burned there to the Lord God, he will_be_expelled from his relatives. 26 [xr]And not only that, even wherever you(pl) may live, don't(pl) indeed eat blood of the birds and of the domestic_animals. 27 The one eating blood, he must be_expelled from his relatives.”

Ka igteil ne baad te talagpanubad

The set_aside portion of the sacrificer

28 Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 29 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil te minsan hentew ne eg-uyan te igpanubad para te keupianan, keilangan ne egteil te baad te Magbebaye ne igbehey diye te talagpanubad. 30 Ne sikandin de ka eg-uyan te seeye se igdasag diye te Magbebaye. Eg-uyanen din degma ka tabe duma te kumeng. Ne ighalad ne egkayawen ka kumeng diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 31 Egtutungen te talagpanubad diye te altar ka tabe piru ka kumeng, igbehey diye ki Aarun wey te me karumaan din ne talagpanubad. 32 Ne ka kawanan ne bubun te igpanubad ne ayam, igbehey diye te talagpanubad su sika iya ka baad din te igpanubad para te keupianan. 33 Ne ka talagpanubad ne migpanubad te langesa wey te tabe te igpanubad para te keupianan, iyan egbehayan te igkakawanan ne bubun te ayam su sika iya ka baad din. 34 Su ka kumeng ne indasag wey bubun te igpanubad para te keupianan, igbehey e ki Aarun wey te me anak din su sika iya ka baad dan te ware egtamanan puun te igmanubad te me kabuhalan ni Israil. 35 Sika ka baad ni Aarun wey te me anak din puun te igmanubad ne egtutungen para te Magbebaye. Egkarawat dan sika ne baad puun te aldew ne immatulus sikandan eyew egpamakey te Magbebaye isip me talagpanubad. 36 Igpabehey sika kandan te Magbebaye te me kabuhalan ni Israil te timpu ne egkeitisan e sikandan ni Muwisis te lana. Sika ka baad dan wey te me kabuhalan dan keureme.”

28 And the Lord God said again to Muwisis, 29 “Tell the descendants of Israil that whoever brings a sacrifice for well-being, (he) must set_aside a portion of the Lord that will_be_given to the sacrificer. 30 And it's only him the one to bring that something_to_sacrifice to the Lord. He will_bring also the fat with the chest. And the chest will_be_offered that's raise there in the front of the Lord. 31 The sacrificer will_burn the fat there on the altar but the chest, will_be_given to Aarun and to his relatives who are sacrificers. 32 And the right thigh of the animal to_be_sacrificed, will_be_given to the sacrificer because that's really his portion of what_is_sacrificed for well-being. 33 And the sacrificer who sacrificed blood and fat from that sacrifice for well-being, will_be_given the right thigh of the animal because that's really his portion. 34 Because the breast that's given_as_gift and the thigh of_what_is sacrificed for well-being, will_be_given to Aarun and his children because that's there portion forever (LIT without ending) from the sacrifices of the descendants of Israil. 35 That's the share of Aarun and of his children from the burnt offerings for the Lord. They will_receive that portion from the day that they were made_holy in_order to serve to the Lord as sacrificer(s). 36 God cause_ that _to_be_given to them by the descendants of Israil at the time when Muwisis could_pour them with oil. That's there portion and of their descendants in the future.”

37 Seeye ka me tulumanen te igpanubad ne egtutungen, te egkakeen ne ighalad, te igpanubad te peg-awe te sale, te igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale, te igpanubad te peg-urdina te me talagpanubad, wey te igpanubad para te keupianan. 38 Seeye ne me tulumanen insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis diye te Bubungan ne Sinay te timpu ne insuhu te Manama ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne eg-uyan te ighalad wey igpanubad diye te kandin.

37 Those (are) the rituals/regulations for burnt sacrifice, food offering, sacrifice for removing sin, sacrifice in_order to pay for sin, sacrifice to ordain of the sacrificers, and the sacrifice for well-being. 38 This rituals/regulations were commanded by the Lord God to Muwisis there at the Mount Sinay at the time when God commanded all the descendants of Israil to bring an offering and sacrifice there to him.

Ka peggimu ne me talagpanubad ki Aarun wey te anak din

The making of Aarun and his children as sacrificers

(Iks 29:1‑37)

(Exo 29:1‑37)

81 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2-3 “Dumaa nu si Aarun wey ka me anak din ne me lukes diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey libulunga nu ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil diye. Uyana nu naa ka igpasaluub te me talagpanubad, ka lana ne ig-itis te peg-urdina, wey ka turu ne baka ne igpanubad te peg-awe te sale. Ne uyana nu man-e ka daruwa ne lukesan ne karniru wey senge liyang ne paan ne ware patulin.”

81 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2-3 “Accompany(sg) Aarun and his male children to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and gather(sg) all the descendants of Israil there. Bring(sg) the clothing for the sacrificers, the oil that's poured_out for ordination, and bull cow to_be_sacrificed for removing sin. And bring(sg) also the two male sheep and woven_basket of bread without leaven.”

4 Ne intuman ni Muwisis ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin. Te nalibulung e ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, 5 migkahiyan e sikandan ni Muwisis, “Insuhu keddi te Magbebaye seini se eggimuwen ku.”

4 And Muwisis fulfilled what_ the Lord God _commanded him. When all the descendants of Israil were gathered already there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, 5 they were_told by Muwisis, “The Lord commanded me this what_ I _will_do.”

6 Ne dutu, impeendiyad e ni Muwisis te tangkaan si Aarun wey ka me anak din wey indihus din e sikandan. 7 Ne insaluuban din si Aarun te egpekeiling te linayun ne malayat se belad,[fn] wey intaberan din wey insaluuban te binelaran ne kumbale. Insaluuban din pad man-e te kumbale ne egngaranan te ipud wey impalilibed din e te libed ne in-ay-ayaran te eggimu. 8 Nataman, impakepkep e ni Muwisis te kumeng ni Aarun ka hagpi te kumeng ne due me burusa wey intahu din e dutu ka Urim wey ka Tumim. 9 Nataman, insalakayan din e si Aarun, wey intahuan din te malibusen ne balieg ne bulawan ka tangkaan te salakey eyew egkeila ne in-alam sikandin te Manama. Inggimu sika ni Muwisis su insuhu ma sikandin te Manama.

6 And then, Muwisis caused_ Aarun and his children _to_go to the front and he bathed them. 7 And he clothed Aarun with something_like a dress with long arm,[fn] and he girded him and put_on a long_armed cloth. He also put_on_him a cloth called ipud and caused_him_to_girdle with band that's nicely made. 8 Then, Muwisis attached the chest covering in Aarun's chest which has a purse and he put there the Urim and Tumim. 9 And then, he put_head_covering onto Aarun, and he put gold round necklace in front of the head_covering in_order to make_known that God chose him. Muwisis did that because God commanded him.

10 Ne ingkuwa ni Muwisis ka lana wey in-itisan din ka Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey ka langun ne diye te seled, wey inhalad din e seeye. 11 Ne kapapitu rin itisi te lana ka altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad wey ka langun ne kasangkapan diye, ka pelenggana wey ka egpapinnuuwan kayi. Inggimu rin sika eyew te peghalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 12 Ne in-itisan ni Muwisis te lana ka ulu ni Aarun eyew te peg-urdina kandin. 13 Ne impeendiye din e degma ka me anak ni Aarun te tangkaan te me etew wey insaluuban din te egpekeiling te linayun ne malayat se belad. Intaberan din degma sikandan wey insalakayan. Inggimu sika ni Muwisis su sika ka insuhu kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama.

10 And Muwisis took the oil and he poured_ (it) _on the Tent of Meeting and everything there inside, and he offered it. 11 And he poured oil seven_times on the altar for burning sacrifice and all its utensils, the basin and its base. He did that in_order to offer (it) to the Lord God. 12 And Muwisis poured oil onto his head in_order to ordain him. 13 And he caused_ also the children of Aarun _to_go to the front of the people and he clothed (them) with something_like a dress with long arm. He girded them also and put_head_covering_on. Muwisis did that because that's really what_ the Lord God _commanded him to do.

14 Pegkapenga dutu, ingkuwa ni Muwisis ka turu ne baka ne igpalangesa eyew ig-awe te sale, wey indagket ni Aarun wey te me anak din ka palad dan diye te ulu te turu ne baka. 15 Nataman, inggimatayan e ni Muwisis ka baka wey ingkuwa rin ka langesa. In-eled din ka kemel rin te langesa wey impulitan din ka me sungey-sungey te altar, eyew egmalinis. Ne in-ule din ka nasame ne langesa diye te pabunsuranan te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen eyew iglinis te altar. 16 Ne ingkuwa degma ni Muwisis ka langun ne tabe ne diye te getek, ka atey ne indeketan te tabe, ka me iihian wey ka tabe kayi, wey intutung din diye te altar. 17 Piru ka nasame ne baad te turu ne baka, iling te laplap, te sapu, wey te bituka, diye din tutunga te lihawangan te kampu sumale te insuhu kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama.

14 After that, Muwisis took the bull cow to be blood_shed in_order to remove sin, and Aarun and his children touched their palms on the head of the cow. 15 And then, Muwisis slaughtered the cow and took the blood. He dipped his finger in the blood and put_on the horns of the altar, in_order to become_clean. And he pour_out the rest of the blood there at the base of the altar which the burnt_offering is put_on in_order for cleaning the altar. 16 And Muwisis took also all fats there in the stomach, and very good portion of the liver, the kidneys and its fat, and burned them there at the altar. 17 But the remaining part of the cow, like the skin, flesh, and intestines, he burned (them) there outside the camp according to what's_commanded him by the Lord God.

18 Nataman, impakuwa ni Muwisis ka an-anayan ne lukesan ne karniru eyew igpanubad ne egtutungen, wey indagket ni Aarun wey te me anak din ka belad dan diye te ulu te lukesan ne karniru. 19 Ne inggimatayan ni Muwisis seini wey inlingut din isawig ka langesa diye te me kakiliran te altar. 20-21 Insapu din ka karniru wey inlu-luan din ka langun ne diye te getek wey ka me paa. Nataman, intutung din e ka langun diye te altar, lagkes ka ulu wey ka me tabe eyew igpanubad, wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye. Inggimu seini ni Muwisis sumale te suhu te Magbebaye.

18 Then, Muwisis caused_ the first male sheep _to_be_brought_in in_order to_be_sacrificed as burnt, and Aarun and his children touched their hands there to the head of the male sheep. 19 And Muwisis slaughtered it and he splashed the blood around there at the sides of the altar. 20-21 He cut the sheep and washed(sg) all that's there inside_the_stomach and the feet. Then, he burned everything on the altar, including the head and the fats in_order to sacrifice, and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord. Moses did this according to the command of the Lord.

22 Ne impakuwa ni Muwisis ka ikarangeb ne lukesan ne karniru ne igpanubad para te peg-urdina. Ne imparagket ni Aarun wey te me anak din ka belad dan diye te ulu te lukesan ne karniru. 23 Ne nataman, inggimatayan e ni Muwisis ka karniru wey migkuwa sikandin te langesa wey impulit din diye te sesel-ayan te igkakawanan ne talinga ni Aarun wey diye te timbebakal te igkakawanan ne belad din wey te paa rin. 24 Nataman, impeendiye degma ni Muwisis te tangkaan ka me anak ni Aarun wey impulitan din degma ka sesel-ayan te igkakawanan ne talinga ran wey te timbebakal te igkakawanan ne belad wey te paa ran. Nataman, inlingut din isawig ka duma ne langesa diye te altar. 25 Ne ingkuwa rin ka me tabe, ka malambu ne ikug, ka langun ne tabe ne diye te getek, ka atey ne nandeketan te tabe, ka me iihian wey ka tabe kayi, wey ka kawanan ne bubun. 26 Ne migkuwa sikandin te sabeka ne paan puun te liyang ne intahuan te me paan ne ware patulin ne inhalad e diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Migkuwa degma sikandin te paan ne insewuhan te mentika, wey te manipis ne paan. In-untud din seini langun diye te tabe wey te kawanan ne bubun te karniru. 27 Ne imbehey rin e seini langun diye ki Aarun wey te me anak din eyew igkayew ran diye te Manama isip igdasag ne egkayawen. 28 Pegkeimpus dan te egkayew, ingkuwa red seini ni Muwisis wey inlagkes din te egtutung te igpanubad ne egtutungen diye te altar. Igpanubad seini para te peg-urdina kandan wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 29 Ne ingkuwa degma ni Muwisis ka kumeng te karniru wey ingkayew rin diye te Manama eyew igdasag ne egkayawen. Seini ka baad din te lukesan ne karniru ne impanubad para te peg-urdina. Inggimu seini langun ni Muwisis su insuhu sikandin te Magbebaye.

22 And Muwisis caused_ the second male sheep _to_be_brought_in in_order to_be_sacrificed for ordination. And Aarun and his children touched their hands there to the head of the male sheep. 23 And then, Muwisis slaughtered the sheep and he took some_blood and put_on the right earlobe of Aaron's ear and on the thumbs of his right hand and foot. 24 Then, Muwisis caused_ the children of Aarun _to_go to the front and he put_on (blood) also on the right earlobes of their ears and on the thumbs of their right hand and feet. Then, he splashed the other blood around the altar there. 25 And he took the fats, the fat tail, all the fats there in the stomach, the liver which is attached with fat, the kidneys and the fat of it, and the right thigh. 26 And he took one bread from the woven_basket where the bread without leaven being offered already to the Lord God was put_in. He also took a bread mixed with oil, and a thin bread. He placed_ these all _on_top of the fats and the right thigh of the sheep. 27 And he gave these all to Aarun and to his children in_order to raise (it) to God as raised_up offering. 28 After their raising_up, Muwisis took it again and burned (it) at the altar together_with the sacrifice to be_burned. This is a sacrifice for ordination and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant to the Lord God. 29 And Muwisis also took a breast of the sheep and raised (it) to God in_order to raised_up offering. It's his portion of the male sheep that's sacrificed for ordination. Muwisis did all these because the Lord commanded him.

30 Ne migkuwa si Muwisis te lana ne ig-itis te peg-urdina wey te langesa ne diye te altar wey impatihisan din si Aarun wey ka me anak din, wey ka me kumbale dan. Iling due ka peg-urdina ki Aarun wey te me anak din wey te me kumbale dan.

30 And Muwisis took oil that's pour_out for ordination and blood there at the altar and caused_(it)_to_drip onto Aarun and his children, and on their cloths. It's like that the ordaining of Aarun and his children and their cloths.

31 Ne migkahiyan ni Muwisis si Aarun wey ka me anak din, “Hilutu-a niyu ka ngalap te ikarangeb ne karniru diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Nakahiyan kud sikaniyu te diye niyu re seini keena wey ka paan ne diye te liyang ne inhalad para te peg-urdina. 32 Ne tutunga niyu ka same niyu te egkeen. 33 Kene kew awe kayi te seled te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan te pitu ne aldew, taman te egkeimpusan e ka peg-urdina kaniyu. 34 Ne ka langun ne inggimu ta kuntee, insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew iglinis te me sale niyu. 35 Ne kene kew awe diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan te aldew wey marusilem te pitu ne aldew. Ne himuwa niyu ka insuhu te Manama keddi ne igpeyimu rin kaniyu eyew kene kew egpatey. Sika ka insuhu te Magbebaye keddi.” 36 Purisu, intuman ni Aarun wey te me anak din ka langun ne insuhu te Manama ki Muwisis ne igpeyimu kandan.

31 And Muwisis said to Aarun and his children, “Cook(pl) the meat of the second sheep there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. I was_able_to_tell you(pl) already that you(sg) eat it only there and the bread which is there in the woven_basket sacrificed for ordination. 32 And burn(pl) your(pl) left_over of what_(you)_eat. 33 Don't(pl) leave here inside the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the ordination for you(pl) is done. 34 And all that we(incl) did today, (was) commanded by the Lord God in_order for cleaning your(sg) sins. 35 And don't(pl) leave from the entrance of the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days. And do(pl) what_ God _commanded me that he caused_ you(pl) _to_do in_order that you(pl) won't die. That's what_ the Lord _commanded me.” 36 Therefore, Aarun fulfilled and his children all that God commanded to Muwisis that caused_them_to_do.

Ka pegbunsud te me talagpanubad te trabahu ran

The starting of the sacrificers of their work

91 Te igkawalu e ne aldew, in-umew ni Muwisis si Aarun wey ka me anak din, wey ka me igbuyag te Israil. 2 Ne migkahiyan din si Aarun, “Kuwa ka te sabeka ne turu ne nati te baka wey lukesan ne karniru ne ware nabalbalangi, wey ipanubad nu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ka baka, para igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale, wey ka karniru, para te egtutungen ne igpanubad. 3 Ne pakua nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil te lukesan ne kambing eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale. Ne pakua nu man-e sikandan te baka wey nati te karniru ne nekeg-iling ne tigsabeka pad ne leg-un, wey ware nabalbalangi eyew egtutungen ne igpanubad. 4 Pakua nu degma sikandan te turu ne baka wey lukesan ne karniru ne igpanubad para te keupianan diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne pakua nu degma sikandan te egkakeen ne ighalad ne insewuhan te mentika, su kuntee ne aldew egpakita ka Manama kaniyu.”

91 On the eight day, Muwisis called Aarun and his children, and the elders of Israil. 2 And he told Aarun, “Get(sg) one bull calf without defect and male sheep, and sacrifice(sg) (them) to the Lord God. The bull, is for blood_shed that's removes sin, and the sheep, is for burnt sacrifice. 3 And cause_ the descendants of Israil _to_get a male goat in_order for blood_shedding that's removes sin. And cause_ them also _to_get a cow and young sheep both one year old yet, and no defect for burnt sacrifice. 4 And cause_ them also _to_get a bull cow and male sheep to_be_sacrificed for well-being there to the Lord God. And cause_ them also _to_get a food offering which is mixed with oil, because today is the day that God appear to you(pl).”

5 Sikan naa, ingkuwa ran ka me ayam ne ingkahi ni Muwisis wey in-uyan dan diye te tangkaan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Ne miglibulung ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 6 Ne migkahi si Muwisis kandan, “Insuhu kew te Magbebaye ne egpanubad eyew igpakita rin kaniyu ka karesen din.” 7 [xr]Ne migkahiyan ni Muwisis si Aarun, “Parani kad dutu te altar wey ipanubad nud ka igpalangesa eyew ig-awe te sale nu wey ka egtutungen ne igpanubad ne igpalangesa ne iglinis te sale nu. Ne sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye, ipanubad nu degma ka igpanubad te me etew wey palangeseyi nu sikandan eyew iglinis te me sale dan.”

5 So then, they took their domestic_animals that Muwisis said and they brought there at the front of the Tent of Meeting.
