And all the descendants of Israil gathered there to the front of the Lord. 6 And Muwisis said to them, “The Lord commanded you(pl) to sacrifice in_order that he will_show to you(pl) his glory.” 7 [xr]And Muwisis told Aarun, “Go_near(sg) there at the altar and sacrifice(sg) the blood_shed in_order to remove your(sg) sin and the burnt sacrifice to blood_shed to clean your(sg) sin. And according to God's command, sacrifice(sg) also the sacrifices of the people and offer_blood_sacrifice for them in_order to clean their sins.”

8 Purisu migparani e si Aarun te altar wey inggimatayan din ka turu ne nati te baka eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale din. 9 Ne ka langesa te baka, in-uyan te me anak din diye te kandin wey in-eled din ka kemel rin te langesa wey impulit din te me sungey-sungey te altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen. Ka nasame ne langesa, in-ule din diye te pabunsuranan te altar. 10 Piru intutung din diye te altar ka tabe, ka me iihian, wey ka atey ne nandeketan te tabe su sika ka insuhu te Magbebaye ki Muwisis. 11 Ne ka sapu wey ka laplap te baka, diye din tutunga te lihawangan te kampu.

8 Therefore Aarun drew_near to the altar and slaughtered the calf in_order to blood_shed that's removes his sin. 9 And the blood of the cow, (was) taken by his children to him and he dipped his finger in the blood and put_it_on there to the horns of the altar which is the burning_place for sacrifice. The remaining blood, he poured_out there in the base of the altar. 10 But he burnt the fats there at the altar, kidneys, and the liver which is attached with the fat because that's what_ the Lord _commanded to Muwisis. 11 And the flesh and skin of the cow, he burnt there outside the camp.

12 Nataman inggimatayan din e man-e ka ayam ne igpanubad ne egtutungen. Ne ka langesa te ayam, imbehey e te me anak din diye te kandin, wey insawig din langun seini diye te me kakiliran te altar. 13 Imbehey te me anak ni Aarun ka me ngalap ne impanggupal e diye te kandin lagkes ka ulu, wey intutung din e diye te altar. 14 Ne inlu-luan din ka langun ne tahu ne diye te getek wey ka me paa, wey intutung din e diye te altar duma te duma pad ne baad te ayam.

12 Afterwards he slaughtered also the domestic_animals which will_be_ a burnt _sacrifice. And the blood of the domestic_animal, was_given to him by his children, and he poured_out it all there at the sides of the altar. 13 His children gave the chopped meat there to him including the head, and he burned (them) on the altar. 14 And he washed all the contain there inside_the_stomach and the feet, and he burned (them) there on the altar with the other portions of the domestic_animal.

15 Pegkapenga dutu, in-uyan e ni Aarun ka igmanubad te keet-etawan. Inggun-aan din te egkuwa ka kambing ne igpalangesa eyew te peg-awe te sale te me etew. Ne inggimatayan din e seini wey impanubad din e iling te inggimu rin te pegpalangesa rin te ig-awe te sale din. 16 Nataman, in-uyan din e man-e ka igpanubad ne egtutungen, wey in-ikul din ka tulumanen ke egmenuwen seini te pegpanubad. 17 Ne in-uyan din degma diye te tangkaan ka egkakeen ne ighalad wey miggamak sikandin dutu wey intimul rin diye te igpanubad ne egtutungen te tagse maselem, wey intutung din e. 18 [xr]Inggilang degma ni Aarun ka turu ne baka wey ka lukesan ne karniru ne igpanubad para te keupianan te me etew. Ne imbehey kandin te me anak din ka langesa te baka wey inlingut din isawig diye te altar. 19 Ka tabe te turu ne baka wey te karniru, lagkes ka mallambu ne me ikug wey ka tabe ne migbukus diye te getek lagkes ka me iihian wey ka tabe ne migbukus te atey, 20 in-untud te me anak ni Aarun diye te me kumeng te me ayam. Ne intutung ni Aarun ka me tabe diye te altar. 21 Piru ka me kumeng wey ka kawanan ne bubun, ingkayew ni Aarun eyew igdasag diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkayawen su sika iya ka insuhu ki Muwisis.

15 After it, Aarun brought the sacrifices of the people. He took first the goat that's (for) blood_shed in_order to remove sin of the people. He slaughtered it and sacrifice it like what_ he _did for his blood_shedding to remove his sin. 16 Then, he brought also the (one for) burnt sacrifice, and he followed the ritual/regulation how to sacrifice it. 17 And he also brought there in the front the food offering and he took_a_handful of it (LIT there) and added (it) there on the burnt sacrifice for every morning, and he burned (them). 18 [xr]Aarun also slaughtered the male cow and the male sheep for sacrifice for well-being of the people. And the blood of the cow was_given to him by his children and splashed it around the altar. 19 The fats of the male cow and sheep, including the fat tail and the fat covering the stomach including the kidneys and the fat covering the liver, 20 were placed_over the breast of the domestic_animal by the children of Aarun. And Aarun burned the fats there at the altar. 21 But the breast and the right thigh, Aarun raised_ (them) _up in_order to offer to the Lord God as raised_up_offering because that's really what_commanded to Muwisis.

22 [xr]Ne ingkayew ni Aarun ka belad din diye te me etew wey impanalanginan din sikandan. Ne migpamaneug sikandin te pegkapenga rin te egpalangesa te ig-awe te sale, pegpanubad te egtutungen wey te pegpanubad para te keupianan. 23 Nataman, migseled si Muwisis wey si Aarun diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Te peglihawang dan e, impanalanginan dan ka me etew. Ne dutu, impakita te Manama ka katelesan din diye te langun ne etew. 24 Sahuhune ne miglepew ka hapuy ne migpuun te tangkaan te Magbebaye wey natutung ka impanubad ne egtutungen wey ka me tabe ne diye te altar. Te pegkakita te me etew dutu, migpanguleyi sikandan wey mig-usengul sikandan diye te tane te pegsimba te Manama.

22 [xr]And Aarun raised his hand on the people and he blessed them. And he stepped_down after his blood_shedding for removing sin, sacrificing of burnt_offering and sacrificing for well-being. 23 Afterwards, Muwisis and Aarun went_inside there at the Tent of Meeting. On their going_out, they blessed the people. And there, the God caused his glory to appeared there to all the people. 24 Suddenly the fire appeared from the front of the Lord and the sacrificed as burnt_offering and the fats there on the altar were burned. When the people saw it/that, they shouted and bowed_down there on the ground in worshiping God.

Ka sale ni Nadab wey ni Abihu

The sin of Nadab and Abihu

101 Nekey naa te due daruwa ne anak ni Aarun ne egngaranan ki Nadab wey Abihu. Migkuwa sikandan te tigsabeka ne tahuanan te insinsu[fn] wey intahuan dan seeye te baha wey inhalad diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne ka seeye ne baha, kene ne eleg ne eggamiten, su ware ma migsuhu ka Magbebaye kandan. 2 Sikan naa ka migpeuyan ka Magbebaye te hapuy wey natutung e sikandan, diye de sikandan nammatey te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 3 Ne migkahiyan ni Muwisis si Aarun, “Sika ka igpasabut te Magbebaye te pegkahi rin, ‘Seeye se egparani keddi, keilangan ne eg-ileen a ne matulus, wey keilangan ne egdayanen a diye te tangkaan te keet-etawan ku.’ ” Piru migpeeneng-eneng de si Aarun.

101 Now (LIT What then) there are two children of Aarun named Nadab and Abihu. They took one_each container of incense[fn] and they put embers on it and offered there to the Lord God. And those embers, are not correct to be used, because the Lord didn't command them_to_do_it. 2 That's why the Lord sent a fire and they were burned, they died there at the front of the Lord. 3 And Muwisis told Aarun, “That is what_ the Lord _meant in his saying, ‘Those who will_draw_near to me, must acknowledge me as holy, and must praise me there in front of my people.’ ” But Aarun was_ just _silent.

4 Ne in-umew ni Muwisis si Misil wey si Ilsapan ne me anak ni Usiil ne anggam ni Aarun, wey ingkahiyan din, “Awaa niyu ka nammatey ne me suled niyu due te tangkaan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey uyana niyu diye te lihawangan te kampu.” 5 Purisu, in-angey ran e ka me minatey wey diye dan de gen-geni te kumbale dan, wey in-uyan dan e diye te lihawangan te kampu sumale te insuhu ni Muwisis kandan.

4 And Muwisis called Misail and Ilsapan who were children of Usiil who was an uncle of Aarun, and was_told by him, “Remove(pl) your(pl) dead brothers there in front of the Tent of Meeting and bring(pl) them outside the camp.” 5 So_then, they took the corpses and they were_holding only at their cloths, and they brought (them) there outside the camp according to what_ Muwisis _commanded them.

6 Ne migkahiyan ni Muwisis si Aarun wey ka me anak din ne si Iliyasar wey si Itamar, “Kene kew lungku. Tapira niyu ka me bulbul niyu wey kene niyu gisia ka kumbale niyu eyew kene kew egpatey wey eyew kene egkabelu ka Magbebaye ne Manama te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Piru ka me karumaan niyu ne me kabuhalan langun ni Israil, egpakaramag mule te seeye se immannilaban te Manama. 7 Ne kene kew pa man-e lihawang te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Su emun ke eglihawang kew iya egpatey kew, su in-urdinaan kew e te Magbebaye ne me talagpanubad pinaahi te peg-itis kaniyu te lana.” Ne intuman dan ka insuhu ni Muwisis kandan.

6 And Muwisis told Aarun and his children who were Iliyasar and Itamar, “Don't(pl) grieve. Organize(pl) your(pl) hair and don't(pl) tear your(pl) cloths so_that you(pl) won't(pl) die and so_that the Lord God won't be angry to all descendants of Israil. But your(pl) relatives that's all descendants of Israil, will_weep to those who were burned by God. 7 And don't(pl) also go_out the Tent of Meeting. Because if you(pl) go_out indeed you(pl) will_die, because you(pl) ordained already by the Lord as sacrificers by_means_of pouring oil to you(pl).” And they fulfilled what_ Muwisis _commanded them.

Ka me tulumanen te me talagpanubad

The rituals/regulations of the sacrificers

8 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Aarun, 9 “Sikeykew wey ka me anak nu ne me lukes, kene egkaayun ne egseled te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan ke nekeinum te binu wey te minsan nekey ne inumen ne egpekewubug. Ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egpatey kew iya. Keilangan ne egtumanen niyu wey te me kabuhalan niyu ka sika ne tulumanen te ware egtamanan. 10 Ne keilangan ne eg-ileen niyu ke nekey ka matulus wey ka kene, wey ke nekey ka in-isip ne malinis wey ka in-isip ne malindit. 11 Ne panulua niyu ka duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil te langun ne me tulumanen ne impabehey ku kaniyu ki Muwisis.”

8 And Aarun was_told by the Lord God, 9 “You(sg) and your(sg) male children, are_ not _possible to get_inside the Tent of Meeting when drank with wine and any drink that can_get_(someone)_drunk. If you(pl) do that, you(pl) will_ really _die. You(pl) must fulfill this ritual/regulation and your(pl) descendants without ending. 10 And you(pl) must know/acknowledge what is holy and not, or what's considered clean and what's considered dirty. 11 And teach(pl) other descendants of Israil of all the rituals/regulaitons that I caused_ Muwisis _to_give to_you(pl).”

12 [xr]Migkahi si Muwisis ki Aarun wey te daruwa ne anak din ne nasame, ne si Iliyasar wey si Itamar, “Kua niyu ka egkakeen ne ighalad ne nasame te halad ne intutung. Hilutua niyu seini wey kene niyu tahui te patulin wey diye niyu re keena te lenged te altar, su amana ne matulus seini. 13 Keena niyu sika diye te lama ne in-isip ne matulus, su baad niyu iya sika puun te halad ne egtutungen ne para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Sika ka insuhu te Magbebaye keddi. 14 [xr]Piru ka kumeng ne ingkayew wey ka bubun ne impanubad e, egkakeen niyu te taltalaanak minsan hendei ne in-isip ne malinis. Su sika iya ka baad niyu puun te igpanubad para te keupianan te kabuhalan ni Israil. 15 Ka impanubad ne bubun, wey kumeng ne ingkayew, keilangan ne eg-uyanen dan duma te me tabe ne igpanubad ne egtutungen eyew igdasag te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne kaniyu ne baad sika te taltalaanak te ware egtamanan sumale te suhu te Magbebaye.”

12 [xr]Muwisis said to Aarun and his remaining two children, who were Iliyasar and Itamar, “Get(pl) the food offering which was left on the burnt offering. Cook(pl) it and don't(pl) put a leaven and you(pl) eat it only at/on the near of the altar, because this is very holy. 13 Eat(pl) that there at the yard that's considered holy, because that's your(pl) portion from burnt offering for the Lord God. That's what_ the Lord _commanded me. 14 [xr]But the breast that's raised_up and the thigh which is sacrificed already, can_be_eaten by you(pl) as family anywhere that's considered clean. Because that's really your(pl) portion from the sacrifice for well-being of the descendants of Israil. 15 The sacrificed that's thigh, and breast that raised_up, they must bring (them) together_with the fats for burnt offering in_order to offer_as_gift to the Lord God. And that's your(pl) portion as_family forever according to the command of the Lord.”

16 Ne hengkayi te mig-ugsi-ugsi e si Muwisis meyitenged te kambing ne igpanubad eyew te peg-awe te sale, wey te pegkanengnengi rin ne natutung bes e seeye, nabelu e sikandin ki Iliyasar wey ki Itamar. Purisu migkahi sikandin, 17 [xr]“Mania te ware niyu keena diye te lama te Matulus ne Balungbalung ka impalangesa ne ig-awe te sale? Amana ne matulus sika! Imbehey sika te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew te peg-awe te sale te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil wey eyew igpalangesa te peglinis te sale te me etew diye te Magbebaye. 18 Ne puun su ware neuyan diye te Matulus ne Sinabeng ka langesa, keilangan ne ingkeen niyud e perem ka kambing diye te Matulus ne Sinabeng sumale te insuhu ku kaniyu.”

16 And when Muwisis researched about the goat to_be_sacrificed in_order for removing sin, and when he knew that it was_burned already, he was angry with Iliyasar and Itamar. Therefore he said, 17 [xr]“Why didn't you(pl) eat the (animal that) is_bleed for that's remove sin there at the yard of the Holy Tent? That's very holy! That's given by the Lord God in_order for removing the sin of all descendants of Israil and in_order for cleaning the sins of the people there to the Lord. 18 And since the blood was not taken into the Holy Room, you(pl) must have eaten the goat there at the Holy Room according to my command to you(pl).”

19 Ne migtabak si Aarun ki Muwisis, “Ganna, migpalangesa ka daruwa ne anak ku te ig-awe te sale wey te egtutungen ne igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, piru nammatey red sikandan se daruwa. Na, egkabennalan bu red ka Magbebaye ke ingkeen ney ka impalangesa te ig-awe te sale te seini ne aldew?” 20 Nabennalan si Muwisis te pegkarineg din te tabak ni Aarun.

19 And Aarun answer Muwisis, “Earlier, my two children blood_shed that's remove sin and for burnt offering there to the Lord God, but the two of them died still. Na, will the Lord be_satisfied if/when we(excl) ate the blood_shed to remove sin this day?” 20 And Muwisis was convinced when he heard Aarun's answer.

Ka me ayam ne in-isip ne malinis wey malindit

The animals that were considered clean and dirty

(Diy 14:3‑21)

(Deu 14:3‑21)

111 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis wey si Aarun, 2 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil ne ka langun ne mananap kayi te tane, seini re ka egkaayun ne egkeenen: 3 ka minsan nekey ne ayam ne naperi se sulu wey egsepe-sepe ke egkeen. 4-6 Piru kene niyu keena ka kamil, ka rabit, wey ke ambew naa. Keilangan ne eg-isipen niyu sika ne malindit su minsan ke egsepe-sepe sika ne egkeen piru ware naperi ka sulu. 7 Ne ka mahintalunan ne babuy minsan ke naperi ka sulu piru kene egsepe-sepe ke egkeen, sikan naa ka isipa niyu seini ne malindit. 8 Kene kew en iya keen te ngalap te sika ne me mananap wey minsan te pegsamsam naan de te nammatey ne me lawa ran. Isipa niyu sika ne malindit.

111 And Muwisis and Aarun were_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that all animals here on earth, these (are) the ones possible to eat: 3 whatever domestic_animal with split hoof/claw and chews when eating. 4-6 But don't(pl) eat the camel, rabbit, or rat. You(pl) must consider that dirty because even if that's chewing eating but the hoof/claw is not split. 7 And the wild_pig even it the hoof/claw is split but won't chew if eats, therefore consider it dirty. 8 Don't(pl) really eat of the meat of those animals and even in just touching only of their dead bodies. Consider(pl) that dirty.

9 “Egkaayun ne egkeenen niyu ka langun ne me ngalap diye te dahat wey te weyig ne due piyapis wey engil. 10-12 Piru ka minsan nekey ne isda ne ware piyapis wey engil, kene niyu keena. Kene kew degma samsam te nammatey ne lawa ran wey isipa niyu ne malindit sika.

9 “It's_possible to eat all the meat/animals there to the sea and to the water that has fin and scales. 10-12 But whatever meat/animals of sea and water with no fin and scales, don't(pl) eat it. Don't(pl) also touch their dead bodies and consider(pl) that dirty.

13-19 “Seini ka me manuk-manuk ne kene egkaayun ne egkeenen su in-isip ne malindit: me banug, me uwak, me manuk-manuk ne egkeen te napatey ne etew wey ke ayam naa, me dakel ne manuk-manuk ne ustrits, me ekang, me manuk-manuk ne egpandagmang te ngalap diye te weyig, bayaku ne egngaranan te bangkiyud, me tandungan ne bayaku, wey kalapenit.

13-19 “These (are) the birds that not possible for you(pl) to eat because (those) are_considered dirty: eagles, crows, birds that eat dead person or animals, big chicken that are ustrits, owls, birds that snatch meat/animals on the water, water_birds, hormorants, and bats.

20 “Ka langun ne me uled-uled ne due pakpak wey due hep-at ne me paa, kene egkaayun ne egkeenen. Isipa niyu ne malindit sika. 21 Piru, due duma ne egkaayun ne egkeenen niyu, iling te me uled-uled ne due pakpak wey hep-at se me paa ne due mule lelenguan diye te elat-elat te paa wey bubun eyew egpekeum-umbetut dan. 22 Ne seini ka me uled-uled ne eglayang wey egdul-ug ne egkeenen niyu: me talangas, me tulung-tulung, dalen-ug, wey palahe. 23 Piru ka duma pad ne me uled-uled ne due pakpak wey hep-at se paa, isipa niyud ne malindit.

20 “All the insects with wings and have feet, it's_ not _possible to eat. Consider(pl) those dirty. 21 But, there are others that you(pl) can eat, like the insects with wings and have four feet that have joints there at the middle of feet and thigh in_order for them to jump. 22 And these (are) the insects that fly and crawl which you(pl) eat: locusts, crickets, mole_cricket, and grasshopper. 23 But the other insects that have wings and four feet, consider(pl) (them) dirty.

24-28 “Kene kew samsam te napatey ne ayam ne ware naperi se sulu wey kene egsepe ke egkeen. Kene kew man-e samsam te napatey ne ayam ne hep-at se paa ne due sulu ne igkalus. Isipa niyu sika ne malindit ne me ayam. Minsan hentew ne eggen-gen te napatey ne lawa, keilangan ne egpami-pi te insaluub din, piru eg-isipen ded sikandin ne malindit taman te egkasagkup.

24-28 “Don't(pl) touch a dead animal which the claw is not split and won't chew its food. Don't(pl) also touch a dead animal with four feet with claws. Consider(pl) it dirty. Whoever hold a dead body, must need to wash his clothing, but he will_be_considered dirty until the sun_sets.

29-31 “Ne isipa niyu ne malindit ka me mananap ne egpananap iling te palabasan, me ambew, tuku, palees, buaya, ibid, ammahal wey ambekang.[fn] Ka minsan hentew ne egsamsam te sika ne me mananap ke egpatey, eg-isipen ne malindit taman te egkasagkup. 32 Ne minsan nekey ne egkeuluhan te sika ne me mananap ke egpatey, eg-isipen degma ne malindit, minsan ka me kasangkapan ne kayu, kumbale, laplap te mananap, hinabel ne saku, wey ka minsan nekey ne kasangkapan. Keilangan ne ig-eled seini te weyig, piru eg-isipen ded man-e ne malindit seini taman te egkasagkup. Pegkapenga due, eg-isipen e ne malinis wey egkahamit e man-e. 33 Ne emun diye egkeulug te kuren ne tane ka lawa te napatey ne mananap ne egpananap, ka langun ne tahu kayi eg-isipen degma ne malindit, ne keilangan ne egpeseen e seini. 34 Ne ka minsan nekey ne egkakeen ne egkatihisan te weyig ne egpuun te sika ne kuren ne tane, eg-isipen ne malindit degma. Ne ka langun ne egkeinum ne weyig ne tahu te sika ne kuren ne tane, eg-isipen degma ne malindit. 35 Ne ka minsan nekey ne egkeuluhan te napatey ne mananap, eg-isipen ne malindit. Ke iyan egkeuluhan ka kuren wey ke sikan naa se hilutuanan, eg-isipen seini ne malindit wey keilangan ne egpeseen. 36 Piru ke iyan egkeuluhan ka belun wey ke sikan naa se inlimuran te weyig, kene sika eg-isipen ne malindit; piru ka minsan hentew ne eg-awe te napatey ne mananap, eg-isipen iya ne malindit. 37 Kene degma eg-isipen ne malindit ka minsan nekey ne beni ne egkeuluhan kayi. 38 Piru ke iyan egkeuluhan ka beni ne in-eled e te weyig, ka sika ne beni, eg-isipen e ne malindit.

29-31 “And consider(pl) dirty the animals that crawl like water_lizard, rats, gecko, land_lizard, crocodile, big_water_lizard, shiny dark lizard and chameleon.[fn] Whoever touches those animals when dying, will_be_considered dirty till the sun_sets. 32 Whatever_things that will_be_fallen_onto by those animals when dying, will_be_considered dirty, even the wooden materials, cloth, skin of animal, weave_sack, and whatever materials. This must be_dipped into the water, but this be_considered dirty till the sun_sets. After that, (it) will_be_considered clean and will_be_used again. 33 And if the dead body of the animal that crawls falls to the earthen pot, all the contains of it will_be_considered dirty also, and this must be broke. 34 And whatever food that the water of that earthen pot will_dripped_into, will_be_considered dirty also. And all the drinking water that contains that earthen pot, will_be_considered dirty also. 35 And whatever_things that the dead animal falls into, will_be_considered dirty. If it falls to the pot or its cooking_place, it will_be_considered dirty and must be broke. 36 But if what_being_fallen_into is the well or something_where_water_collected, that won't be_considered dirty; but whoever that removes the dead animal, will_be_considered dirty. 37 Whatever seeds that it will_be_fallen_into won't be_considered dirty also. 38 But if what_is_fallen_into is the seed dipped in water, that seed, will_be_considered dirty.

39 “Ke egkapatey ka minsan nekey ne mananap ne egkakeen, eg-isipen ne malindit ka egpakasamsam kayi taman te egkasagkup. 40 Ne ka minsan hentew ne egkuwa wey ke egkeen naa kayi, keilangan ne egpi-pian din ka insaluub din, piru eg-isipen ded sikandin ne malindit taman te egkasagkup.

39 “If whatever animal that can_be_eaten dies, the one touches it will_be_considered dirty until the sun_sets. 40 And whoever takes and eats it, (s/he) must wash his/her clothing, but s/he will_be_considered dirty still until the sun_sets.

41 “Kene niyu keena ka langun ne mananap ne egdul-ug te tane, su in-isip ne malindit sika. 42 Kene kew man-e keen te egdul-ug wey ke egpananap naa ne mananap ne hep-at se paa wey subla pad, su in-isip ne malindit sika. 43 Ne kene niyu linditi ka pegkeetew niyu. Keilangan ne kene kew egmalindit tenged te me mananap ne in-isip ne malindit. 44 [xr]Su sikeddi ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Keilangan ne egmatulusen niyu ka pegkeetew niyu, su matulus e ma. Purisu kene niyu linditi ka pegkeetew niyu te minsan nekey ne mananap ne egdul-ug te tane. 45 Su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ka impaawe kaniyu puun te Ihiptu eyew egkeyimu a ne Manama niyu. Purisu matulusa niyu ka pegkeetew niyu, su matulus e ma.”

41 “Don't(pl) eat all the animals that crawl_on_belly on the soil/ground, because those are_considered dirty. 42 Don't(pl) eat also the animal that creeps and crawls with four or more feet, because that's considered dirty. 43 Don't(pl) dirty yourselves. You(pl) must not be_dirty due to the animals that are_considered dirty. 44 [xr]Because I (am) the Lord your(pl) God. You(pl) must make_ yourselves _holy, because I (am) holy. Therefore don't(pl) make_ yourselves _dirty with whatever animals that crawl_on_belly on the ground. 45 Because I (am) the Lord God who caused_ you(pl) _to_leave from Ihiptu in_order that I will_become your(pl) God. Therefore make_ yourselves _holy, because I (am) holy indeed.”

46 Sika ka me tulumanen meyitenged te me mananap wey me manuk-manuk wey te langun ne me mananap ne diye te weyig wey diye te tane, 47 eyew egkeila niyu ka in-isip ne malindit wey malinis, ka mananap ne egkaayun ne egkeenen wey ka kene egkaayun ne egkeenen.

46 That were the rituals/regulations about animals and bird and all the animals there in the water and ground/soil, 47 in_order that you(pl) recognize what_is_considered dirty and clean, an animal that's possible to eat and the one not possible to eat.

Ka peglinis te malitan ne miglesutan

The cleaning of the woman who gave_birth

121 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil, te emun ke due eg-anak te lukes, eg-isipen ka malitan ne malindit taman te pitu ne aldew iling te malitan ne eglangeseen. 3 [xr]Ne keilangan ne egtulian[fn] ka bate te igkawalu e ne aldew. 4 Pegkapenga kayi, egtetahad pad man-e ka mig-anak te tatelu ne pulu wey tatelu (33) ne aldew human pad eg-isipa sikandin ne malinis. Te kene pad egkapenga ka peglinis kandin, keilangan ne kene pad egsamsam sikandin te minsan nekey ne matulus ne kasangkapan wey kene pad egseled diye te Balungbalung.

121 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil, that if there's a woman_giving_birth to a boy, the woman will_be_considered dirty until seven days like a woman who is bleeding. 3 [xr]And the baby must be circumcised[fn] on the eighth day. 4 After that, the one_who_gave_birth will_wait for thirty-three (33) days before she will_be_considered clean. Before the cleaning of her finishes, she must not touch whatever holy materials and should not enter there at the Tent.

5 “Piru ke malitan ka ig-anak din, eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit te daruwa ne simana iling te malitan ne eglangeseen. Keilangan ne egtetahad pad man-e sikandin te hen-em ne pulu wey hen-em (66) ne aldew human eg-isipa sikandin ne malinis.

5 “But if she gives_birth to a girl, she will_be_considered dirty in two weeks like a woman who is bleeding. She must wait for sixty-six (66) days before she's considered dirty.

6 “Ke egkapenge e ka aldew te peglinis te mig-anak te lukes wey ke malitan naa—eg-uyan sikandin te nati te karniru ne sabeka pad ne leg-un diye te talagpanubad ne diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. Igpanubad din seini ne egtutungen ne eglagkesan te tukmu wey ke seleppati naa ne igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale. 7 Ne igmanubad seini te talagpanubad diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey igpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale wey egmalinis e sikandin ka inlangesa te mig-anak. Sika ka tulumanen te peglinis te malitan ne mig-anak.

6 “When/If the day for cleaning of the one_who_gave_birth to boy or girl—she will_bring a one year old sheep to the sacrificer there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. He will_burn it as burnt_offering includ_with spotted_dove or dove that's (for) blood_shed that's remove sin. 7 The sacrificer will_sacrifice it there at the front of the Lord God and do blood_shedding in_order to clean a sin and she will be clean who menstruated from_giving_birth. That's the ritual/regulation for cleaning the woman who gives_birth.

8 [xr]“Piru ke ware nati te karniru ne igpakabehey rin, eg-uyan naan de sikandin te daruwa ne tukmu wey ke daruwa naa ne seleppati; ka sabeka egtutungen ne igpanubad wey ka sabeka, iglinis te sale. Ne egpalangesaan te talagpanubad ka malitan eyew iglinis te sale din wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis.”

8 [xr]“But if there_is_no lamb that she can give, she will_ only _bring two spotted_doves or two doves; one will_be_burned sacrifice and the other, for blood_shed that's remove sin. The sacrificer spill_blood for the woman in_order for cleaning her sin and she will_be_considered clean.”

Ka me tulumanen meyitenged te dalu te laplap

The rituals/regulations concerning skin disease

131 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis wey si Aarun, 2 “Ke due etew ne due miglebag diye te laplap din, wey ke miglambetug naa wey ke migkekehang naa, ne hendue te egkeyimu ne ibung, keilangan ne eg-uyanen sikandin diye te talagpanubad ne si Aarun wey ke diye naa te sabeka te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan din. 3 Ne egpitawen te talagpanubad ka migbubusuwak. Ne emun ke migmaangkag e ka me bulbul diye te intubuan te busuwak, wey mig-ugseb e seini diye te sapu, ibung naa sika. Ne igpanengneng din e seini wey eg-isipen e ne malindit ka ibungen. 4 Piru ke migbubusuwak ka laplap din wey ware ded mig-ugseb ka miglebag diye te sapu wey ware migmaangkag ka bulbul dutu, igpasuwey te talagpanubad sikandin igpeugpe te pitu ne aldew. 5 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, egpitawen e man-e te talagpanubad ka miglebag. Ne emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware seini migdalapdap, igpasuwey pad man-e sikandin igpeugpe te talagpanubad puun te me etew te pitu e man-e ne aldew. 6 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, egpitawen e man-e sikandin te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke migkiles e wey ware migdalapdap ka miglebag, igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e ne malinis ka seeye ne etew su me busuwak de seini. Keilangan ne egpi-pian e te etew ka insaluub din, wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis. 7 Piru ke egdalapdap ka migbubusuwak diye te laplap din, keilangan ne egpapitew pad man-e sikandin te talagpanubad minsan ke nakapanengneng e sikandin ne malinis e. 8 Ne egpitawen e man-e sikandin te talagpanubad. Ne emun malehet ne migdalapdap ka migbubusuwak, igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne due ibung din wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malindit.

131 And Muwisis and Aarun were_told by the Lord God, 2 “If there's a person and has something_swelling on his skin, or lump_raising_up or skin sore, and seems becoming a leprosy, s/he must be brought to the sacrificer Aarun or there at one of the sacrificers who (are) his descendants. 3 And the sacrificer will_check the skin_with_sore. And if the hair on the skin_with_sore became_white, and it penetrates there at the flesh, that's leprosy. And he will_make_ it _known and the leper will_be_considered dirty. 4 But if his skin has_a_pussy and the lump_raising_up didn't penetrate there in the flesh and the hair there didn't turn_white, the sacrificer will_separate_ him to live _from_others for seven days. 5 On the seventh day, the sacrificer will_look at the lump_raising_up again. And if the sacrificer will_see that it didn't spread_over, the sacrificer will_separate him again to_live from the people for another seven days. 6 On the seventh day, the sacrificer will_look/check him again. And if the swelling withered and didn't spread_over, the sacrificer will_make_ that person _known to be_considered clean because it's only sore. The person must wash his clothing, and he will_be_considered clean. 7 But if the sore will_spread_over there at his skin, he must cause_to_be_check again by the sacrificer even if he was_made_known clean already. 8 And the sacrificer will_look/check him again. And if it's true that the lump_raising_up spread_over, the sacrificer make_(it)_known that he has leprosy and he will_be_considered dirty.

9 “Ke due etew ne due dalu te laplap ne hendue te ibung, keilangan ne eg-uyanen sikandin diye te talagpanubad. 10 Ne emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne due migbubusuwak diye te miglebag ne iyan egpuunan ne migmaangkag ka me bulbul, wey egkakite e ka sapu, 11 ibung naa sika ne naluhey e diye te kandin. Ne igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne due ibung din wey eg-isipen e ka sika ne etew ne malindit. Kenad igpasuwey sikandin, su natuenan e ne eg-isipen iya sikandin ne malindit. 12 Piru emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne migdalapdap e amana ka dalu te laplap diye te intiru ne lawa te etew—puun te ulu peendiye te paa, 13 keilangan ne eg-abayan egpitawa eg-ay-ayaran te talagpanubad. Ne emun malehet ne migdalapdap e amana ka dalu te laplap din wey migbubusuwak e ka langun ne laplap din, igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis su busuwak de.[fn] 14 Piru ke egkakita ne migleput e ka sapu din, eg-isipen e sikandin ne malindit. 15 Piru ke pegpitew te talagpanubad ne migleput ka sapu, igpanengneng din e ne eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit su due dalu rin ne malindit su migleput ka sapu ne iyan palinneu te ibung ne dalu. 16 Piru ke egkabalbalawan e ka pali wey migmaangkag e, keilangan ne egpapitew man-e sikandin te talagpanubad. 17 Ne eg-abayan e man-e sikandin te egpitew te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke migmaangkag e ka pali, igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis.

9 “If there's a person that has a skin disease similar to leprosy, he must be_taken to the sacrificer. 10 And if the sacrificer will_see that the lump_raising_up has_a_pussy which causes the hair to turn_white, and the flesh could be seen, 11 that's indeed a leprosy that's been with him for long_time already. And the sacrificer make_(it)_known that he has leprosy and that person will_be_considered dirty. He won't be caused_to_live_separately, because it's known that he should be_considered dirty. 12 But if the sacrificer will_see that the skin disease spread_over there in the entire body of the person—from the head towards_there to foot, 13 the sacrificer must check it again carefully. And if it's true that the skin disease spread much and all the skin having_a_pussy already, the sacrificer make_it_known that he will_be_considered clean because it's only sore.[fn] 14 But if the flesh is seen protruding_out, he will_be_considered dirty. 15 But if the sacrificer sees that the flesh is protruding_out, he will_make_ him _known to be_considered dirty because he has a dirty disease because the flesh protrudes_out which is the sign of leprosy disease. 16 But if the pussy is renewed and turned_white, he must be_checked again by the sacrificer. 17 The sacrificer will_check him again. And if the wound_part turned_white, the sacrificer will_make_it_known that he will_be_considered clean.

18 “Ke due etew ne due buu ne neulian e, 19 wey miglebag e seini wey ke migbubusuwak naa, keilangan ne igpapitew rin seini diye te talagpanubad. 20 Ne keilangan ne egpitawen seini te talagpanubad. Ke egkakita rin ne mig-ugseb e seini diye te sapu wey migmaangkag e ka bulbul, igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen ne malindit ne etew sikandin su due ibung din ne migbubusuwak. 21 Piru ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware mig-ugseb diye te sapu wey ware degma migmemaangkag ka bulbul te intubuan, ne bayew e neuli, igpasuwey sikandin te talagpanubad puun te me etew te pitu ne aldew. 22 Ne emun ke migdalapdap seini diye te laplap din, igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne due dalu rin wey eg-isipen e ne malindit; su sika ka palinneu ne due dalu rin ne makaaldek-haldek. 23 Piru ke ware seini migdalapdap, wey migbebateg de ka intubuan te buu, keilangan ne igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen sikandin ne malinis.

18 “If there's a person with a boil and healed already, 19 and it's swelling or sore, he must show it to the sacrificer. 20 And the sacrificer must look/check it. If he sees that it penetrates there in the flesh and the hair turned_white, the sacrificer make_it_known that he is a dirty person because he has leprosy that's having_a_pusyXXX. 21 But if the sacrificer will_see that (it) didn't penetrate there in the flesh and the hair on the spot_of_a_sprouting_boil also didn't turn_white, and it heals initially, the sacrifice cause_ him _to_live_away from the people for seven days. 22 And if it spread_over on his skin, the sacrificer makes_ him _known that he has a disease and be_considered dirty; because that's the sign that he has a terrifying disease. 23 But it didn't spread_over, and the spot of the boil made_a_scar only, the sacrificer must make_it_known that he will_be_considered clean.

24 “Ne emun due etew ne natutung ka laplap wey migmalalab e ka sapu wey ke migbubusuwak naa, 25 keilangan ne igpapitew seini te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke mig-ugseb seini diye te sapu wey migmaangkag e ka me bulbul, ibung naa sika ne diye migtubu te natutung ne laplap. Ne igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malindit su due dalu rin ne ibung. 26 Piru emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware seini mig-ugseb diye te sapu wey ware migmemaangkag ka me bulbul te natutung ne laplap wey bayew e neulii, igsuwey sikandin te talagpanubad puun te me etew te pitu ne aldew. 27 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, eg-abayan e man-e sikandin egpitawa te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke migdalapdap e ka migbubusuwak diye te laplap din, igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne due ibung din wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malindit su duen e ibung din. 28 Piru ke ware migdalapdap wey ke migkiles e seini, miglebag de ka natutung ne laplap. Ne igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis su migbebateg de ka natutung.

24 “And if there's a person with a burned skin and the burned_spot turned_red or having_a_pusyXXX, 25 it must shown to the sacrificer. And if it's penetrate there in the flesh and the hair turned_white, that is leprosy that grew at the burned skin. And the sacrificer make_it_known that he will_be_considered dirty because he has a leprosy disease. 26 But if the sacrificer will_see that it didn't penetrate there to the flesh and the hair on the burned skin didn't turn_white and it heals initially, he will_be_caused_ by the sacrificer _to_separate from the people for seven days. 27 On the seventh day, he will_be_checked by the sacrificer again. And if the sore spread_over on his skin, the sacrificer make_it_known that he has leprosy and he will_be_considered dirty because he has leprosy already. 28 But if it didn't spread_over or withered already, the burned skin is swelling only. And the sacrificer make_it_known that he will_be_considered clean.

29 “Ke due lukes wey ke malitan naa ne due migtubu ne dalu te laplap diye te ulu wey ke diye naa te bake, 30 keilangan ne igpapitew rin seini te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke mig-ugseb e seini diye te sapu wey migmakalawag e ka bulbul rin wey migmahalat e, igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen ka sika ne etew ne malindit su due ibung ne migtubu diye te ulu rin wey ke bake din naa. 31 Ne emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware mig-ugseb diye te sapu ka migtubu ne dalu te laplap wey warad meitem ne bulbul wey ke sumpe naa, igpasuwey te talagpanubad ka etew ne due migtubu ne dalu te laplap te pitu ne aldew. 32 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, egpitawen e man-e te talagpanubad ka migtubu ne dalu te laplap. Ne emun ke ware seini migdalapdap wey ware migmakalawag ka bulbul wey ke ka sumpe naa, wey ware man-e seini mig-ugseb te sapu, 33 eg-eabulug sikandin wey ke egpanumpe naa piru kene din iglagkes ka intubuan te dalu te laplap. Ne iglein sikandin te talagpanubad te pitu e man-e ne aldew. 34 Te igkapitu e man-e ne aldew, egpitawen e man-e te talagpanubad ka migtubu ne dalu te laplap. Ne emun ke ware seini migdalapdap wey ware mig-ugseb te sapu, igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis. Ne egpi-pian din ka insaluub din, wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis. 35 Piru ke migdalapdap ka migtubu ne dalu te laplap din minsan impakapanengneng e sikandin ne malinis, 36 egpitawen sikandin eg-abayi te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke malehet ne migdalapdap ka kehang diye te laplap din, eg-isipen e sikandin ne malindit. Kenad keilangan ne egpamitew pad ka talagpanubad te bulbul ne egmakalawag. 37 Piru emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware migdalapdap ka migtubu ne dalu te laplap, wey migtubu e ka meupiya ne bulbul rin wey ke sumpe din naa, neulian naan e seini. Ne igpanengneng e te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis.

29 “If there's a man or a woman that has disease sprouted on the skin there on the head or there on the jaw, 30 s/he must show it to the sacrificer. And if it penetrates already there in the flesh and his hair turned_yellow already and thin already, the sacrificer make_it_known that that person will_be_considered dirty because there's a leprosy that grew on his/her head or his/her jaw. 31 And if the sacrificer sees the disease that sprouted on the skin didn't penetrate there in the flesh and no_more black hair or beard, the sacrificer cause_ the person who has a sore _to_be_separated for seven days. 32 On the seventh day, the sacrificer will_check again the disease that sprouted on the skin. And if it didn't spread_over and the hair didn't turn_yellow or the beard, and it didn't penetrate in the flesh, 33 s/he will_be_bald or shave_the_beard but s/he won't include the part that has disease sprouted on the skin. And s/he will_be_separated by the sacrificer for seven days. 34 On the seventh day again, his sore will_be_checked by the sacrificer again. And if it didn't spread_over and didn't penetrate in the flesh, the sacrificer make_it_known that s/he will_be_considered clean. And s/he will_wash his clothing, and s/he will_be_considered clean. 35 But if the sore spread_over there on his skin even if he's made_known clean, 36 s/he will_be_checked by the sacrificer again. And if it's true that her/his sore spread_over there on her/his skin, s/he will_be_considered dirty. The sacrificer must not look of the hair that's yellowish any_more. 37 But if the sacrificer sees that the sore didn't spread_over, and his/her good hair grew already or his/her beard, it's healed already. And the sacrificer make_it_known that s/he will_be_considered clean.

38 “Ke due lukes wey ke malitan naa ne due pamuti diye te laplap din, 39 keilangan ne igpapitew rin seini diye te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke kenad egkamelmelehan ka pamuti, me kaliskis de seini ne miglepew. Eg-isipen ka sika ne etew ne malinis.

38 “If there's a man or woman who has white_spots on her/his skin, 39 s/he must show it to the sacrificer. And if the white_spots will_ no_longer _be_seen_clearly, it's only rashes that showed_up. That person will_be_considered clean.

40 “Ke egkaluluwan ka bulbul te sabeka ne lukes wey egkeupew e sikandin, eg-isipen ded sikandin ne malinis. 41 Ke egkaluluwan ka panabas din, eg-isipen ded man-e sikandin ne malinis. 42 Piru ke due egmalalab ne egbubusuwak diye te naluluwan ne ulu rin, ibung naa seini ne migtubu diye. 43 Ne keilangan ne egpitawen sikandin te talagpanubad, ne emun ke egmalalab wey egmaangkag iling te ibung ka migbubusuwak diye te ulu rin, 44 ibung naa iya sika. Keilangan ne igpanengneng te talagpanubad ne eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit su due dalu te laplap ne migtubu diye te ulu rin.

40 “If the hair of the man falls_off and he becomes_bald already, he will_ still _be_considered clean. 41 If the hair on her/his forehead side falls_off, he will_ still _be_considered clean. 42 But if there's something_red pussy there on her/his bald head, it's leprosy that sprouted there. 43 And s/he must be checked by the sacrificer, and if the spot_with_pussy on his/her head turns_red or turns_white like a leprosy, 44 that's really a leprosy. The sacrificer must make_it_known that s/he will_be_considered dirty because there_is disease that sprouted on his/her head.

45 “Ne ka ibungen ne etew, keilangan ne egsaluub te nahisi ne kumbale wey kene egpanugkad wey egdingdingan din ka be-be din, wey egpanguleyi sikandin ne egkahi, ‘Malindit a! Malindit a!’ 46 Eg-isipen sikandin ne malindit taman te kene pad egkeulian ka dalu rin. Ne keilangan ne egsuwey-suwey sikandin wey diye sikandin eg-ugpe te lihawangan te kampu.

45 “And the leper person, must wear a tore cloth and won't comb_the_hair and he will_cover his mouth, and he'll shout saying, ‘Consider me dirty! Consider me dirty!’ 46 He will_be_considered dirty until his disease won't heal. And he must separate_ himself _from_others and he lives there outside the camp.

Ka balaud meyitenged te abungew

The law concerning molds

47 “Ke due abungew diye te kumbale[fn] wey ke diye naa te hinabel 48 ne inhabel puun te minsan nekey, puun te bulbul te ayam, wey ke diye naa te laplap te ayam, wey ke diye naa te minsan nekey ne inggimu puun te laplap te ayam, 49 ne migmeilem-ilem naa wey ke miglahem naa, abungew seini ne migdalapdap, wey keilangan ne igpapitew seini diye te talagpanubad. 50 Ne keilangan ne egpitawen te talagpanubad ka in-abungew, wey iglein din igtahu seini te pitu ne aldew. 51 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, eg-abayan seini egpitawa te talagpanubad. Ne emun ke migdalapdap ka abungew diye te hinabel, diye te inhabel puun te minsan nekey, wey ke diye naa te laplap te ayam, malehet naa seini ne abungew ne egpakarereet wey eg-isipen sika ne malindit. 52 Ne keilangan ne egtutungen te talagpanubad ka manggad, wey ke seeye naa se inhabel puun te minsan nekey, wey ke seeye naa se egpuun te bulbul te ayam, wey ke seeye naa se hinabel, wey ke seeye naa se minsan nekey ne inggimu puun te laplap te ayam, su abungew seini ne egpakarereet.

47 “If there's a molds there at the cloth[fn] or there at the cloth 48 that's woven from whatever, from the wool of the animal, or in the skin of domestic_animal, or in the whatever made from the skin of domestic_animal, 49 which appeared_green/blue or appeared_dark_in_color, it's a molds that spreading, and this must be shown to the sacrificer. 50 And the sacrificer must check the thing_with_molds, and put_ it _separately for seven days. 51 On the seventh day, the sacrificer will_check it again. And if the molds spread_over there on the cloth, on the woven from whatever, or on the skin of domestic_animal, it's real molds that can destroy and that's considered dirty. 52 The sacrificer must burn the cloth, or that woven from whatever, or that from the wool of the domestic_animal, or that cloth, or that whatever made from the skin of domestic_animal, because this is mould that can_destroy (anything).

53 “Piru emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne ware migdalapdap ka abungew te minsan nekey ne kumbale, 54 egpapi-pian din ka minsan nekey ne in-abungew wey iglein igtahu seini seled te pitu e man-e ne aldew. 55 Egkataman, eg-abayan seini egpitawa te talagpanubad. Ke migmeilem ded wey miglahem ded ka manggad minsan napi-pian e, eg-isipen ne malindit seini minsan ke ware migdalapdap ka abungew. Sikan naa, keilangan ne egtutungen e seini minsan ke iyan de in-abungew ka diye te tangkaan wey ke diye naa te peka. 56 Piru emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne kenad e egkamelmelehan ka abungew, te napengaan e te egpi-pi ka manggad, egbindasen din ka in-abungawan diye te manggad wey ke diye naa te laplap te ayam, wey ke diye naa te inhabel puun te minsan nekey. 57 Piru ke eglibed ded wey egdalapdap ded ka abungew diye te kumbale, wey ke diye naa te inhabel puun te minsan nekey, wey ke diye naa te laplap te ayam, keilangan ne egtutungen e seini. 58 Piru ke naawe e ka abungew diye te manggad, wey ke diye naa te inhabel puun te minsan nekey, wey ke diye naa te laplap te ayam, te napi-pian e ka manggad, egpi-pian pad man-e eg-abayi seini, wey eg-isipen e seini ne malinis.”

53 “But if the sacrificer sees that the molds didn't spread_over to whatever clothing, 54 s/he will_wash whatever_things that has_molds_on_it and put_it_separately in another seven days again. 55 Afterwards, the sacrificer will_check it again. If it's still the cloth turning_green and turning_dark_in_color even if it's washed already, this will_be_considered dirty even if the molds didn't spread_over. So then, this must be burned even if only the front_side or the back_side has_the_molds. 56 But if the sacrificer sees the molds won't be_seen_clearly, after the cloth was washed, he will_tear_out the part_with_molds of the cloth or skin of domestic_animal, or woven from whatever. 57 But if the molds return and spread still there on the cloth, or there on the woven from whatever, or there in the skin of the domestic_animal, this must be burned. 58 But if the molds was_removed there in the cloth, or there on the woven from whatever, or there in the skin of domestic_animal, when the cloth was washed, this must be washed again, and this will_be_considered clean.”

59 Sika iya ka tulumanen meyitenged te abungew diye te kumbale eyew egkanengnengan ke eg-isipen ne malinis wey ke malindit naa ka minsan nekey ne hinabel ne inggimu puun te bulbul te ayam, wey ke hinabel naa, wey ke inhabel naa puun te minsan nekey, wey ke ka minsan nekey ne inggimu puun te laplap te ayam.

59 That's indeed the ritual/regulation about molds there in garment in_order to know whether to consider dirty or clean whatever cloths made from wool of domestic_animal, or cloth, or woven from whatever, or whatever made from skin of domestic_animal.

Ka tulumanen te peglinis te ibungen

The ritual/regulation for cleaning a leper

141 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 [xr]“Seini ka me tulumanen te peglinis te etew ne neulian te ibung. Te aldew te peglinis kandin, igpapitew sikandin diye te talagpanubad. 3 Ne eglihawang diye te kampu ka talagpanubad eyew te pegpitew kandin. Ne emun ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne neulian en iya ka etew, 4 egpaangayen sikandin te seini: daruwa ne manuk-manuk ne neuyag pad wey in-isip ne malinis, sabeka ne sugpang te kayu ne sidar, malalab-lalab ne hiket, wey derewunen ne isupu. 5 Egkataman, igpahilang te talagpanubad ka sabeka ne manuk-manuk diye te ampew te kuren ne tane ne inweyihan te egpuun te sebseb. 6 Ne egbalakesen te talagpanubad te eggen-gen ka neuyag pad ne manuk-manuk, ka sugpang te kayu ne sidar, ka malalab-lalab ne hiket, wey ka derewunen ne isupu, wey ig-eled din seini diye te langesa te manuk-manuk ne nakaampew te weyig diye te kuren. 7 Ne egpabesikan din te langesa te kapapitu ka etew ne eglinisan. Pegkapenga kayi, igpanengneng din e ka etew ne malinis e, wey eglekaan din e ka sabeka ne manuk-manuk. 8 Ne egpi-pian te etew ka insaluub din wey egkahisen din ka langun ne bulbul rin, wey egpamanihus sikandin. Ne puun due, eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis wey egpakaseled e diye te kampu, piru diye pad sikandin eg-uugpe te lihawangan te Balungbalung din te pitu ne aldew. 9 Emun ke egpitu e ne aldew, eg-abayan din e man-e te egkahis ka langun ne bulbul rin, ka sumpe din, wey kiley rin. Egpi-pian din man-e ka insaluub din wey egpamanihus man-e sikandin, wey egmalinis e man-e sikandin.

141 And Muwisis was_told again by the Lord God, 2 [xr]“These (are) the rituals/regulations for cleaning a person healed already with leprosy. On the day of his cleaning, he will_be_shown to the sacrificer. 3 And the sacrificer will_go_out in the camp in_order check him. And if the sacrificer sees that the person is indeed healed, 4 he's asked_to_get of this: two living birds and considered clean, one branch of cedar tree/wood, red tying_cord, and leafy isupu. 5 Afterwards, the sacrificer will_cause_ the one bird _to_be_slaughtered there on_top of the earthen pot watered_in with something_from the spring. 6 And the sacrificer hold_together the living bird, the branch of cedar tree/wood, the red tying_cord, and the branch of isupu, and he will_dip into the blood of the bird that's on the top of the water there on the pot. 7 And he splashes the person to_be_cleaned with blood seven_times. After that, he will_make_known the person clean, and he will_let_ one bird _go. 8 And the person washes his clothing and shave_off all his hair, and he will_bathe. And due to that, he will_be_considered clean and be_able_to_enter there in the camp, but can't live there in his tent for seven days. 9 If it takes_seven days already, his hair, beard, and his eyebrow(s) will_be_shaved_off again. He will_wash his clothing again, and he will_bathe again.

10 “Te igkawalu e ne aldew, keilangan ne eg-uyan sikandin te daruwa ne lukesan ne nati te karniru, wey sabeka ne beyan ne nati te karniru ne sabeka ne leg-un pad wey ware nabalbalangi. Eg-uyan man-e sikandin te tatelu ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika, wey senge-ubab man-e ne mentika. 11 Ne ka talagpanubad ne egpanengneng te malinis e ka etew, iyan eg-uyan te sika ne etew duma te langun ne igpanubad diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 12 Egkataman, egkuen te talagpanubad ka sabeka ne lukesan ne karniru wey ka senge-ubab ne mentika, wey igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale. Ne igkayew rin seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew igdasag ne egkayawen. 13 Ne eggilangen din ka nati te karniru diye te gilanganan ne in-isip ne matulus ne eggilangan te ig-awe te sale wey te egtutungen ne igpanubad. Amana red degma ne matulus ka igpanubad ne igbayad te sale iling te igpanubad ne iglinis te sale, wey iyan egpakakamuney ka talagpanubad. 14 Egkataman, egkuwa ka talagpanubad te langesa te karniru ne igpanubad wey egpulitan din ka sesel-ayan te igkakawanan ne talinga te etew ne eglinisan, wey iglagkes degma ka timbebakal te kawanan ne belad wey paa te etew. 15 Egkuwa degma ka talagpanubad te mentika ne diye te ubab wey ig-itis din diye te gibang ne palad din, 16 ig-eled din dutu ka kemel te igkakawanan ne belad din, wey igpatihis din e seini te kapapitu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 17 Ne ka same te mentika ne diye te palad din, ig-ampew rin igpulit diye te langesa ne impulit din diye te sesel-ayan te igkakawanan ne talinga te etew ne eglinisan, wey iglagkes din degma ka timbebakal te kawanan ne belad wey paa te etew. 18 Ne ka langun ne nasame te mentika ne diye te palad te talagpanubad, igpulit din diye te ulu te etew ne eglinisan. Ne egpalangesaan sikandin te talagpanubad eyew iglinis te sale din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

10 “On the eighth day, he needs to bring two male lambs, and one female sheep which is one year old yet and no defect. He will_bring also three kilograms of very good flour mixed with oil, and also one cup of oil. 11 And the sacrificer who makes_known that the person is clean already, is the one to bring that person together_with all that will_be_sacrificed there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. 12 Afterwards, the sacrificer takes one male lamb and one cup of oil, and be_sacrificed in_order to pay for sin. And he will_raise it to the front of the Lord God in_order to offer as raised_up_offering. 13 And he will_slaughter the sheep there on yard which is a slaughtering_place of blood_shed that's remove sin and for burnt sacrifices. The sacrifice for payment of sin is also very holy like the sacrifice for cleaning sin, and the one who_owns_it (will be) the sacrificer. 14 Afterwards, the sacrificer will_take a blood of the sacrificed sheep and put_some on the earlobe of the right ear of the person being clean, and including the thumbs of the right hand and foot of the person. 15 The sacrificer will_ also _get oil from the cup and pour_it there on his left palm, 16 he will_dip the finger of his right hand on_it, and cause_ it _to_drip seven_times on the front of the Lord God. 17 The remainder of the oil on his palm, he will_put on top of the blood that he put_on the earlobe of the right ear of a person that would_be_cleaned, and he includes also the thumbs of the right hand and foot of a person. 18 And all the remainder of oil there on the palm of the sacrificer, he will_put_on the head of the person being cleaned. And the sacrificer will_spill_blood for him in_order for cleaning of his sin on the front of the Lord God.

19 “Ne igpanubad te talagpanubad ka igpalangesa eyew iglinis te kalindit te etew. Pegkapenga kayi, eggilangen din ka egtutungen ne igpanubad 20 wey igpanubad din e diye te altar lagkes ka egkakeen ne ighalad. Ne egpalangesa ka talagpanubad eyew iglinis te sale te etew wey eg-isipen e sikandin ne malinis.

19 “And the sacrificer will_sacrifice the blood_shed that's remove sins of a person. After it, he will_slaughter the (one) for burnt offering 20 and sacrifice there on the altar including the food offering from plucked plants. And the sacrificer will_do_a_blood_shed in_order to clean person's sin and he will_be_considered clean.

21 “Piru ke egkaayu-ayu sikandin wey kene egpakabehey te seeye ne igmanubad, egkaayun ne iyan din de igbehey ka nati te karniru eyew igbayad te sale. Egkayawen seini eyew iglinis te sale. Egpakabehey re degma sikandin te sabeka ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika eyew ighalad, wey senge-ubab te mentika. 22 Ne egkaayun ne egbehey man-e sikandin te daruwa ne tukmu wey ke daruwa naa ne seleppati ke hendei ka egkaayunan din: ka sabeka para te igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale, wey ka sabeka, igpanubad ne egtutungen. 23 Te igkawalu e ne aldew, eg-uyanen din seini langun diye te talagpanubad ne eglinis kandin diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 24 Ne egkuen te talagpanubad ka nati te karniru ne igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale wey ka senge-ubab ne mentika, wey egkayawen din seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye eyew igdasag ne egkayawen. 25 Egkataman, eggilangen din ka nati te karniru ne igpanubad eyew igbayad te sale. Egkuwa sikandin te langesa wey igpulit din diye te sesel-ayan te kawanan ne talinga wey diye te timbebakal te kawanan ne belad wey paa te etew ne eglinisan. 26 Egtahuan degma te talagpanubad te mentika ne diye te ubab ka igkahibang ne palad din, 27 ig-eled din te mentika ka kemel te igkakawanan ne belad din wey igpatihis din e seini te kapapitu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 28 Ne ka same te mentika ne diye te palad din, ig-ampew rin igpulit diye te langesa ne impulit din diye te sesel-ayan te igkakawanan ne talinga te etew ne eglinisan wey iglagkes degma ka timbebakal te kawanan ne belad wey paa rin. 29 Ne ka langun ne nasame te mentika ne diye te palad te talagpanubad, igpulit din diye te ulu te etew ne eglinisan. Ne egpalangesa ka talagpanubad eyew iglinis te sale te etew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 30 Ne egpanubad ka etew te daruwa ne tukmu wey ke daruwa naa ne seleppati ke hendei ka igpakabehey rin: 31 ka sabeka, igpalangesa eyew ig-awe te sale, wey ka sabeka, egtutungen ne igpanubad ne eglagkesan te egkakeen ne ighalad. Ne egpalangesa ka talagpanubad diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew iglinis te sale te etew ne eglinisan. 32 Sika ka me tulumanen te etew ne due ibung, ke ware ayam ne igpanubad ne igpakabehey rin eyew egkalinisan sikandin.”

21 “But if he is poor and not able_to_give those sacrifices, it's_possible for him to give a lamb in_order to pay a sin. This will_be_raised_up in_order for cleaning a sin. He can also just give one kilogram of flour which is very good and mixed with oil in_order to offer, and just one cup of oil. 22 It's_possible for him also to give two spotted_doves or two doves whatever he can afford (LIT possible_to_go): one for a blood_shed that removes sin, and the other, (as a) burnt offering. 23 On the eighth day already, he will_bring this all to the sacrificer that will_clean him there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting at the front of the Lord God. 24 And the sacrificer takes the lamb to_be_sacrificed in_order to pay for sin and cup of oil, and he will_raise it to the front of the Lord in_order to offer as raised_up_offering. 25 Afterwards, he will_slaughter the lamb to_be_sacrificed in_order to pay for sin. He takes blood and puts_ (it) _on there on the earlobe of the right ear and there on the thumbs of the hand and feet of the person to be_cleaned. 26 The sacrificer also puts oil which is there in the cup his right palm, 27 and he will_dip his finger of his right hand onto the oil and splashes it seven_times there in the front of the Lord God. 28 And the remainder of oil on his palm, he puts (it) on_top of the blood that he put_on there at the earlobe of the right ear and there at the thumbs of the right hand and foot of the person to be_cleaned. 29 And all the remainder of oil there on his palm, he will_put_on the head of the person who is to be cleaned. And the sacrificer will_do_a_blood_shed in_order to clean person's sin there at the front of the Lord God. 30 And the person will_sacrifice two spotted_doves or two doves whatever he can afford: 31 one, will_be_a_blood_shed in_order to remove sin, and the other, (as a) burnt offering together_with the food offering from plucked plants. And the sacrificer spills_blood_for there at the front of the Lord God in_order for cleaning sin of the person who will_be_cleaned. 32 Those (are) the rituals/regulations of the person that has a leprosy, if he can't give sacrifices in_order for him to be_cleaned.”

Ka peglinis te abungew diye te baley

The cleaning of the molds there in the house

33 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis wey si Aarun, 34 “Emun ke egpekeuma kew e te inged te Kanaan ne igbehey ku kaniyu, wey ke due baley diye ne egpaabungawan ku, 35 keilangan ne eggendiye te talagpanubad ka mahinged dutu wey igpangguhud kandin ka abungew. 36 Ne egpitawen e te talagpanubad ka baley wey egnengnengan ka abungew. Piru te kene pad sikandin eglasud te baley, igpalihawang din pad ka langun ne diye te seled eyew kene eg-isipen ne malindit. 37 Emun ke diye te alabat ka abungew wey migmeilem wey migmalalab ka migkepkep diye te me alabat, 38 eglihawang sikandin te baley wey eglekeban din seini wey kene eglukatan taman te pitu ne aldew. 39 Te igkapitu ne aldew, egpitawen din e man-e seini. Ne emun ke migdalapdap e ka abungew diye te me alabat, 40 igpalekat din seeye se me batu ne in-alabat ne in-abungew wey igparegpak diye te lihawangan te siyudad ne egdegpakan te langun ne in-isip ne malindit. 41 Egkataman, egpakahisan din langun ka seled te alabat wey igparegpak dan ka kinahis diye te lihawangan te siyudad ne degpakanan te malindit. 42 Ne egkuwa man-e sikandan te lein ne me batu ne igliwan te me batu ne in-awe, eg-akeban dan te egpulit ka alabat ne nakahisan.

33 And Muwisis and Aarun were_told by the Lord God, 34 “If/when you(pl) reach there at the place of Kaanan that I give to you(pl), and if/when there_is a house that I cause_molds_to_be_with_it, 35 the resident of_it must go to the sacrificer and tell him the molds. 36 And the sacrificer checks the house and check_out the molds. But before he enters the house, he puts_out first all that's there inside in_order not to be_considered dirty. 37 If the molds is on the wall and turned_green/blue and turned_red that's sticking there on the walls, 38 he goes_out the house and shuts it and won't open it until seven days. 39 On the seventh day, he will_check it again. And if the molds spread_over there on the walls, 40 he will_cause_to_be_pulled_out the stones that's walled that has_mold and cause_it_to_be_thrown there outside the city where all that's considered dirty will_be_thrown_in. 41 Afterwards, he will_cause_ all the walls inside _to_be_scraped and cause_ the scrape_off _to_be_thrown outside the city where the dirty (things) will_be_thrown. 42 And he will_take other stones again to replace the stones that were removed, and plaster again the walls that scraped.

43 “Ke eglibed ka abungew te naawe e ka batu, wey nakahisan e wey napulitan e, 44 eggendiyaan e man-e seeye te talagpanubad wey egpitawen e man-e. Ke migdalapdap e ka abungew diye te baley, abungew naa seini ne egpakarereet su eglibed-libed, wey eg-isipen ne malindit seini ne baley. 45 Purisu, igpahuhus din ka baley wey igparegpak ka langun-langun diye te lihawangan te siyudad, diye te degpakanan te eg-isipen ne malindit. 46 Ne minsan hentew ne egseled te seeye ne baley ne inlekeban pad, eg-isipen ne malindit taman te egkasagkup, 47 wey minsan hentew ne eglipereng wey ke egkeen naa diye te seled te sika ne baley, keilangan ne egpami-pi te insaluub din.

43 “If the molds return when the stones are removed already, and scraped already and plastered already, 44 the sacrificer visits that again and checks again. If the molds spread_over the house, it's a mold that's destructive because it keeps_coming_back, and this house will_be_considered dirty. 45 Therefore, he cause_ the house _to_be_broken and everything will_be_thrown there outside the city, there where all that's considered dirty will_be_thrown_in. 46 And whoever enters that house which is closed yet, will_be_considered dirty until the sun_sets, 47 and whoever sleeps or eats there inside that house, must wash of his clothing.

48 “Piru ke egkakita te talagpanubad ne warad migdalapdap ka abungew diye te napulitan e, igpanengneng din ne kenad seeye ne malindit su naawe e ka abungew. 49 Ne eyew eg-isipen ne malinis ka baley, egkuwa ka talagpanubad te daruwa ne manuk-manuk, wey sabeka ne sugpang te kayu ne sidar, wey malalab-lalab ne lubid, wey derewunen ne isupu. 50 Ne eggimatayan din ka sabeka ne manuk-manuk ne egtayeen ka langesa te kuren ne due weyig. 51 Ne egbalakesen din te eggen-gen ka sabeka ne sugpang te kayu ne sidar, wey ka malalab-lalab ne lubid, wey ka derewunen ne isupu, wey iglagkes din ka sabeka ne manuk-manuk ne neuyag, wey ig-eled din ka langun diye te weyig ne due langesa te manuk-manuk ne inggimatayan. Ne egpapesikan din ka baley te kapapitu. 52 Iling due ka peglinis te baley ne iyan eggamiten ka langesa te manuk, ka weyig, ka neuyag ne manuk-manuk, wey ka kayu ne sidar, ka derewunen ne isupu, wey ka malalab-lalab ne lubid. 53 Ne eglekaan ka neuyag ne manuk-manuk diye te lihawangan te siyudad. Iling due ka pegpalangesa rin te peglinis te baley ne in-abungew.”

48 “But if the sacrificer sees that the molds didn't spread_over there at the plastered_portion, he will_make_it_known that that house is no_longer dirty because the molds are gone. 49 And in_order that the house will_be_considered clean, the sacrificer takes two birds, and one branch of cedar tree/wood, and reddish tying_cord, and one branch of isupu. 50 And he will_slaughter the one bird and the blood will_be_catch with the pot that has water. 51 And he will_hold_together the one branch of cedar tree/wood, and the reddish tying_cord, and the one branch of isupu, and he will_include the other living bird, and he dips all there on the blood of the slaughtered bird with water. And he splashes the house for seven_times. 52 It's like that the cleaning of the house that's using a blood of the bird, water, living bird, and cedar tree/wood, isupu, and reddish tying_cord. 53 And he will_let_ the living bird _go there outside the city. Like that his blood shedding to clean house that became mouldy.”

54-56 Sika ka me tulumanen meyitenged te dalu te laplap iling te me kehang, buu wey ke busuwak naa, wey meyitenged te abungew ne diye te manggad, wey ke diye naa te me baley, 57 eyew egkanengnengan ke eg-isipen naan e ne malindit wey eg-isipen naan e ne malinis. Ka aldew te peglinis te sale

The day of cleaning sin

161 Te migpatey e ka daruwa ne anak ni Aarun tenged su migparani sikandan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, migkahiyan e te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 2 [xr]“Kahii nu ka suled nu ne si Aarun ne kene egseled egtakuseng diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng ne diye te limang te kurtina ne diye ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Ke egseled sikandin diye ne egpakakita te katelesan ku pinaahi te gapun diye te ampew te supe[fn] te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, egpatey sikandin. 3 Egpakaseled de sikandin diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng ke eg-uyan sikandin te turu ne baka ne igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale wey lukesan ne karniru ne igpanubad ne egtutungen.

161 After the two children of Aarun died because they drew_near there to the front of the Lord God, Muwisis was_told by the Lord, 2 [xr]“Tell(sg) your(sg) brother Aarun not to enter easily/disorderly there in the Very Holy Room there behind the curtain where the Container of the Agreement is. 4 “Keilangan ne egpamanihus sikandin wey igsaluub din ka egpekeiling te kumbale ne malayat se belad, malepet ne salual ne igbunbun te lebut, tabed, wey salakey.
