15 [xr]“He will_slaughter also the goat that's blood_shed for removing the sins of the people. And he will_take the blood of the goat there at the Very Holy Room and he will_splashes_blood on the cover of the Container of the Agreement, like what_ he _did with the blood of the bull cow. 16 That's what_ Aarun _do for spilling_blood for cleaning the Very Holy Room due to the impurities of the descendants of Israil and of all their sins, and their disobeying. And he will_do this also there on the other dirtied parts of the Tent of Meeting that's there to the middle of_them. 17 It's_necessary that there's_no person there in the Tent of Meeting when Aarun enters there in_order for cleaning the Very Holy Room until he exits. And when he's able_to_spill_blood in_order to clean their sins as parents_and_children and all the descendants of Israil, 18 he exits there and goes there to the altar that's near the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And he will_take a blood of the male cow and goat, and he put_on it the horns of the altar. 19 Aarun cause_to_splash by his finger for seven_times the rest of blood there in the altar, and due to that, this will_be_cleaned and becomes_holy from the impurities of the descendants of Israil.

Ka kambing ne eglekaan

The goat being let_go

20 “Ke egkeimpusan e ni Aarun te egpalangesa ka Matulus ne Sinabeng wey ka Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey ka altar, eg-uyanen din e diye te Manama ka neuyag ne kambing ne para ki Asasil. 21 Igtel-eb din ka daruwa ne belad din te ulu te kambing wey igpangguhud din ka langun ne sale te kabuhalan ni Israil. Te seini ne paahi, egkaalin ka pegkamalindit dan, wey ka me seyyup dan diye te ulu te kambing. Ne egpalekaan e ni Aarun te me etew ne talagpaleke ka kambing diye te disirtu. 22 Ne egkeuyan e te kambing ka langun ne sale dan diye te diriyui ne inged, su eglekaan ma seini diye te disirtu.

20 “When Aarun is done in spilling_blood_for the Holy Room and the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he will_bring there to God the living goat that's for Asasil. 21 He puts_ his two hands _over there on the head of the goat and he'll tell all the sins of the descendants of Israil. In this way, their impurities, and their mistakes will_transfer there to the head of the goat. And Aarun will_cause_ the goat _to_be_released by the people who (were) released there in the desert. 22 And the goat will_take all their sins there at the very_far place, because it will_be_sent_away there in the desert.

23 [xr]“Ne egseled si Aarun te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey egluungen din ka insaluub din te migseled wey iggaat din de seini diye te Matulus ne Sinabeng. 24 Ne egpamanihus sikandin diye te Matulus ne Sinabeng, wey igsaluub din ka lerew ne kumbale din. Ne egkataman, eglihawang e sikandin wey egtutungen din e ka kandin ne igpanubad eyew iglinis te sale din, wey ka igpanubad degma te me etew eyew iglinis te sale dan. 25 Ne egtutungen din diye te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad ka tabe te igpalangesa ne iglinis te sale. 26 Ne ka etew ne talagleke te kambing ne para ki Asasil, keilangan ne egpami-pi te insaluub din, wey egpamanihus te kene pad sikandin egseled diye te kampu. 27 [xr]Keilangan ne eg-uyanen diye te lihawangan te kampu wey egtutungen ka nasame ne turu ne baka wey ka kambing ne in-angayan te langesa eyew iglinis te Matulus ne Sinabeng. Iglagkes te egtutung ka laplap, sapu, wey ka tei te me ayam. 28 Ne seeye se migtutung te same te me ayam, keilangan ne egpami-pi pad te insaluub din wey egpamanihus pad human eglibed diye te kampu.

23 [xr]“And Aarun will_enter the Tent of Meeting and will_take_off what_ he _put_on when he enters and he just leave it there at the Holy Room. 24 And he will_bathe there in the Holy Room, and put_on his usual clothing. And then, he will_go_out and he will_sacrifice his burnt offering in_order to clean his sin, and the sacrifice also of the people in_order to clean their sin. 25 And he will_burn on the altar which is the burning_place for sacrifice the fat of the blood_shed that's clean sin. 26 And the person who released the goat for Asasil, must wash his clothing, and bathe before he enters there in the camp. 27 [xr]He must bring there outside the camp and burn the remainder of the bull cow and the goat where_ he _took_ blood _away_from in_order for cleaning the Holy Room. The skin, flesh, and dung of the domestic_animals will_be_included. 28 And those who burned the remainder of the domestic_animals, must wash his clothing and bathe yet before returning there in the camp.

Ka Aldew te Pegpasaylu te Sale

The Day of Forgiving Sin

29 [xr]“Seini ka tulumanen ne eg-ikulen niyu te langun ne timpu: keilangan ne egpuasa kew te igkapitu ne bulan te igkasapulu ne aldew wey kene kew himu te minsan nekey, mahinged ma wey se lapu ne miglemung kaniyu. 30 Su sika ka aldew ne egpalangesaan kew eyew egmalinis kew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 31 Himeley kew wey peeneng-eneng kew te eggimuwen niyu te sika ne aldew wey puasa kew man-e. Tulumanen seini ne kene egkataman. 32 Ne iyan egpalangesa kaniyu ka egkaalam ne talagpanubad ne eg-itisan te lana ne iyan igliwan te amey rin isip Labew ne Talagpanubad. Igsaluub din ka igsaluub te Labew ne Talagpanubad, 33 wey egpalangesaan din ka Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng wey ka balungbalung ne temuwanan, wey ka altar, wey iglagkes din te egpalangesa ka me talagpanubad wey ka langun ne keet-etawan eyew egmalinis. 34 Ne keilangan ne egtumanen niyu seini ne tulumanen ne pegpalangesa te langun ne sale te kabuhalan ni Israil te ware egtamanan wey himuwa niyu seini tagse leg-un.” Ne intuman ni Muwisis ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin.

29 [xr]“This the ritual/regulation that you(pl) follow at all times: you(pl) must fast in the seventh month on tenth day and don't(pl) do anything, local_inhabitants or foreigners that live_among you(pl). 30 For that's the day of spilling_blood_for you(pl) so_that you(pl) become_clean there in front of the Lord God. 31 Rest(pl) and be_stop(pl) of you're(pl) doing on that day and fast(pl) also. This is a ritual/regulation that won't end. 32 The one leading the spilling_blood_for cleaning a sin is the sacrificer that will_be_chosen and be_anointed with oil who will_be_replacing his father as Prominent Sacrificer. He will_put_on the clothing of the Prominent Sacrificer, 33 and he will_spill_blood_for the Very Holy Room and the tent of meeting, and the altar, and he will_include to spill_blood_for the sacrificer and all the people in_order to become_clean. 34 And you(pl) must fulfill this ritual/regulation that's blood_shedding for all sins of the descendants of Israil forever (LIT without ending) and do(pl) this every year.” And Muwisis fulfilled what_ the Lord God _commanded him.

Ka inged ne eleg ne egpanubaran

The correct place to_be_offered_sacrifices_to

171 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu si Aarun wey ka me anak din, wey ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne seini ka igsuhu ku kandan: 3 Minsan hentew kandan ne eggilang te baka wey ke nati naa te karniru wey ke kambing naa ne igpanubad, keilangan ne diye din seini eggimuwa te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan eyew igdasag diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 4 Ke diye din seini eggilanga te minsan hendei diye te kampu wey ke diye naa te lihawangan te kampu, nakasale sikandin iling te nakapatey. Ne puun due, egdeldelen e sikandin puun te me karumaan din. 5 Inggimu seini ne suhu eyew egkeengked ka pegpanubad te kabuhalan ni Israil te minsan hendei. Pegpehet-pehet man-e seini ne ka igpanubad para te keupianan, igbehey diye te me talagpanubad ne diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan ne iyan egpanubad diye te Magbebaye. 6 Ne egpatihisan te talagpanubad te langesa te igpanubad ka altar te Magbebaye ne diye dapit te gumawan te Balungbalung. Egtutungen sika wey meemut ka lansi due diye te Magbebaye. 7 Su kenad e egpanubad sikandan diye te me busew ne kambing ne insimba ran. Tulumanen seini ne ware egtamanan para kandan wey te egginguma pad ne kabuhalan dan.

171 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) Aarun and his children, and all the descendants of Israil that this is what_ I _will_command them: 3 Whoever of them who slaughters a cow or sheep or goat that will_be_sacrificed, she/he should do it at the entrance of the Tent in_order to offer (it) to the Lord God. 4 If she/he slaughter it anywhere in the camp or there at outside the camp, he_commits_sin like the one_who_murdered_someone. And due to that, he will_be_expelled from his relatives. 5 This command was_made in_order to stop the sacrificing of the descendants of Israil everywhere. This is also to make_sure that the sacrifice for well-being, will_be_given there to sacrificers that's there to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting who will_sacrifice there to the Lord God. 6 And the sacrificer cause_to_drip_ a blood of the sacrifice _into the altar of the Lord God there on the side of the entrance of the Tent. This will_be_burned and the burning_smell of that (will be) fragrant there to the Lord. 7 Because they won't sacrifice anymore there to the goat evil_spirits that they worshiped. This was the ritual/regulation without ending for them and of their future descendants.

8 “Sikan naa, kahii nu sikandan ne minsan hentew te kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke lapu naa ne miglemung kandan ne egpanubad te egtutungen 9 ne kene dan eg-uyanen diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan eyew igpanubad te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka sika ne etew, egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din.”

8 “So then, tell(sg) them that whoever descendant of Israil or sojourner that lives with them who sacrifices a burnt (one) 9 that they won't bring there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting in_order to sacrifice to the Lord God, that person, will_be_expelled from his relatives.”

Ka balaud meyitenged te langesa

The law concerning the blood

10 [xr]“Ne emun due kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke lapu naa ne miglemung kandan ne egkeen te due langesa, egbalaharen ku sikandin wey egdeldelen e sikandin te me kabuhalan din. 11 [xr]Su puun te langesa ka umul te langun ne eggeheyinawa. Ne ka langesa iya ka in-alam ku ne iglinis kaniyu diye te altar. Su ka langesa ne iyan egpuunan te umul, iyan egpakalinis te sale te me etew. 12 Seini ka egpuunan mania te inlalahan ku ka kabuhalan ni Israil ne kene egkaayun ne egkeen te langesa ka minsan hentew kandan wey ke me lapu naa ne miglemung kandan.

10 [xr]“And if there's a descendant of Israil or sojourner that lives_among them that eats something_with blood, I will_abandon him and will_consider him no_longer relative of his descendants. 11 [xr]Because life of all breathing came_from the blood. And it's really the blood that I have_chosen to clean there to the altar. For the blood is the source of life, that's able_to_clean with people's sin. 12 That's the reason why I said to the descendants of Israil that no (one) of them can eat with blood or sojourners that live_among them.

13 “Ka minsan hentew ne kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke me lapu naa ne miglemung kaniyu ne egpanganup wey egpanitingen te egkaayun ne egkeenen, keilangan ne igpatihis din te tane ka langesa te egkeutel rin wey egbunbunan din. 14 Tenged su egpuun te langesa ka umul te langun ne eggeheyinawa, sikan naa, egbalabahan ku ka kabuhalan ni Israil ne egkeen te langesa te minsan nekey ne mananap. Ka egkeen te langesa, egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din.

13 “Whoever descendant of Israil or sojourners that live_among you(pl) that hunt_wild_animals and hunt_birds that can be eaten, must cause_ the blood_of_what_he_caught _to_drip on the soil and he covers it. 14 Since the lives of all breathing were from the blood, that's why, I will_stop the descendants of Israil to eat blood of any animals. The one eating a blood, will_be_expelled from his relatives.

15 “Ka minsan hentew te kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke me lapu naa ne mig-ugpe duma kaniyu ne egkeen te mananap ne napatey re due wey ke inggimatayan te lein ne mananap, keilangan ne egpami-pi sikandin te insaluub din wey egpamanihus, piru eg-isipen ded sikandin ne malindit taman te egkasagkup. 16 Piru ke kene din egpi-pian ka insaluub din wey kene egpamanihus, due egkaneem-neem din ne legpad.”

15 “Whoever descendant of Israil or sojourners that live_among you(pl) that eats animals that just died or killed by other animals, must wash her/his clothing and bathe, but s/he will_be_considered dirty until the sun_sets. 16 But if s/he won't wash her/his clothing and won't bathe, there's a punishment that s/he'll taste.”

Ka kene ne eleg ne pegpeyilabetey

The not correct intercourse_with_each_other

181 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te seini: Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu. 3 Kene kew ikul te me hinimuwan te me matig-Ihiptu ne mig-ugpaan niyu dengan, wey kene kew ikul te me hinimuwan te me matig-Kanaan ne eg-uyanan ku kaniyu. Kene kew ikul te me batasan dan. 4 Tumana niyu ka me suhu ku wey ikula niyu ka me balaud ku kaniyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 5 [xr]Sikan naa, tumana niyu ka me suhu ku wey ikula niyu ka me balaud ku kaniyu, su ka egtuman due, egkeuyag. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

181 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) this to the descendants of Israil: I (am) your(pl) Lord. 3 Don't(pl) follow what_ the (ones) from_Ihiptu _did where_you_live before, and don't(pl) follow what_ the (ones) from_Kanaan _did where_ I _will_bring you(pl). Don't(pl) follow their custom/behavior. 4 Fulfill(pl) my commands and follow my laws to you(pl). I (am) the Lord your(pl) God. 5 [xr]So then, fulfill(pl) my commands and follow my laws to you(pl), because the one_obeying it, will_live. I (am) the Lord.

6 “Kene kew hilabet te karumaan niyu pad iya. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye. 7 Kene kew hilabet te iney niyu su egpakapeyilew sika te amey niyu. Iney niyu sikandin; kene niyu sikandin huliri. 8 [xr]Ne kene kew hilabet te duwey te amey niyu, su egpakapeyilew sika te amey niyu. 9 [xr]Kene kew hilabet te atebey niyu, minsan ke nekegtalaari kew re te amey wey ke iney naa, minsan ke diye miglesut sikandin te baley niyu wey se ware. 10 Ne kene kew hilabet te apu niyu ne malitan—apu niyu ma sikandin te anak niyu ne lukes wey se malitan—su egpekeyilew kaniyu sika. 11 Kene kew hilabet te anak te amey niyu te lein ne malitan su atebey niyu red sikandin. 12 [xr]Ne kene kew hilabet te aye niyu su atebey pad iya sikandin te amey niyu. 13 Kene kew hilabet te hari te iney niyu ne malitan, su karumaan pad iya sikandin te iney niyu. 14 Kene kew hilabet te asawa te anggam niyu su egpakapeyilew sika te anggam niyu, wey egkaaye niyu pad man-e ka asawa rin. 15 [xr]Kene kew hilabet te ambey niyu su asawa ma sikandin te anak niyu. Keilangan ne kene niyu egguliran sikandin. 16 [xr]Ne kene kew hilabet te ipag niyu su egkeyilawan ka suled niyu. 17 [xr]Kene niyu peglakita te eggilabet ka anak wey ka iney. Kene kew man-e hilabet te me apu din su amana rin pad iya sikandan wey mareet sika ne himu. 18 Kene kew duruwey te ipag niyu wey kene kew hilabet kandin su neuyag pad ka asawa niyu wey eyew kene egpekeg-ehet sikandan.

6 “Don't(pl) intercourse_with your(pl) close relative. I (am) the Lord. 7 Don't(pl) intercourse_with your(pl) mother because that can_shame your(pl) fathers. She is your(pl) mother; don't(pl) lie_with her. 8 [xr]And don't(pl) intercourse_with junior_wife of your(pl) father, because that can_shame your(pl) father. 9 [xr]Don't(pl) have_intercourse_with your(pl) sister(s), even if you(pl) are only sibling in_relation_to the father or mother, even she was_borne there in you(pl) house or not. 10 And don't(pl) have_intercourse_with your(pl) female grandchild—she's your(pl) grandchild from your(pl) male or female child—because that can_cause_shame on_you(pl). 11 Don't(pl) have_intercourse_with the child of your(pl) father with other woman because she is still your(pl) sister. 12 [xr]And don't(pl) intercourse_with your(pl) aunt because she's really a sister of your(pl) father. 13 Don't(pl) intercourse_with the female younger_sister of your(pl) mother, because she is indeed a close relative of your(pl) mother. 14 Don't(pl) intercourse_with the spouse of your(pl) uncle because that can_cause_shame of your(pl) uncle, and his spouse is also be your(pl) aunt. 15 [xr]Don't(pl) intercourse_with your(pl) daughter-in-law because she's a spouse of you(pl) child. You(pl) must not lie_with her. 16 [xr]And don't(pl) intercourse_with your(pl) sister-in-law because your(pl) brother will_be_shamed_on. 17 [xr]Don't(pl) intercourse_with mother and child together. Also don't(pl) intercourse_with her grandchildren because they are indeed related to her and that's bad action. 18 Don't(pl) take_as_a_junior_wife your(pl) sister-in-law and don't(pl) intercourse_with her because her spouse is still alive and so_that they won't be_able_to_fight_together.

19 [xr]“Kene kew man-e hilabet te eglangeseen ne malitan, su in-isip sikandin ne malindit. 20 [xr]Ne kene kew hilabet te asawa te senge-etew eyew kene kew eg-isipen ne malindit. 21 [xr]Kene niyu ipanubad ka me anak niyu diye te diyus-diyus ne si Muluk, su eyew kene egkabaley-baley ka ngaran te Manama niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama. 22 [xr]Kene kew hilabet te iling niyu red ne lukes iling te peggulid niyu te malitan, su eg-isipen sika ne malindit. 23 [xr]Ne sikaniyu se me lukes, kene kew hilabet te mananap eyew kene kew eg-isipen ne malindit. Ne sikaniyu degma se me malitan, kene kew peyilabet te me mananap su eg-isipen iya sika ne malindit.

19 [xr]“Don't(pl) also intercourse_with a bleeding woman, because she's considered dirty. 20 [xr]And don't(pl) intercourse_with the spouse of other man/person so_that you(pl) won't be_considered dirty. 21 [xr]Don't(pl) sacrifice your(pl) children to the false_god Muluk, so_that the name of your(pl) God won't be mocked. I (am) the Lord God. 22 [xr]Don't(pl) intercourse_with male like you(pl) same as your(pl) lying_with female, because that's considered dirty. 23 [xr]And you(pl) males, don't(pl) intercourse_with animal(s) so_that you(pl) won't be_considered dirty. And you(pl) females also, don't cause_animals_to_intercourse_with you(sg) because that's really considered dirty.

24 “Kene niyu linditi ka pegkeetew niyu te minsan hendei te seeye ne me himu, su sika ka nakalindit te me etew ne egdeldelen ku te in-ugpaan dan eyew egkasubalan niyu. 25 Tenged te nalinditan dan e ka intiru ne tane, imparusaan ku ka inged dan, purisu narelrel e sikandan. 26 Piru tumana niyu mule ka me suhu ku wey ka me balaud ku, sikaniyu se kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke me lapu naa. Ne kene niyu himuwa ka minsan hendei te seeye se eg-isipen ne malindit ne himu 27 su sika iya ka nakalindit te tane te me etew ne egsubalan niyu. 28 Su emun ke eg-iling kew red kandan, egdeldelen ku degma sikaniyu iling te pegdeldel ku kandan te nekewun-a kaniyu. 29 Minsan hentew ne eggimu te seeye se eg-isipen ne malindit, egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din.

24 “Don't(pl) cause_ yourselves _to_be_dirty on any of those works, because that's what_cause_ people _to_be_dirty whom I will_send_away in their place so_that you(pl) replace_them. 25 Because they have dirtied the entire ground/soil, I have punished their place, therefore they were_sent_away. 26 But you(pl) obey my commands and my laws, you(pl) the descendants of Israil or foreigners. And don't(pl) do any of those works that are_considered dirty 27 because that's really what_causes_to_be_dirty the ground/soil of the people that you(pl) are to_replace. 28 Because if you(pl) are to imitate them, I will_send_ you(pl) _away also like my sending_away of them who preceded you(pl). 29 Whoever does those will_be_considered dirty, he will_be_expelled from his relatives.

30 “Purisu tanud-tanud kew ne egkatuman niyu ka igpeyimu ku kaniyu, wey kene niyu ilingi ka mallindit ne hinimuwan te me etew ne nekewun-a kaniyu. Kene kew en iya bul-ug himu te iling due su egpakamalindit sika kaniyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

30 “Therefore be_mindful(pl) that you(pl) can_fulfill what_ I _cause_ you(pl) _to_do, and don't(pl) imitate the dirty actions of the people who preceded you(pl). Don't(pl) really try to do something_like that because that can cause_ you(pl) _dirty. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.”

Ka nalein-lein ne me suhu

The various commands

191 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 [xr]“Kahii nu ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil: Keilangan ne egmatulus kew su matulus a se Magbebaye niyu. 3 [xra][xrb]Tahura niyu ka iney wey ka amey niyu, wey himeley kew te Aldew te Peggimeley. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

191 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 [xr]“Tell(sg) all the descendants of Israil: You(pl) must be holy because I (am) holy your(pl) Lord. 3 [xra][xrb]Respect(pl) your(pl) mother and father, and rest(pl) on the Day of Resting. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

4 [xra][xrb]“Kene kew simba te me diyus-diyus wey ke egpanggimu naa te diyus-diyus ne me putew. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

4 [xra][xrb]“Don't(pl) worship false_gods or make iron false_gods. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

5 “Ke egpanubad kew te igpanubad para te keupianan, keilangan ne eleg ka pegpanubad niyu eyew egdawaten ku sikaniyu. 6 Keilangan ne egkasimahan de seini wey ke egkararuan naa. Ne emun due egkasame te egkatateluwan e, keilangan ne egtutungen e seini. 7 Ke egkeenen niyu seini te egkatateluwan e, kene ku seini egdawaten, su in-isip e seini ne malindit. 8 Ka minsan hentew ne egkeen due, due egkaneem-neem din ne legpad tenged su imbaley-baley rin ka inhalad e keddi, sikan naa, egdeldelen e sikandin puun te me karumaan din.

5 “If you(pl) will_sacrifice of sacrifice for well-being, your(pl) sacrificing must be correct so_that I will_accept you(pl). 6 It must stay_overnight only or two_days. And if there's a left_over after three_days, this must be_burned. 7 If you(pl) eat this after three_days, I won't accept it, because it's considered dirty already. 8 Whoever eats it, there's punishment that s/he can_taste because s/he mocked what's_offered already to me, that's why, s/he will_be_expelled from his relatives.

9 [xr]“Ke eggaani kew, kene niyu re amina wey ke pakilalawi naa. 10 Kene niyu re man-e amina te egpamupu ka parasan niyu wey ke egpamuruten naa ka neneulug. Pangengkeri niyud e seini para te seeye se ware egkeyimu wey te me lapu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

9 [xr]“If you(pl) are harvesting, don't(pl) (harvest)_everything or glean_on_it. 10 Don't(pl) pick_ all _fruits of your(pl) grapevines also or pick the fallen (ones). Leave(pl) it for those who are needy (LIT nothing can do) and to the sojourners. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.

11 [xra][xrb]“Kene kew panakew, kene kew paak-akaley wey ke peub-ubatey naa. 12 [xr]Ne kene niyu gamita ka ngaran ku eyew igpamalehet niyu te ubat su ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egkabaley-baley niyu re ka ngaran ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

11 [xra][xrb]“Don't(pl) steal, don't(pl) betray_one_another or lie_to_one_another. 12 [xr]And don't(pl) use my name in testifying what's lie because if you(pl) do that, you(pl) will_only_mock my name. I (am) the Lord.

13 [xr]“Kene niyu le-leiha wey ke panakawi naa ka duma niyu. Kene niyu pasimahi te egbayad ka trabahanti niyu. 14 [xr]Kene niyu balbalaya ka kene egdineg ne etew wey kene niyu balabahi ka egbayaan te butud, ke kene, kaaldeki a nikaniyu se Manama niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

13 [xr]“Don't(pl) take_advantage_of or rob your(pl) companion. Don't(pl) let_overnight_comes and pay your(pl) workers. 14 [xr]Don't(pl) mock the deaf person and don't(pl) block the way of the blind, but rather, fear(pl) me who is your(pl) God. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

15 [xr]“Kene kew hukum te kene ne eleg ne peggukum eyew te peglapig te egkaayu-ayu wey ke meyaman naa. Ke kene, peg-ilinga niyu te eggukum ka langun. 16 Kene kew sesalupet te duma niyu. Kene kew himu te minsan nekey ne egpakarereet te duma niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

15 [xr]“Don't(pl) judge with not correct judgment in_order to favor the poor or rich_person. But rather, you(pl) judge all equally. 16 Don't(pl) slander about your(pl) companion. Don't(pl) do anything that destroys your(pl) companion. I (am) the Lord.

17 [xr]“Kene kew tetahu te langet te pusung niyu ke due ig-ehet niyu te duma niyu, eyew kene kew egpakalagkes kandan te due sale. 18 [xr]Kene kew suli wey ke ehet naa te duma niyu. Ke kene, geyinawei niyu ka duma niyu iling te peggeyinawa niyu te pegkeetew niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

17 [xr]“Don't(pl) put hatred in your(pl) heart if you(pl) have something_to_tell_of with your(pl) companion, tell(sg) him straight so_that you(sg) won't be included them that have sin. 18 [xr]Don't(pl) take_revenge or fight your(pl) relative. But rather, love(pl) your(pl) companion like your(pl) loving of your(pl) selves. I (am) the Lord.

19 [xr]“Tumana niyu ka me balaud ne igpatuman ku kaniyu. Kene niyu paahari ka ayam niyu te lein ne klasi te ayam. Kene niyu pamulei te daruwa ne klasi te beni ka kamet niyu. Kene niyu isaluub ka manggad ne inggimu puun te daruwa ne klasi te hinabel.

19 [xr]“Fulfill(pl) the laws that I cause_ you(pl) _to_fulfill. Don't(pl) breed your(pl) domestic_animal with other kind of domestic_animal. Don't(pl) plant two kinds of seeds in your(pl) field. Don't(pl) put_on a garment made from two kinds of cloth.

20 “Ke due lukes ne eggilabet te uripen ne malitan ne duen e egpangasawa, piru ware pad nalekat te eg-asawa kandin wey ware pad kaligwangan din puun te nekeuripen kandin, keilangan ne egparusaan sikandan. Piru kene de sikandan eggimatayan su ware mem pad kaligwangan te malitan puun te nekeuripen kandin. 21 Ne ka lukes ne nekeyilabet, eg-uyan te lukesan ne karniru diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan eyew igbayad te sale ne neyimu rin. 22 Ne igpalangesa te talagpanubad ka lukesan ne karniru diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye eyew iglinis te sale te lukes wey egkapasaylu e ka sale din.

20 “If there's male who intercourse_with a female slave who has some_one_to_marry_her already, but (she's) not redeemed yet by the one who_marries her and (she's) no freedom yet from the one who_enslaved her, they must be_punished. But they won't be_killed because the female has no freedom yet from the one who_enslaved her. 21 And the male who intercoursed_with, he must bring a male sheep there to the Lord God, there at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting in_order to pay for the sin that he did. 22 And the sacrificer will_blood_shed the male sheep there at the front of the Lord in_order to clean the sin of a male/man and his sin will_be_forgiven.

23 “Ke diye kew e te Kanaan wey ke egpamula kew e te minsan nekey ne prutas ne egkakeen, kene kew egkaayun ne egkeen te behas te tatelu ne leg-un. Kene kew pa keen te behas su kene egkaayun. 24 Te igkeep-at ne leg-un, ka langun ne behas, ihalad niyu eyew te pegdayan keddi. 25 Te igkalalimme e ne leg-un, egkaayun e ne egkeenen niyu ka me behas te me prutas wey egmasalig e ka me behas kayi. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

23 “If you(pl) get_there in Kanaan already and you(pl) plant any kinds of edible fruits, it's_ not _allowable for you(pl) to eat fruits for three years. Don't(pl) eat fruit because it's not allowable. 24 On the fourth year, all the seeds, you(pl) offer it in_order to praise me. 25 On the fifth year, you(pl) can_eat the seeds of the fruits and the seeds of it become_many. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.

26 [xra][xrb]“Kene kew keen te ngalap te minsan nekey ne duen pad langesa. Ne kene kew panagne wey ke pahehane naa. 27 [xr]Kene niyu abuluhi ka tagse kakiliran te ulu niyu wey kene kew panumpe. 28 Ne kene niyu man-e tulisi ka lawa niyu wey ke pangetebi naa eyew te peglungku te minatey. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.

26 [xra][xrb]“Don't(pl) eat meat of any_thing that has blood yet. Don't(pl) predict_the_future or don't(pl) do magic. 27 [xr]Don't(pl) shave_off every side of your(pl) head and don't(pl) shave_off_(your)_beard. 28 And don't(pl) also cut your(pl) bodies or make_a_tattoo_on_it in_order to mourn a dead_body. I (am) the Lord God.

29 [xr]“Kene niyu ipabaley-baley ka me anak niyu ne me malitan su eg-isipen sikandan ne malindit. Ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egkeempet te malindit ka inged niyu wey egkeelin e ne mareet ka langun. 30 [xr]Himeley kew te Aldew te Peggimeley, wey kaaldeki niyu ka inged ne egsimbaan niyu keddi. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

29 [xr]“Don't(pl) cause_ your(pl) female children _to_be_used_sexually_by_others because she will_be_considered dirty. If you(pl) do this, your(pl) place will_be_covered by dirty_things and everything will_become_all bad. 30 [xr]Rest(pl) on the Day of Resting, and fear(pl) the place where_ you(pl) _worship me. I (am) the Lord.

31 [xr]“Kene kew pabulig te egmahehane. Ke egpabulig kew kandan, eg-isipen kew ne malindit. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

31 [xr]“Don't(pl) ask_help from sorcerers. If you(pl) ask_help from them, you(pl) will_be_considered dirty. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

32 “Tahura niyu ka me buyag. Kaaldeki a degma nikaniyu se Manama niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

32 “Respect(pl) the old_people. Fear(pl) me also your(pl) God. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

33 [xr]“Ke due lapu ne eglemung kaniyu diye te tane niyu, kene niyu le-leiha sikandin, 34 ke kene, sahipaa niyu iling te duma niyu red te mahinged. Geyinawei niyu sikandin iling te peggeyinawa niyu te pegkeetew niyu tenged su me lapu kew ma degma dengan diye te Ihiptu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.

33 [xr]“If there's a sojourner that lives_among you(pl) there in your(pl) ground/soil, don't(pl) take_advantage_of him, 34 but rather, treat him like your(pl) fellow local_resident. Love him like your(pl) loving of your(pl) selves because you(pl) were sojourners also before there in Ihiptu. I (am) your(pl) Lord.

35 [xr]“Kene kew lilimbung te pegseked niyu, pegtimbang wey ke pegtakes naa. 36 Gamita niyu ka eleg ne sekeranan,[fn] timbangan wey takesanan.[fn] Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka migpalihawang kaniyu diye te Ihiptu. 37 Ne keilangan ne egtumanen niyu ka langun ne balaud wey ka langun ne me suhu ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.”

35 [xr]“Don't(pl) deceive_others in your(pl) measuring, weighing or scooping. 36 Use(pl) the correct measuring,[fn] weigh and scooper.[fn] I (am) the Lord your(pl) God who caused_ you(pl) _to_depart in Ihiptu. 37 And you(pl) must fulfill all the laws and all my commands. I (am) the Lord.”

Ka igdusa te me sale

The punishment of sins

201 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil wey ka me lapu te egbatuwen taman te egpatey ka minsan hentew kandan ne egpanubad te me anak dan diye ki Muluk. 3 Egbalaharen kud ka sika ne etew wey egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din. Tenged te pegpanubad din te anak din diye ki Muluk, nalinditan ka Balungbalung ku, wey imbaley-baley rin ka ngaran ku. 4 Ne emun ke egbalaharen niyu re sikandin te pegpanubad din te anak din diye ki Muluk wey kene niyu eggimatayan sikandin, 5 egbalaharen kud sikandin wey ka pamilya rin, wey ka langun ne migparuma-ruma kandin te pegpanubad din ki Muluk. Egdeldelen e sikandan puun te me karumaan dan.

201 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil and those who are sojourners that whoever of them who will_sacrifice of their children there to Muluk will_be_stoned until death. 3 I will_abandon that person and will_be_expelled from his relatives. Due to his sacrificing of his child there to Muluk, my tent was dirtied, and my name was mocked. 4 And if you(pl) just ignore him on his sacrificing of his children there to Muluk and you(pl) won't kill him, 5 I will_abandon him and his family, and the all (who) obey him for sacrificing of Muluk. They will_be_expelled from their relatives.

6 “Ke due etew ne egparani wey egparuma-ruma te egmahehane, egbalaharen kud sikandin, wey egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din. 7 Purisu keilangan ne matulus kew su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 8 Tantanuri niyu wey tumana niyu ka me balaud ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne migmatulus kaniyu.

6 “If there's a person that approaches and obeys the sorcerer, I will_abandon him, and will_be_expelled from his relatives. 7 Therefore it's_necessary that you(pl) will_be_holy because I (am) the Lord your(pl) God. 8 Be_mindful(pl) and fulfill(pl) my laws. I (am) the Lord who made you(pl) holy.

9 [xr]“Ke due egdilus te amey wey iney rin, keilangan ne eggimatayan. Sikandin ded ka egpuunan te kamatayen din su indilus din ma ka amey wey iney rin.

9 [xr]“If there's one_cursing his/her father and mother, (s/he) must be_killed. He/She himself/herself is the source of his/her death because s/he cursed his/her father and mother.

10 [xr]“Ke due etew ne nakalibug te asawa te senge-etew, egpeg-unungen de iya sikandan te eggimatey se daruwa. 11 [xr]Ne ka lukes ne eggilabet te nasunud din ne iney, migpeyilew te amey rin. Keilangan ne egpeg-unungen de sikandan te eggimatey; sikandan ded ka egpuunan te kamatayen dan. 12 [xr]Ke due etew ne eggilabet te ambey rin, egpeg-unungen sikandan te eggimatey su mareet ka inggimu ran. Sikandan ded ka egpuunan te kamatayen dan. 13 [xr]Ke due lukes ne eggilabet te iling din ne lukes, eg-isipen sikandan ne malindit. Keilangan ne egpeg-unungen de sikandan te eggimatey; sikandan ded ka egpuunan te kamatayen dan. 14 [xr]Ke due etew ne egpegduwayen ka anak wey iney, keilangan ne egsilaban sikandan se tatelu, su mareet ka inggimu ran. Kene ne meupiya ne egkasewuhan kew te mareet. 15-16 [xr]Ke due lukes wey ke malitan naa ne eggilabet te mananap, keilangan ne eggimatayan sikandin wey ka mananap. Sikandan ded ka egpuunan te kamatayen dan.

10 [xr]“If there's a person who committed_adultery with the wife of other person, they two must be just killed together. 11 [xr]And the man that intercourse_with of his step mother, (he) puts_ his father _in_shame. They must be just killed together; just they (are) the reason for their death. 12 [xr]If there's a person that intercourse_with his daughter-in-law, they will_be_killed together because what they did was bad. They themselves (are) the source of their death. 13 [xr]If there's a male that intercourse_with male like him, they will_be_considered dirty. It must be that they will_be_ just _killed together; they themselves (are) the source of their death. 14 [xr]If there's a person that marries_together the child and mother, the three of them must be burned, because what_ they _did was bad. It's not good that you(pl) will_be_mixed_in with bad_things. 15-16 [xr]If there's male or female that intercourse_with animal(s), s/he must be_killed and the animal(s). They themselves (are) the source of their death.

17 [xr]“Ke due lukes ne eg-asawa te atebey rin, minsan nekeg-atebey re sikandan te amey wey ke iney naa, impeyilawan din ka me suled din wey due egkaneem-neem din ne legpad. Ne tenged te inggimu rin, egdeldelen e sikandin wey ka atebey rin puun te me karumaan dan. 18 [xr]Ke due lukes ne eggilabet te malitan ne eglangeseen, egdeldelen e sikandan se daruwa puun te me karumaan dan su nekeiling te inwakisan dan ka kalindit[fn] te malitan.

17 [xr]“If there's a male that marries his sister, even if they are related (LIT become_sister_and_brother) only in father or just in mother, he puts_ his brothers _in_shame and there's a punishment that he will_taste. And due to what_ he _did, he and his sister will_be_expelled from his relatives. 18 [xr]If there's a male that intercourse_with a woman that's bleeding, the two of them will_be_expelled from their relatives because it's like that they uncover the dirtiness[fn] of the woman.

19 [xr]“Ke due lukes ne eggilabet te aye din, impeyilawan din ka aye din. Ne due egkaneem-neem dan ne legpad te daruwa. 20 Ke due lukes ne eggilabet te asawa te anggam din, impeyilawan din ka anggam din. Ne due egkaneem-neem dan ne legpad te daruwa wey egpatey sikandan ne ware anak. 21 [xr]Ke due etew ne egpakalibug te suled din, impeyilawan din ka suled din. Eg-isipen ne malindit sika ne himu wey keilangan ne eggimatayan sikandan se daruwa ne migpalibuhey ne ware anak.

19 [xr]“If there's a male that intercourse_with his aunt, he puts_ his aunt _in_shame. And there's a punishment that will_be_tasted by the two of them. 20 If there's a male that intercourse_with the spouse of his uncle, he puts_ his uncle _in_shame. And there's a punishment that will_be_tasted by the two of them and they will_die without child. 21 [xr]And if there's a person who commits_adultery with his brother, he puts_ his brother _in_shame. This will_be consider dirty act and two_of_them_that_committed_adultery must put_to_death without child.

22 “Tumana niyu ka langun ne me balaud ku wey ka me suhu ku su eyew kene ku sikaniyu egdeldelen diye te tane ne egpeendiyaan ku wey egpeugpaan kaniyu. 23 Kene kew iling te me batasan te keet-etawan ne egdeldelen ku diye te inged ne eggendiyaan niyu. Ingkeepes ku sikandan tenged te peggimu ran te mekeyilew-hilew ne himu. 24 Ne sumale te ingkahi ku kaniyu, sikaniyud e ka egpakakamuney te tane. Igbehey ku kaniyu sika se meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma.[fn] Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne mig-alam kaniyu puun te duma ne keet-etawan. 25 Sikan naa, ilein niyu degma ka in-isip ne malinis ne mananap puun te mananap ne in-isip ne malindit wey ka malindit ne manuk-manuk puun te malinis. Kene kew keen te in-isip ne malindit ne me mananap, manuk-manuk, wey minsan nekey ne egdul-ug te tane ne impalein ku kaniyu su eg-isipen kew ne malindit. 26 Keilangan ne matulus kew su sikeddi se Magbebaye niyu, matulus a. In-alam ku sikaniyu puun te duma ne keet-etawan eyew sikeddiey e ka egpakakamuney kaniyu.

22 “Fulfill(pl) all my laws and my commands so_that I won't chased_you_away there on the land/soil that I will_send_ you(pl) _to and I will_let_ you(pl) _live_on. 23 Don't(pl) imitate the custom/behavior of the people that I will_chase_away there in the place that you(pl) go to. I disliked them due to their doing of shameful acts. 24 And according to what_ I _said to you(pl), you(pl) will_become_the_owner of the land/soil. I will_give to you(pl) this good land/soil and with plentiful harvest.[fn] I (am) the Lord your(pl) God who chose you(pl) from other people. 25 That's why, separate(pl) also the animals that are_considered clean from the animals that are_considered dirty and the dirty birds from the clean (ones). Don't(pl) eat the considered dirty animals, birds, and whatever that crawls on the ground/soil that I caused_ you(pl) _to_separate because you(pl) will_be_considered dirty. 26 You(pl) must be holy because I your(pl) Lord, I (am) holy. I chose you(pl) from the other people so_that I will_be_ the one _to_own you(pl).

27 “Ke due egpahehane, lukes ma wey se malitan, keilangan ne egbatuwen taman te egpatey. Sikandin ded ke egpuunan te kamatayen din.”

27 “If there_is a sorcerer, male or female, must be stoned in_order to die. He/She himself is the source of his/her death.”

Ka kene ne eleg ne eggimuwen te talagpanubad

The not correct_thing to do by the sacrificer

211 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, “Kahii nu ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun: Kene kew duma te eglebeng minsan te karumaan niyu su egkeisip kew ne malindit, 2 angin e ke amana niyu pad iya sikandin ne karumaan iling te iney niyu, amey, me anak, me suled, 3 wey ke atebey niyu naa ne ware pad nakaasawa wey sikaniyu pad ka eg-uyag. 4 Keilangan ne kene kew duma te eglebeng te karumaan te asawa niyu su egkeisip kew ne malindit.

211 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, “Tell(sg) the sacrificers who are descendants of Aarun: Don't(pl) go with ones_burying_corpses even of your(pl) relatives because you(pl) be_considered dirty, 2 except if s/he is close relative to you(pl) like your(pl) mother, father, children, brothers, 3 or your(pl) sister who's not married yet and you(pl) are still the one_supporting (LIT to make_alive). 4 You(pl) must not accompany the ones_burying the relatives of your(pl) spouse(s) because you(pl) will_be_considered dirty.

5 [xr]“Kene niyu kahisi ka ulu niyu wey ke sumpe naa wey ke panultulisi naa ka me lawa niyu. 6 Keilangan ne igteil niyu ka pegkeetew niyu para keddi te Manama niyu, wey kene niyu balbalaya ka ngaran ku. Keilangan ne matulus kew su sikaniyu ka egpanubad te egkakeen ne egtutungen kayi te keddi te Magbebaye. 7 Kene kew asawa te malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa wey ke nabaley-baley e ne malitan, wey ke in-engkeran e te asawa, su inteil ku sikaniyu para keddi. 8 Keilangan ne eg-isipen kew ne matulus te me duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil tenged su sikaniyu ka egpanubad te egkakeen diye te Manama. Keilangan ne eggimuwen niyu sika su sikeddi se Magbebaye, matulus a wey sikeddi ka migmatulus kaniyu. 9 Ke due anak niyu ne malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa wey egpakapeyilew kaniyu, keilangan ne egsilaban niyu sikandin.

5 [xr]“Don't(pl) shave_off your(pl) head or your(pl) beard or cut_repeatedly your(pl) body. 6 You(pl) must set your(pl) selves for me who is your(pl) God, and don't(pl) mock my name. You(pl) must be holy because you(pl) (are) the ones who sacrifice burnt food here to me the Lord. 7 Don't(pl) marry a prostitute (LIT woman that sells a body) or a female that already made_fun_of, or one divorced (LIT left) from her spouse, because I set you(pl) for me. 8 You(pl) must be_considered holy by your(pl) company the descendants of Israil because you(pl) (are) the ones to sacrifice the food there to God. You(pl) must do that because I the Lord, I (am) holy and I (am) the (one who) made_you(pl)_holy. 9 If you(pl) have a female child that sells (her) body and causes_ you(pl) _to_shame, she must be burned by you(pl).

10 “Ne ka Labew ne Talagpanubad iyan pangulu te langun ne me talagpanubad. In-itisan sikandin te lana te peg-alam kandin wey imbehayan te katenged ne egsaluub te kumbale te talagpanubad. Sikan naa ka kene din eggusengen ka bulbul din wey kene din eggisgisien ka insaluub din. 11-12 Ne tenged su neitisan e sikandin te lana te peghalad kandin kayi te keddiey te Manama rin, keilangan ne kene din eg-engkeran ka Balungbalung, wey kene eggendiye te baley ne due migpatey, minsan ke amey rin pad sikandin wey ke iney rin naa eyew kene eg-isipen ne malindit ka Balungbalung. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama. 13 Keilangan ne ware pad neyilabeti ka eg-asaween din. 14 Keilangan ne kene sikandin eg-asawa te malitan ne balu wey ke malitan naa ne in-engkeran te asawa rin wey ke malitan naa ne egpamelegye te lawa. Keilangan ne iyan din eg-asaween ka malitan ne ware pad neyilabeti wey karumaan din ded, 15 eyew kene egkalinditan ka kabuhalan din su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka migmatulus kandin.”

10 “And the Prominent Sacrificer is the leader of all the sacrificers. The oil was_poured to him in choosing him and given right to put_on the cloth of the sacrificer. So then he should not let_ his hair _unfixed and he should not tear his clothing. 11-12 And because he was_poured with oil in offering of him to me his God, he must not leave the tent, and must not go to the house that has someone_died, even if he is his father or mother so_that he won't be_considered dirty. I (am) the Lord God. 13 The one that he marries must be virgin (LIT not intercourse_with). 14 He must not marry a widow woman or woman divorced (LIT left) from his spouse or a prostitute woman (LIT woman that sells a body). He must marry a virgin woman (LIT not intercourse_with) and his relative, 15 so_that his descendant won't be dirtied because I (am) the Lord God who made_him_holy.”

16 Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 17 “Kahii nu si Aarun te kene egkaayun ne eg-uyan te egkakeen ne igpanubad diye te Manama ka me kabuhalan din ne nabalbalangan se lawa kuntee lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan din. 18 Kene egkaayun ka butud, pungku, nabalbalangan se ulaula wey ke lawa naa, 19 nahepu se paa wey ke belad naa, 20 napeku wey ke deisek ne etew, seeye se due dalu te mata wey ke seeye naa se due kehang, wey seeye se kene egpakaanak. 21 Kene egkaayun ne egpakapanubad te igdasag din te Magbebaye ne Manama ka nabalbalangan ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun ne talagpanubad. Ne tenged te nabalbalangan sikandin, kene sikandin egkaayun ne egpakahalad te egkakeen para te Manama. 22 Piru egpakakeen ded sikandin te igpanubad ne egkakeen diye te Manama, matulus ma wey se amana ne matulus ne egkakeen. 23 Piru tenged te nabalbalangan sikandin, keilangan ne kene sikandin egseled diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng wey ke diye naa te altar eyew kene din egkabaley-baley ka Matulus ne Ugpaan ku, su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne migmatulus te Balungbalung.”

16 And Muwisis was_told_again by the Lord, 17 “Tell(sg) Aarun that it's_ not _possible for his disable descendants to bring a sacrifice there to God today including all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed. 18 It's_ not _possible the blind, lame, deformed face or body, 19 broken foot or hand, 20 hunch_back or little person, those have disease in the eyes and those have sore, and those can't give_birth. 21 It's_ not _possible to sacrifice their offering to the Lord God those disabled descendants of Aarun the sacrificer. And due to his deformity, he can't offer food for God. 22 But he can still eat of the food that's sacrificed there to God, holy or very holy food. 23 But because he is disabled, he must not be entered there to Very Holy Room or to the altar so_that he won't insult/blaspheme the Holy Living_place of me, because I (am) the Lord who made_ the tent _holy.”

24 Purisu, ingguhud seini langun ni Muwisis ki Aarun wey te me anak din ne me lukes, wey te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil.

24 Therefore, Muwisis told this all to Aarun and to his male sons, and to all the descendants of Israil.

Ka me halad

The offerings

221 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu si Aarun wey ka me kabuhalan din te egpatantanuran kandan ka me halad te kabuhalan ni Israil keddi eyew kene egkabaley-baley ka matulus ne ngaran ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye. 3 Ne ka minsan hentew te me kabuhalan din lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan din, ne in-isip ne malindit ne egdani te egkakeen ne inhalad e keddi te kabuhalan ni Israil, egdeldelen e sikandin puun te tangkaan ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.

221 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) Aarun and his descendants that they were cautioned_about the offerings of the descendants of Israil of me so_that my name won't be mocked. I (am) the Lord. 3 And whoever of his descendants including all his descendant that will_follow, that considered dirty that draws_near the food that's offered already to me by the descendants of Israil, he will_be_expelled from in_front of me. I (am) the Lord.

4 “Kene egkaayun ne egkeen te egkakeen ne impanubad e ka kabuhalan ni Aarun ne duen e ibung wey ke duen naa eglihawang diye te lebut din. Egpakakeen de sikandin te egkakeen ne inhalad e ke egmalinis e sikandin. Ne eg-isipen man-e sikandin ne malindit ke egpakahen-gen sikandin te migpatey wey ke etew naa ne miglihawangan te muntus, 5 wey ke nakasamsam naa sikandin te mananap ne egdul-ug wey egpananap wey ke nakasamsam naa sikandin te etew ne in-isip ne malindit. 6 Ka minsan hentew ne talagpanubad ne egpakasamsam te minsan nekey te mananap ne egdul-ug wey egpananap wey te etew ne in-isip ne malindit, egmalindit taman te egkasagkup wey kene egpakakeen te egkakeen ne inhalad e, angin e ke egpamanihus sikandin. 7 Ne saliet de te eglineb e ka aldew, egmalinis e sikandin wey egpakakeen e sikandin te egkakeen ne inhalad e diye te Manama su sika iya ka pegkeen din. 8 Kene sikandin egkeen te minsan nekey ne napatey re due wey ke inggimatayan naa te duma ne mananap eyew kene sikandin egkeisip ne malindit. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.

4 “It's_ not _possible to eat a food that's offered already the descendant of Aarun who has leprosy or there's something that comes_out his butt. He can only eat food that's offered already when he is_cleaned already. He is also considered dirty if he can touch dead (one) or person that has a semen going_out, 5 or he touches an animal that crawls or creeps or he touches a person that's considered dirty. 6 Whoever sacrificer that touches whatever animal that crawls or creeps or a person that's considered dirty, (he) will_become_dirty until the sun_sets and can't eat a food that's offered already, except if he bathes. 7 And as_soon_as the sun sets, s/he will_become_clean and s/he can eat a food that's offered already to God because that's what_really his food. 8 S/he won't eat anything that just died or killed by other animal so_that s/he won't be_considered dirty. I (am) the Lord God.

9 “Keilangan ne egtumanen dan ka insuhu ku kandan eyew kene sikandan egpakasale wey kene egpatey tenged te pegsupak dan kayi. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne migmatulus kandan.

9 “They must fulfill what_ I _commanded them so_that they won't sin and they won't die because they will_disobey those that (are) my commands. I (am) the Lord who made_them_holy.

10 “Kene egpakakeen te inhalad ne egkakeen ka kene ne karumaan te me talagpanubad. Ne kene man-e egpakakeen due ka mahaliyug te talagpanubad wey ka insuulan din naa ne trabahanti. 11 Piru ka imbeli rin ne uripen wey ka neetew diye te baley rin, kaayun ded ne egpakakeen due. 12 Kene man-e egpakakeen te immanubad e ka me malitan ne anak te talagpanubad ne mig-asawa te kene ne talagpanubad. 13 Piru ke nabalu e ka malitan wey ke nekeg-engked naan e sikandin te asawa rin, wey ware nakaanak, egpakakeen e sikandin te pegkeen te amey rin. Piru kene iya egkaayun ne egkeen kayi ka kene ne karumaan te talagpanubad.

10 “Those who are not relatives of the sacrificers can't eat offered food. The visitor of the sacrificer and the worker_ which he _pays_for can't eat it also. 11 But the slave that he bought and the one_borne in his house, can eat it yet. 12 The female children of the sacrificer who married ones_ that are not _sacrificer also won't be_able_to_eat something_sacrificed already. 13 But if the woman is a widower or she's divorced with his spouse, she can eat the food of his father, and without child. But it is not really possible to eat it the ones_ not _relatives of sacrificer.

14 “Ke due egpakakeen te inhalad e ne ware din tuyui, eg-ulian din ka talagpanubad te nakeen din wey egtimulan din pad ka bali te nakeen din te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu. 15 Keilangan ne kene egkabaley-baley te talagpanubad ka inhalad e te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 16 Kene nu iya sikandan pakeena rue te inhalad e eyew kene sikandan egpakasale wey egparusaan. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne migmatulus kandan.”

14 “If there's one_unknowingly_eats something_offered already that he didn't mean, s/he will_repay the sacrificer of what_ s/he's _eaten and s/he will_add twenty (20) percent the amount of what_ s/he's _eaten. 15 The sacrificer must not mock/make_fun of what's_offered already by the descendants of Israil there to the Lord God. 16 Don't(sg) let_ them _eat that something_sacrificed already so_that they won't sin and be punished. I (am) the Lord who made_ them _holy.”

17 Ne migkahi man-e ka Magbebaye ki Muwisis, 18 “Kahii nu si Aarun wey ka me kabuhalan din ne me lukes wey ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil, wey ka me lapu te Israil. Emun ke iyan niyu igpanubad ka egtutungen ne igpanubad isip pegtuman te impahunlibet niyu wey ke igdasag niyu naa, 19 keilangan ne lukesan ne baka, lukesan ne karniru, wey ke kambing naa ne ware nabalbalangi eyew egdawaten ku ka igpanubad niyu. 20 [xr]Kene kew panubad te nabalbalangan su kene ku sika egdawaten. 21 Emun ke iyan niyu igpanubad ka igpanubad para te keupianan eyew igpanubad isip pegtuman te impahunlibet niyu wey ke igdasag naa, keilangan ne baka wey ke karniru naa ne ware nabalbalangi eyew egdawaten ku seini. 22 Kene egkaayun ne igpanubad keddi ka mananap ne butud, nalepuan, napalian, due kehang, wey due kaliskis. Kene egkaayun ne egtutungen sika diye te altar eyew igdasag keddi. 23 Egkaayun ne igpanubad niyu eyew igdasag ka baka wey ke nati te karniru naa ne nabalbalangan piru kene egkarawat ne igpanubad seini eyew te pegtuman te impahunlibet niyu ne eggimuwen. 24 Kene egkaayun ne igpanubad niyu keddi ka mananap ne nalupet se butu, napigse, nakepun wey ke napalian naa. Kene niyu iya seini himuwa diye te inged niyu.

17 And the Lord said to Muwisis again, 18 “Tell(sg) Aarun and his male descendants and all the descendants of Israil, and the ones_sojourned in Israil. If what_you(pl) sacrificed is the burnt_offering of fulfilling of_what_you(pl) sworn or gift, 19 (it) needs to be male cow, male sheep, or goat that's not deformed so_that I will_receive your(pl) sacrifice. 20 [xr]Don't(pl) sacrifice something_deformed because I won't accept that. 21 If what's you(pl) sacrifice is sacrificed for well-being in_order to sacrifice of fulfilling of what_ you(pl) _sworn or gift, it needs to be a cow or sheep with no defects so_that I will_accept it. 22 It's_ not _possible to sacrifice to me the animal that's blind, lame, wounded, with sore(s), or has disease on skin, has skin_sore. That's not possible to be_burned there to the altar in_order to offer_as_gift of me. 23 It's_possible that you(pl) sacrifice a cow or sheep that's deformed in_order to offer_as_gift but this is not be_accepted to sacrifice in_order to fulfill what_ you(pl) _promised to do. 24 It's_ not _possible that you(pl) sacrifice to me the animal that's crushed testicle, broke, castrated or wounded. Don't(pl) indeed do this there in your(pl) place.

25 “Kene egkaayun ne igmanubad niyu ka me ayam ne egkuen niyu puun te me lapu su in-isip sika ne nabalbalangan wey kene seini egdawaten.”

25 “It's_ not _possible that you(pl) sacrifice the animals that you(pl) get from the sojourners because that's considered disabled and this won't be accepted.”

26 Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 27 “Ka iyam eglesut ne baka, karniru wey ke kambing naa, keilangan ne kene pad egpitasen diye te iney te pitu ne aldew. Piru ke egsuble e te pitu ne aldew, egkaayun e ne igpanubad sika keddiey. 28 Kene niyu peglegsaa te egpanubad te sikan ded ne aldew ka talaanak ne baka, wey ke talaanak ne karniru. 29 Ke eggilang kew te igpanubad eyew te pegpasalamat keddi, ikula niyu ka eleg ne paahi te pegpanubad kayi eyew egdawaten ku seini. 30 Keilangan ne eg-aminen niyu re seini te egkeen te sikan de ne aldew wey kene kew sesame taman te egkapawe. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.

26 And Muwisis was_told again by the Lord God, 27 “If the calf/cow, sheep or goat newly borne, this must not be separated from the mother for seven days. But if it exceeds seven days, that's possible to sacrifice to me already. 28 Don't(pl) sacrifice at_the_same day the mother_and_her_young of cow, or the mother_and_her_young of sheep. 29 If you(pl) slaughter something to sacrifice in_order to thank me, follow(pl) the correct way of sacrificing it so_that I will_receive it. 30 It's_necessary that you(pl) eat this all on that day only and don't left_something until the next_day. I (am) the Lord God.

31 “Tantanuri niyu wey tumana niyu ka me suhu ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye. 32 Kene niyu balbalaya ka matulus ne ngaran ku wey keilangan ne eg-ileen a nikaniyu ne matulus. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ka migmatulus kaniyu, 33 wey migpaawe kaniyu puun te Ihiptu eyew egkeyimu a ne Manama niyu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye.”

31 “Be_mindful(pl) and fulfill(pl) my commands. I (am) the Lord. 32 Don't(pl) mock my holy name and it's_necessary that you(pl) acknowledge me as holy. I (am) the Lord who made_you(pl)_holy, 33 and one who_let_ you(pl) _leave from Ihiptu so_that I will_become your(pl) God. I (am) the Lord.”

(Num 28:16‑25)

231 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil te seini ka me sahakeen ne in-alam te Magbebaye ne keilangan ne eglibulung kew eyew te pegsimba te Magbebaye.

231 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that these (are) the feasts chosen by the Lord where you(pl) must gather_together in_order to worship the Lord.

Ka Aldew te Peggimeley

The Day of Resting

3 [xr]“Due hen-em ne aldew ne egpakatrabahu kew piru ka igkapitu ne aldew, sika ka Aldew te Peggimeley. Kene kew trabahu te sika ne aldew, ke kene, libulung kew eyew te pegsimba minsan hendei kew mig-ugpe, su aldew sika te pegsaye te Manama.

3 [xr]“There are six days which you(pl) can work but the seventh day, that's the Day of Resting. Don't(pl) work on that day, but rather, gather(pl) in_order to worship wherever you(pl) live, because that's a day of praising God.

4 “Seini ka me aldew ne in-alam te Magbebaye ne eglibulung kew eyew te pegsimba. Keilangan ne eggimuwen seini te intahahe ne timpu: 5 [xr]Ka Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan eggimuwen te marusilem te an-anayan ne bulan[fn] te ikasapulu wey hep-at (14) ne aldew. 6 [xr]Ka Sahakeen te Paan ne ware Patulin eggimuwen te igkasapulu wey lalimma (15) ne aldew te sikan ded ne bulan. Sahakeen kew te pitu ne aldew ne iyan egkeenen se paan ne ware patulin. 7 Te an-anayan ne aldew te pegsahakeen niyu, libulung kew eyew te pegsimba te Magbebaye ne Manama wey kene kew trabahu. 8 Pitu ne aldew ka pegpanubad niyu te egtutungen diye te Magbebaye. Te igkapitu ne aldew, kene kew trabahu wey libulung kew eyew te pegsimba te Magbebaye.”

4 “These (are) the days chosen by the Lord when you(pl) gather_together in_order to worship. It's_necessary that you(pl) do this on the appointed time: 5 [xr]The Feast of the Passover of the Angel is_celebrated on the night on the first month[fn] on the fourteenth (14) day. 6 [xr]The feast(pl) of the bread without leaven is_celebrated on the fifteenth (15) day of that same month. Feast for seven days and what_will_be_eaten is the bread without leaven. 7 On the first day of your(pl) gathering, gather(pl) in_order for worshiping the Lord God and don't(pl) work. 8 Your(pl) sacrificing of burned_offering there to the Lord will_be_seven days. On the seventh day, don't(pl) work and gather_together(pl) in_order for worshiping the Lord.”

Ka pegsahakeen te an-anayan ne eg-uma

The feast of the first harvest

9 Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 10 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil: Emun ke diye kew e te tane ne igbehey ku kaniyu, wey egpakahaani kew e te an-anayan ne eg-uma, uyan kew diye talagpanubad te senge-bagkes. 11 Ne igkayew rin seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye eyew egdawaten kew nikandin. Eggimuwen seini te talagpanubad te aldew ne egkeimpusan e ka Aldew te Peggimeley. 12 Te sikan ded man-e ne aldew, panubad kew e man-e diye te Magbebaye te nati ne karniru ne sabeka pad ne leg-un wey ware nabalbalangi eyew egtutungen ne igpanubad. 13 Parumeyi niyu seini te daruwa ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya ne insewuhan te mentika. Ighalad seini ne egkakeen diye te Magbebaye wey ka keemut kayi egpakahale kandin. Lagkesi niyu man-e te eghalad te eg-inumen ne binu ne senge-litru. 14 Ke ware kew pad nakahalad te mig-uma ne pinamula niyu, kene niyu pa seini keeni, meyilew ma seini wey ke insandag naa wey ke inggilutu naa ne paan. Sika ka tulumanen ne keilangan ne egtumanen niyu lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu minsan hendei kew eg-ugpe.

9 And Muwisis was_told again by the Lord, 10 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil: If you(pl) get_there already on the land/soil that I will_give to you(pl), and harvest already for the first crop, bring one sheaf there to the sacrificer. 11 And he will_raise it up there to the front of the Lord so_that he will_accept you(pl). The sacrificer will_do this on the day after the Day of Resting is done. 12 On that day also, sacrifice(pl) again to the Lord a young sheep that's just one year and not deformed in_order to be burned as sacrifice. 13 Add_along it two kilograms of very good flour mixed with oil. This is offered as food there to the Lord and the fragrance of it will_cause_him_to_be_glad to him. Include(pl) also to offer a drinking wine and the size is one liter. 14 If you(pl) were_ not _able_to_offer yet of your(pl) harvested crops, you(pl) don't eat from it yet, raw or roasted or baked bread. This is the ritual/regulation that you(pl) must fulfill including all your(pl) descendants who follow wherever you(pl) live.

Ka pegsahakeen te pegsawit

The feasting of first_fruits

(Num 28:26‑31)

(Num 28:26‑31)

15 [xr]“Seel kew naa te pitu ne simana pegkeimpus te Aldew te Peggimeley, te aldew ne mig-uyan kew te senge-bagkes ne ingkayew niyu. 16 Peglihad te pitu ne simana, bunsud kew e man-e seel taman te igkalalimma ne pulu ne aldew (50) wey halad kew e man-e diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te iyam ne halad ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula. 17 Ne minsan hendei kew eg-ugpe, halad kew te daruwa ne paan ne derakel ne inggimu puun te daruwa ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya, wey due patulin. Kayawa niyu seini eyew ighalad ne egkayawen. 18 Ne parumeyi niyu sika te pitu ne lukesan ne karniru ne tigsabeka pad ne leg-un se kabuyahi, sabeka ne turu ne baka, wey daruwa ne lukesan ne karniru ne ware nabalbalangi. Ipanubad niyu sika isip igpanubad ne egtutungen duma te halad ne egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne me pinamula lagkes ka halad ne inumen su ka keemut due egpakahale te Magbebaye. 19 Ne panubad kew man-e te sabeka ne lukesan ne kambing eyew igpalangesa ne ig-awe te sale, wey daruwa ne karniru ne sabeka pad ne leg-un ne para te keupianan. 20 Ne igkayew te talagpanubad diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ka daruwa ne karniru wey ka ighalad ne an-anayan ne eg-uma te me pinamula eyew igdasag te Manama. Ighalad iya seeye langun diye te Magbebaye wey baad iya seeye te me talagpanubad. 21 Te sikan ded man-e ne aldew kene kew trabahu wey libulung kew eyew te pegsimba te Magbebaye. Keilangan ne egtumanen niyu sika ne me tulumanen lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu, minsan hendei kew eg-ugpe.

15 [xr]“Count(pl) seven weeks when_ the Day for Resting _is_done, on the day that you(pl) brought one sheaf that you(pl) raised_up. 16 On the passing of seven weeks, begin(pl) again counting up_to fifty (50) days and you(pl) offer again a new food offering that's from plucked plants there to the Lord God. 17 And whenever you(pl) live, offer(pl) two large bread made from two kilograms of very good flour, and has leaven. Raise(pl)_it_up in_order to offer that will_be_raised. 18 And add_along that with seven male sheep that are one year, one bull cow, and two male sheep that are_ not _deformed. Sacrifice(pl) that in_order to be burned sacrifice together_with food offering that's from plucked plants including the drink offering because the fragrance of it will_cause_the_Lord_God_to_be_glad. 19 And sacrifice(pl) also one male goat in_order to blood_shed that's remove sin, and two sheep that are one year for well-being. 20 And the sacrificer raise_up to the Lord the two sheep and the first harvested crops offering in_order to give_as_gift to God. All of those will_be_really_offered to the Lord and those were really a portion of the sacrificers. 21 On that same day again don't(pl) work and gather_together in_order for worshiping the Lord. It's_necessary that you(pl) fulfill that ritual/regulation including all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed, wherever you(pl) live.

22 [xr]“ ‘Ke eggaani kew, kene niyu amina te eggaani ka diye te ilis te pinamulaan niyu, wey kene niyu pakilalawi seini. Igtahahe e seini te egkengaayu-ayu wey te me lapu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye niyu.’ ”

22 [xr]“ ‘If you(pl) are harvesting, don't(pl) harvest all that's there in the edge of your(pl) plantation, and don't(pl) glean it. Those are allocated to the poor and sojourners. I (am) your(pl) Lord.’ ”

23 Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 24 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil: Himeley kew te an-anayan ne aldew te igkapitu ne bulan. Ne emun ke egkarineg niyud ka dahing te me trumpita, libulung kew e eyew te pegsimba. 25 Keilangan ne kene kew trabahu te sika ne aldew wey panubad kew diye te Magbebaye te igpanubad ne egtutungen.”

And if you(pl) hear already the sound of the trumpets, gather(pl) in_order to worship. 25 It's_necessary that you(pl) won't work on that day and you(pl) sacrifice there to the Lord of burnt offering.”

Ka Aldew te Pegpasaylu te Sale

The Day of Forgiveness of Sin

(Num 29:7‑11)

(Num 29:7‑11)

26 [xr]Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye si Muwisis, 27 “Ka igkasapulu ne aldew te seini se igkapitu ne bulan, ka Aldew te Pegpasaylu te me sale niyu. Sika ne timpu ka peglibulung niyu eyew te pegsimba, ne puasa kew naa wey panubad kew te egtutungen para te Magbebaye. 28 Kene kew trabahu te sika ne aldew su sika ka Aldew te Pegpasaylu te me Sale, te pegpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale niyu diye te Magbebaye niyu. 29 Ka kene egpuasa te sika ne aldew, egdeldelen e puun te me karumaan din. 30 Ne ka minsan hentew ne egtrabahu te sika ne aldew, eggimatayan te Magbebaye. 31 Ne keilangan ne kene kew iya trabahu. Tulumanen seini ne ware egtamanan para kaniyu lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu, minsan hendei kew eg-ugpe. 32 Himeley kew te seini ne aldew wey keilangan ne egpuasa kew. 26 [xr]And Muwisis was_told again by the Lord, 27 “The tenth day of this seventh of month, is the Day of Forgiveness of your(pl) Sins. That's the time of your(pl) gathering in_order to worship, and you(pl) fast and sacrifice something_to_burn for the Lord. 28 Don't(pl) work on that day because that's the Day of Forgiveness, of blood_shedding in_order to clean your(pl) sins there to your(pl) Lord. 29 The one doesn't fast on that day, she/he will_be_expelled from his relatives. 30 And whoever works on that day, will_be_killed by the Lord. 31 And it's really necessary that you(pl) don't work. This is without end ritual/regulation for you(pl) and your(pl) descendants including the all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed, wherever you(pl) live. 32 Rest(pl) on that day and you(pl) need to fast. This begins on the afternoon of the ninth day of the seventh month and this ends on the afternoon of the tenth day.”
