The Feasting in Shelters

(Num 29:12‑40)

(Num 29:12‑40)

33 [xr]Ne migkahiyan e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 34 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil: Ka Sahakeen diye te me Leeb para te Magbebaye, eggimuwen te igkasapulu wey lalimma ne aldew te igkapitu ne bulan. Sahakeen kew te pitu ne aldew. 35 Te an-anayan ne aldew, kene kew trabahu wey libulung kew te pegsimba te Magbebaye. 36 Panubad kew te egtutungen diye te Manama te pitu ne aldew wey libulung kew eyew te pegsimba te Magbebaye te igkawalu ne aldew, wey panubad kew te egtutungen. Katammanan seini te pegsahakeen niyu, purisu kene kew trabahu.

33 [xr]And Muwisis was_told again by the Lord God, 34 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil: The Feast in Shelter for the Lord, will_be_celebrated on the fifteenth day of the seventh month. Feast(pl) for seven days. 35 On the first day, don't(pl) work and gather_together(pl) to worship the Lord. 36 Sacrifice(pl) a burnt_offering there to God for seven days and gather_together(pl) in_order for worshiping the Lord on the eighth day, and sacrifice a burnt_offering. This is the ending of your(pl) feasting, therefore don't(pl) work.

37 “Seini ka in-alam ne me sahakeen te Magbebaye ne eglibulung kew eyew egsimba kandin, wey panubad kew te egtutungen ne igpanubad, halad kew te egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne pinamula, igmanubad wey me halad ne igkeinum te timpu te intahahe ne pegsahakeen niyu. 38 Ne ihalad niyu sika timul te me dasag niyu, te me halad niyu te pegtuman te impahunlibet niyu, wey te me dasag niyu diye te Magbebaye. Ka sika ne sahakeen timul te Aldew te Peggimeley ne eggimuwen niyu tagse simana.

37 “These (are) the chosen feasts of the Lord that you(pl) gather_together in_order to worship God, and you(pl) sacrifice a burnt sacrifice, offer food that's from the plucked_plants, sacrifices and drinking offerring at the appointed time of your(pl) feasting. 38 And offer that in_addition of your(pl) gifts, your(pl) offerings in fulfilling what_ you(pl) _sworn, and your(pl) gifts to the Lord. That feast is addition of Day of Resting that you(pl) do every week.

39 “Ke egkatines niyud ka me uma niyu, sahakeen kew para te Magbebaye te igkasapulu wey lalimma (15) ne aldew te igkapitu ne bulan. Sahakeen kew te pitu ne aldew; kene kew trabahu te an-anayan ne aldew wey te igkawalu ne aldew. 40 Te an-anayan ne aldew, kuwa kew te amana ne meupiya ne behas te me kayu, me pakew te palmira, me sugpang te mallapung ne me kayu, wey ka me kayu-kayu diye te ilis te bangalug. Ne gale-gale kew te pitu ne aldew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 41 Sahakeen kew para te Magbebaye te pitu ne aldew te igkapitu ne bulan te tagse leg-un, wey tantanuri niyu seini lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu. 42 Sikaniyu langun se mahinged te Israil, diye kew re ugpe te me leeb niyu taman te pitu ne aldew, 43 eyew egpakanengneng ka kabuhalan niyu keureme ne impalihawang ku ka kabuhalan ni Israil puun te Ihiptu wey impeugpe ku sikandan te me leeb. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

39 “If you(pl) can_store already your(pl) harvests, you(pl) feast for the Lord on the fifteenth (15) day on the seventh month. Feast(pl) for seven days; don't(pl) work on the first day and on the eighth day. 40 On the first day, get(pl) a very good fruits of trees, branches of palm, branches of leafy trees, and bush_trees there on the edge of valleys. And rejoice(pl) for seven days there in the front of the Lord. 41 You(pl) feast for the Lord in seven days in seventh month in every year, and be_mindful of it including the all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed. 42 You(pl) all who are residents in Israil, just live(pl) there in your(pl) shelters until seven days, 43 so_that your(pl) descendants in_the_future will_know that I have caused_ the descendants of Israil _to_go_out from Ihiptu and caused_ them _to_live in the shelters. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.”

44 Sika ka in-alam ne me sahakeen te Magbebaye ne ingguhud ni Muwisis diye te kabuhalan ni Israil.

44 Those (were) the chosen feasts of the Lord that Muwisis told there to descendants of Israil.

Ka lana ne igtubil te me sulu

The oil that fuels the lamps

(Iks 27:20‑21)

(Exo 27:20‑21)

241 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te egpeuyanen te mating-ew ne lana te ulibu eyew igtubil te sulu eyew kene seini egkeebukan. 3 Keilangan ne egpareketan ni Aarun ka sulu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te tangkaan te hinabel ne indingding te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, ne diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey kene eg-ebukan seini taman te maselem. Tulumanen seini ne keilangan ne egtumanen niyu lagkes ka langun ne egpakasinundul pad ne kabuhalan niyu. 4 Ne keilangan ne ig-untud ni Aarun ka me sulu diye te tahuanan te sulu ne bulawan eyew eglayag layun seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

241 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil to bring a clear olive oil in_order to fuel the light so_that it can't be_extinguished. 3 Aarun must light the lamp there in_front of the Lord God there in front of the cloth that's block the Container of the Agreement, which is in Tent of Meeting, and won't be_extinguished it until the morning. This ritual/regulation must be_fulfilled by you(pl) including the all your(pl) descendants that will_be_followed. 4 And it's_necessary that Aarun puts_on the lamps there on the lamp container so_that it will_light_on always there in the front of the Lord God.

Ka paan ne ighalad diye te Manama

The bread that's offered to God

5 [xr]“Ne kuwa kew te daruwa ne kilu te harina ne amana ne meupiya wey hilutu kew te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne paan. 6 Keilangan ne egbaaren niyu seini te daruwa ne baad. Tighen-em ka tagse baad wey meg-un-untura niyu diye te lamisa ne impulitan te bulawan. 7 Sewuhi niyu te meemut ne insinsu ka tagse dangdang te daruwa ne baad ne paan. Ka insinsu ne egtutungen iyan pegpapitew ne ka langun nakapanubad e te Magbebaye ne Manama. 8 Keilangan ne layun egtahu si Aarun te paan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, tagse Aldew te Peggimeley. Sika ka layun niyu igbehey te Manama te ware egtamanan. 9 [xr]Si Aarun wey ka me anak din iyan egpakakamuney te paan ne ighalad, wey diye dan de seini egkeena te Matulus ne Sinabeng, tenged su amana ma ne matulus seini para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Kene egkataman ka pegdawat dan te seini ne paan.”

5 [xr]“Get(pl) two kilograms of very good flour and bake(pl) twelve (12) loaves_of_bread. 6 And you(pl) must divide it to two portions. Six_loaves of one_portion and pile_on_top_of_each_other there on the table that's plustered with gold. 7 Mix(pl) a fragrant incense each side of the two portions of bread. The incense to be burned show that all were already sacrificed to the Lord God. 8 It's_necessary that Aarun puts a bread always there in the front of the Lord God, every Day of Resting. That's what_ you(pl) _give always to God forever. 9 [xr]Aarun and his children (are) the ones_to_own the bread that's sacrificed, and they will_eat this only in the Holy Room, because it is very holy for the Lord God. Their receiving of this bread won't end.”

Ka pegbatu te etew ne migbaley-baley te Manama

The stoning of those who mocked God

10 Ne due etew ne matig-Ihiptu se amey wey kabuhalan ni Israil ka iney. Ka ngaran te iney rin, si Silumit ne anak ni Dibri ne kabuhalan ni Dan. Ka seini ne etew migpakig-ehet te sabeka ne kabuhalan ni Israil diye te kampu, 11 wey imbaley-baley rin wey indilus ka ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama. Purisu in-uyan dan e sikandin diye ki Muwisis. 12 Ne imprisu ran pad sikandin taheed te ware pad nanengnengi ka igkeupii te Magbebaye ne Manama ne eggimuwen diye te kandin.

10 And there's a man whose father was from_Ihiptu and his mother was descendant of Israil. The name of his mother, was Silumit the child of Dibri who was a descendant of Dan. This person fought with one descendant of Israil there in the camp, 11 and he mocked and cursed the name of the Lord God. Therefore they brought him there to Muwisis. 12 And they imprisoned him while they didn't know yet what_ the Lord God _wills to do with him.

13 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 14 “Ipalihawang niyu ka etew ne migbaley-baley keddi. Ne ka langun ne nakarineg te pegbaley-baley rin, egtel-eb te belad dan diye te ulu rin, wey egbatuwen sikandin te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. 15 Ne kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne ka egbaley-baley te Manama rin, keilangan ne eglegparan iya. 16 Ka egbaley-baley te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama, keilangan ne eggimatayan iya. Igpabatu sikandin te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne egpeg-ilingen de iya ka lapu wey ka mahinged ne egbaley-baley te Manama, keilangan ne eggimatayan iya.”

13 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 14 “Bring_out(pl) the person who mocked me. And all who heard his mocking, put_ their hands _over his head, and he will_be_stoned by all descendants of Israil. 15 And tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that (whoever) mocks his God, must be_punished indeed. 16 The (one who) mocks the name of the Lord God, must be_killed indeed. S/he will_be_stoned by all descendants of Israil. And the sojourner and the residents who mocks God be_treated_the_same, (s/he) must be_killed indeed.”

17 [xr]“Ka egpakapatey te etew keilangan ne eggimatayan degma, 18 wey ka egpakapatey te ayam te senge-etew, keilangan ne egliwanan din ka neyimatayan din. Tantanuri niyu ne ka umul, egbayaran ded degma te umul.

17 [xr]“The one_who_killed a person must be_killed also, 18 and one_who_killed an animal of other people, s/he must replace what_ s/he _killed. Be_mindful that life, will_be_paid by life also.

19 “Ke due etew ne nekeyimu te mareet diye te duma rin, sikan ded degma ka eggimuwen diye te kandin. 20 [xr]Ka nakalepu te senge-etew, eglepuan ded degma; ka nakabutud te senge-etew, egbuturen degma; ka nakabingew te senge-etew, egbingawan degma. Ne, ka nekeyimu te mareet diye te duma rin, sikan ded degma ka eggimuwen diye te kandin. 21 Ka nakapatey te ayam te senge-etew, keilangan ne egliwanan din ka neyimatayan din, piru ka nakapatey te etew, keilangan ne eggimatayan degma. 22 [xr]Para te langun ka sika ne balaud, mahinged ma wey se lapu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.”

19 “If there's person made bad on his companion, that same_thing will_be_done to him also. 20 [xr]The one_who_lamed other person, be_lamed also; the one_who_blinded other person, be_blinded also; the one_who_lost_ the _tooth of other person, be_lost_tooth also. And, the person made bad on his companion, that same_thing will_be_done to him also. 21 The one_who_killed an animal of other person, s/he must replace what_ s/he _killed, but the one_who_killed a person, must be_killed also. 22 [xr]That law is for all, sojourner or resident. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.”

23 Ne miglalahan e ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Israil. Pegkapenga rin te eglalag, in-uyan dan e diye te mariyu te kampu ka etew ne migbaley-baley te Manama. Ne imbebatu ran e sikandin su seeye ma iya ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

23 And Muwisis spoken to the descendants of Israil. When he finished speaking, they took the person who mocked God there far from the camp. And they stoned him because that's what_ the Lord God _commanded to Muwisis.

Ka igkapitu ne leg-un

The seventh year

(Diy 15:1‑11)

(Deu 15:1‑11)

251 [xr]Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis diye te Bubungan ne Sinay, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te emun ke diye kew e te tane ne igbehey ku kaniyu, kene niyu pa pamulei ka tane te tagse igkapitu ne leg-un su egpeyimelayen pad te Magbebaye ne Manama. 3 Egpakapamula kew, egpakapanengul kew te parasan niyu wey egpakapamupu kew te me behas te pinamula niyu, seled te hen-em ne leg-un. 4 Piru te igkapitu e ne leg-un, keilangan ne kene niyu egtrabahuwen ka tane niyu. Kene niyu pamulei ka me kamet niyu wey kene niyu man-e panenguli ka me parasan niyu. 5 Kene niyu gaaniya ka me pinamula niyu ne nanubu de due diye te inggaaniyan niyu wey kene niyu pamupuwa ka behas te me paras ne ware napanenguli. Keilangan man-e ne kene niyu egtrabahuwen ka tane te sika ne leg-un eyew egpekeyimmeley. 6 Piru egpakakuwa kew red te egkeenen niyu puun dutu, wey ka me uripen niyu, ka me suluhuanen niyu, ka me lapu ne mig-ugpe te marani niyu, 7 ka me ayam niyu, wey ka me mahintalunan ne diye te tane niyu. Egkaayun ne egkeenen niyu ka minsan nekey ne uma te tane.

251 [xr]And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God there in the Mount Sinay, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that if you(pl) get_there in the land which I give to you(pl), don't(pl) plant the (pl) land every seventh year because the Lord God will_cause_(it)_to_rest. 3 You(pl) can plant, trim(pl) your(pl) grapevines and harvest(pl) the fruits of your(pl) plants, for six years. 4 But on the seventh year, it's_necessary that you(pl) won't work your(pl) land. Don't(pl) plant your(pl) fields and also don't trim your(pl) grapevines. 5 Don't(pl) harvest your(pl) plants that grow themselves there where_ you(pl) _harvested_crops and don't(pl) harvest the fruits of the grapevines that are_ not _trimmed. It's_necessary also_that you(pl) don't work_on the land on that year so_that (it) can_rest. 6 But you(pl) can still get food_to_eat from it, and your(pl) slaves, your(pl) servants, the sojourners who live near you(pl), 7 your(pl) domestic_animals, and the wild_animals that there in your(pl) land. It's_possible that you(pl) eat any thing that's produced by land.

Ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan

The Year of Being_Rescued

8 “Ne keilangan ne egseel kew te pitu ne leg-un ne peggimeley. Ne kapapituwa niyu sika se pitu ne leg-un ne peggimeley eyew egkeyimu ne hep-at ne pulu wey siyam (49) ne leg-un. 9 Parahinga niyu te derahingi ka me trumpita te minsan hendei, te igkapitu ne bulan ne Aldew red degma te Pegpasaylu te me Sale niyu. 10 Matulusa niyu ka igkalalimma ne pulu (50) ne leg-un wey behayi niyu te kaligwangan ka langun ne nangugpe te tane niyu. Leg-un te Kaligwangan seini su egpakalibed kaniyu ka me kasangkapan ne nakabelegye niyu. Egbehayan degma te kaligwangan ka neneuripen ne egpekeuli diye te pamilya ran wey diye te me karumaan dan. 11 Ka igkalalimma (50) ne pulu ne leg-un, ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan para kaniyu. Ne keilangan ne kene niyu egpamulaan ka me kamet niyu wey ke eggaaniyan naa ka pinamula ne nanubu de due wey ke egpamupuwen naa ka behas te paras ne ware napanenguli. 12 Matulus sika ne leg-un para kaniyu su due Kaligwangan niyu wey egpakakeen kew red te me behas te me pinamula niyu.

8 “And it's_necessary that you(pl) count seven years of resting. And that seven years of resting make_it_seven_times so_that it_becomes forty_nine (49) years. 9 Sound(pl) loudly the trumpets everywhere, on the seventh month that Day also of Forgiveness of your(pl) Sins. 10 Make_ the fiftieth (50) year _holy(pl) and give freedom to all the inhabitants of your(pl) land. This is Year of Being_Rescued because your(pl) possessions that you(pl) sold will_return to you(pl). The ones_enslaves are given also freedom to go_home to their family and there to their relatives. 11 The fiftieth (50) year, is the Year of Being_Rescued for you(pl). And it's_necessary that you(pl) won't plant your(pl) fields or harvest the plants that just grow or harvest the fruits of the grapevines that are_ not _trimmed. 12 That year is holy for you(pl) because there_is freedom of you(pl) and you(pl) can still eat the fruits of your(pl) plants.

13 “Te Leg-un te Kaligwangan, ilibed niyu diye te kamuney ka kasangkapan ne nakabelegye din kaniyu. 14 Ke egbelegye kew te tane diye te duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil wey ke egbeli kew naa, kene kew pale-leihey. 15 Ne emun egbeli kew te tane diye te duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil, seela niyu ke pila naan de ne leg-un ka nahaat ne eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan, wey alahaa niyu re ka kentiddad ke kapapila naan de egpakahaani. 16 Ke pila pad ne leg-un ne human ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan, egdakel degma ka kentiddad kayi piru ke malepet naan de, deisek naan de degma ka kentiddad due. Su ka malehet, kene ne ka tane ka imbeli niyu, ke kene, ka karakel te egkahaani. 17 Purisu kene kew pale-leihey, ke kene, kaaldeki niyu ka Manama niyu su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

13 “On the Year of Being_Rescued, return(pl) to the owner the materials that he has sold to you(pl). 14 If you(pl) sell a land to your(pl) companion who is a descendant of Israil or buy(pl), don't(pl) take_advantage_to_each_other. 15 If you(pl) buy a land to your(pl) companion who is a descendant of Israil, count(pl) how many years left and the Year of Being_Rescued comes, and just fit the amount on how_many_times someone_can_harvest. 16 If the Year of Being_Rescued for comes in few years yet, the price of it will_become_big also but if (the time) is short, the price also is small. Because the truth, is that you(pl) didn't buy the land, but rather, the amount what_is_harvested. 17 Therefore don't(pl) take_advantage_to_each_other, but rather, fear(pl) your(pl) God because I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.

18 “Tumana niyu iya ka me balaud wey me suhu ne igpeyimu ku kaniyu eyew egpekeugpe kew diye te tane ne ware igkabantali. 19 Ne dakel ka eg-uma te tane wey kene kew e egkaawaan te egkakeen, wey eg-ugpe kew ne warad e egpammitawen.

18 “Fulfill(pl) indeed my laws and my commands that I cause_ you(pl) _to_do so_that you(pl) will_be_able_to_live there on the land that has_nothing to_be_anxious_about. 19 And the land produce abundance and you(pl) won't run_out of food, and you(pl) live with nothing to look_for.

20 “Piru ke eg-inse kew ke nekey ka egkeenen niyu te igkapitu ne leg-un te kene kew ma egpakapamula wey ke egpakahaani naa, 21 egpanalanginan ku sikaniyu te igkeem-em ne leg-un eyew egpakahaani kew te egkakeen ne eleg te tatelu ne leg-un. 22 Purisu taheed te egpamula kew te igkawalu ne leg-un, iyan niyu pad egkakeen ka nahaani niyu te igkeen-em ne leg-un, wey dakel pad ka egkakeen niyu taman te tinggaani e te igkasiyam ne leg-un.

20 “But if you(pl) ask what you(pl) eat on the seventh year which you(pl) can't plant or harvest, 21 the Lord God will_bless you(pl) in sixth year so_that you(pl) can_harvest something_to_eat that's good for three years. 22 Therefore while you(pl) are_planting on the eighth year, what_ you(pl) _eat is the one you(pl) harvested on the sixth year, and you(pl) have plenty to eat until the harvest_time on the ninth month.

Ka peg-uli te me kasangkapan

The returning of the materials

23 “Kene kew bebelegye te tane ne kene niyud egkaawi, su sikeddiey ka kamuney te tane. Impeugpaan ku re sika kaniyu wey impalapuan ku re sika kaniyu.

23 “Don't(pl) sell a land that you(pl) can't get_back, because I (am) the owner of the land. I am just causing_ you(pl) _to_live_on it and I'm just causing_ you(pl) _to_be_foreigners there.

24 “Purisu ipaawi niyu red te kamuney ka tane din puun kaniyu. Himuwa niyu seini te langun ne tane ne egkabeli niyu. 25 Ke naayu-ayu e ka duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil wey egkapehes e sikandin ne egbelegye te tane din, kaayun ne ka amana rin pad iya ne karumaan ka eglekat due. 26 Piru ke ware karumaan din ne egpakalekat te nabelegye din, sikandin ded ka eglekat due ke egmatubung e man-e sikandin. 27 Keilangan ne egbayaran din langun ka kentiddad te egkahaani puun te tane din taman te eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. Ne egkaawi din e ka tane din. 28 Piru ke kene ne eleg ka iglekat din, kene din pad egkaawi seini diye te nabelegyaan din taman te eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. Te sika ne leg-un, egkaawi din e ka tane din ne warad bayad.

24 “There just cause_ the owner _to_get_back his land from you(pl). Do(pl) this for all land that_ you(pl) _buy. 25 If your(pl) companion who is a descendant of Israil becomes_poor and he will_be_forced to sell his land, it's_possible that his close relative will_redeem it. 26 But if he has no relative who can redeem what_ he _sold, he is still the one to redeem it when he becomes_abundant already. 27 It's_necessary that he pays all the price of something_harvested from his land until the Year of Being_Rescued comes. And he can get_back his land. 28 If what_ he _redeem is not enough, he can't get_ it _back yet from the one_ he _sold_it_to until the Year of Being_Rescued comes. On that year, he can get_back his land without payment.

29 “Ke due etew ne migbelegye te baley rin ne nakaseled te alad te siyudad, egkaayun pad ne eglekaten din seeye seled te sabeka ne leg-un. 30 Piru ke kene din egkalekat seeye seled te sabeka ne leg-un, iyan e egpakakamuney dutu ka nakabeli wey ka me kabuhalan din keureme, minsan ke eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. 31 Piru ka me baley ne diye te me bariyu ne ware nalinguti te alad, eg-isipen ne iling te me kamet, egkaayun ne eglekaten te kamuney te Leg-un te Kaligwangan.

29 “If there's a person that sold his house that's inside the wall/fence of the city, it possible for him to redeem it for (LIT inside) one year. 30 But if he can't redeem it for one year, the one to_own it is the one_who_bought_it and his future descendants, even if the Year of Being_Rescued comes. 31 But the houses there at the villages not surrounded with fence/wall, will_be_considered that like the fields, it's_possible to redeem by the owner on the Year of Being_Rescued.

32 “Piru ka me baley te me Libita ne diye te me siyudad dan, egkaayun mule ne eglekaten dan te minsan ken-u. 33 Ke kene dan seeye egkalekat, ig-uli seeye diye te kandan te timpu te Leg-un te Kaligwangan, su ka me baley ne diye te siyudad, baad dan iya puun te me karumaan dan ne kabuhalan ni Israil. 34 Piru ka me panabtaban ne diye lenged te me siyudad dan, keilangan ne kene dan igbelegye su kandan ma iya seini te ware egtamanan.

32 “But the houses of the Levites that are in the cities of_them, it's_possible for them to redeem any time. 33 If they can't redeem those, those will_be_returned to them by the time of the Year of Being_Rescued, because the houses there in the city, are their share from their relatives the descendants of Israil. 34 But the grazing_places there near their cities, it's_necessary that they don't(pl) sell_it because it's indeed theirs without ending.

Ka pegpasambey te egkaayu-ayu

The lending to a poor

35 [xr]“Ke warad egkeyimu te duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil wey kenad e egpekeyimu ne eg-uyag-uyag, bulihi niyu sikandin iling te pegbulig niyu te lapu wey ke mahaliyug naa eyew egpakalemung ded sikandin kaniyu. 36 Pasambaya niyu sikandin te seleppi piru kene niyu paanaki ka egsambayan din, ke kene, kaaldeki niyu ka Manama niyu eyew egpakalemung ded sikandin kaniyu. 37 [xr]Kene niyu paanaki ka seleppi ne impasambayan niyu kandin wey kene niyu pasubleyi ka bayad te keenen ne igpakeen niyu kandin. 38 Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne migpalihawang kaniyu puun te Ihiptu eyew igbehey kaniyu ka inged te Kanaan wey eyew egkeyimu a ne Manama niyu.

35 [xr]“If your(pl) relative descendant of Israil has nothing_anymore and is not able to make_a_living, help(pl) him like your(pl) helping of sojourners or visitors so_that he can continue living_among you(pl). 36 Lend(pl) him money but don't(pl) take_interest (LIT have_child) what he/she lend, but rather, fear(pl) your(pl) God so_that he can continue living_among you(pl). 37 [xr]Don't(pl) take_interest on your(pl) money that you(pl) lended to him and don't(pl) ask_excessive payment for what_ you(pl) _fed to him. 38 I (am) the Lord your(pl) God who cause_ you(pl) _to_leave from Ihiptu in_order to give you(pl) the land Kanan and in_order that I become your(pl) God.

Ka pegpaawe te me uripen

The causing_of_slaves_to_leave

39 [xr]“Ke warad egkeyimu te duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne egkapehes e sikandin ne egpeuripen kaniyu, kene niyu patrabahuwa sikandin iling te uripen. 40 Isipa niyu sikandin ne egsuulan ne trabahanti wey iling te lapu. Egtrabahu sikandin kaniyu taman te Leg-un te Kaligwangan. 41 Te sika ne leg-un, ipaawe niyud e sikandin wey ka me anak din wey egpakalibed e sikandan diye te karumaan dan, wey diye te tane te kaap-apuan dan. 42 Impaawe ku sikandan puun te Ihiptu, purisu kene egkaayun ne igbelegye sikandan eyew igpeuripen. 43 Kene niyu de-deeha ka duma niyu, ke kene, kaaldeki a nikaniyu ne Manama niyu. 44 Ne egkaayun ne egpekeuuripen kew te lukes wey malitan piru beliya niyu sikandan diye te marani niyu re ne me inged. 45 Egpakabeli kew man-e te me etew ne miglapu kaniyu wey ke me sakup naa te pamilya ran ne neetew te inged niyu. Ka me uripen ne nabeli niyu puun kandan, eg-uripenen iya. 46 Ne egkaayun ne igpeuripen niyud e man-e sikandan te me anak niyu wey egkeuripen sikandan taman te egpatey sikandan. Piru kene niyu iya de-deeha ka duma niyu ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne egkeuripen niyu.

39 [xr]“If your(pl) relative descendant of Israil has nothing_anymore and he is forced to be your(pl) slave, don't(pl) make_ him _work like a slave. 40 Consider(pl) him as paid worker and like a sojourner. He will_work for you(pl) until the Year of Being_Rescued. 41 On that year, let_ him _go and his children and they will_be_able_to_return to their relatives, and there at the land of their ancestors. 42 I caused_ them _to_leave from Ihiptu, therefore it's_ not _possible that they will_be_sold in_order to become_slaves. 43 Don't(pl) oppress your(pl) companion, but rather, fear me your(pl) God. 44 And it's_possible for you(pl) to have_ male and female _slaves but buy(pl) them there at places near you(pl). 45 You(pl) can also buy people who sojourned at you(pl) or members of their family who are born in your(pl) place. The slaves that you(pl) bought from them, will_be_enslaved indeed. 46 And it's_possible that you(pl) enslave them with your(pl) children also and they will_be_enslaved until they die. But don't(pl) oppress your(pl) companion descendant of Israil that becomes_ your(pl) _slave.

47 “Emun ke due lapu de ne naratu, wey due karumaan niyu ne warad iya egkeyimu, wey imbelegye din e ka pegkeetew rin diye te naratu eyew egpeuripen, 48 egkaayun ded ne eglekaten sikandin te duma rin ne kabuhalan ni Israil 49 ne anggam wey ke suled din naa, wey ke minsan hentew ne amana rin pad iya ne karumaan wey ke duen naan e seleppi din ne igbayad din te kaligwangan din. 50 Ka eggimuwen din duma te lapu ne nakabeli kandin, egseelen dan ke pile e ne leg-un ne neuripen sikandin wey ke pila naan de ne leg-un ne eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. Ke pila naan de ne leg-un ka nasame, sikan naan de ka egbayaran din ne igpeiling te igbayad te egsuulan ne trabahanti. 51 Ke mananey pad egginguma ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan, dakel degma ka igbayad din te kaligwangan din. 52 Ke mahaan e, deisek naan de degma ka igbayad din te kaligwangan din. Ne ka bali te igbayad din, igpeiling te bayad te egsuulan ne trabahanti. 53 Keilangan ne eg-isipen sikandin ne trabahanti te seeye se lapu ne nakabeli kandin, wey keilangan ne kene sikandin egle-leihen. 54 Ne emun ke ware egpakalekat kandin wey ware seleppi ne igbayad te kaligwangan din, egpakaligwang ded sikandin wey ka me anak din ke eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. 55 Su sikeddiey re ka ahalen te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne me suluhuanen ku. Sikandan ka me suluhuanen ku ne impalihawang ku puun te Ihiptu. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.

47 “If there's a sojourner who becomes_rich, and you(pl) have a relative/companion who has nothing_anymore indeed, and sold him self there to the one who_becomes_rich in_order to become_slave, 48 it's_possible that he will_be_redeemed by his relative descendant of Israil 49 uncle or his brother/cousin, or whoever that is a relative close to him or if he has money that he pays for his freedom. 50 What he does with the one_who_buys him, they will_count how many years that he became_slave or how many years left and the Year of Being_Rescued comes. If the years left are few only, that's what he pays which is made_identical with the payment of paid worker. 51 If the Year of Being_Rescued comes long yet, what_ he _pays for his freedom will_be_big/much also. 52 If it's closer, what_he_pays for his freedom will_be_small also. And the price of what_he_pays, is made_identical with the payment of paid worker. 53 He must be_considered by the sojourner who_bought him as paid worker, and not be_oppressed by him. 54 And if no_(one) is able_to_redeem him and no money that pays for his freedom, he and his children will_be_free when the Year of Being_Rescued comes. 55 Because I am only the master of the descendants of Israil who (are) my servant. They (are) my servant that I caused_to_go_out from there in Ihiptu. I (am) the Lord your(pl) God.

Ka me unag te seeye se matinumanen

The reward of those obedient

(Diy 7:12‑24; 28:1‑1 28:1‑14)

(Deu 7:12‑24; 28:1‑1 28:1‑14)

261 [xra][xrb]“ ‘Kene kew himu te me diyus-diyus ne larawan, batu ne limlimuan, sungkaleg wey ke ingkulit naa ne batu eyew egsimbeen niyu, su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 2 Himeley kew te Aldew te Peggimeley, wey tahura niyu ka ugpaanan ku. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.

261 [xra][xrb]“ ‘Don't(pl) make false_gods that's statue, stone of remembrance, post or carved stones in_order that you(pl) worship, because I (am) the Lord your(pl) God. 2 Rest(pl) on the Day of Resting, and respect(pl) my living_place. I (am) the Lord God.

3 “ ‘Ke eg-ikulen niyu ka me balaud wey egtumanen niyu ka me suhu ku, 4 egpeuranen ku te timpu te ting-uran eyew egdakel ka eg-uma wey egpakapamehas ka me kayu niyu. 5 Te kene kew pad egpekeimpus ka egmandiriek, egkengeyinuhan e ka me behas te paras, wey te kene kew pad egpekeimpus ka egpamupu te behas te paras, egpamula kew e man-e. Ne dakel amana ka egkakeen niyu wey egmatubung kew te peg-ugpe niyu.

3 “ ‘If you(pl) follow my laws and fulfill(pl) my commands, 4 I cause_rain_to pour at the time of raining in_order that the harvest will_increase and your(pl) trees cause_to_bear_fruits. 5 Before you(pl) are done threshing, the fruits of grapevines will_become_ripe, and before you(pl) are done harvesting the fruits of grapevines, you(pl) are_planting again. And you(pl) have plenty to eat and become_abundant in your(pl) living.

6 “ ‘Ne due keupianan te nasud niyu wey egmanlipereng kew ne warad igkengabantali. Eg-alawen ku ka mabbulut ne mananap diye te tane niyu wey igpariyu ku sikaniyu te gira. 7 Ne sikaniyud e nasi ka egpanalukun te me kuntere niyu wey egpangimatayan niyu sikandan te me kampilan niyu. 8 Ka lalimma kaniyu, egpakapatey te sabeka ne gatus (100), wey ka sabeka ne gatus (100) kaniyu, egpakapatey te sapulu ne libu (10,000). 9 Egpanalanginan ku sikaniyu, egpamatubungen ku wey egpamasuluhen, wey egtumanen ku ka kasabutan ku kaniyu. 10 Ne kene niyu egkaamin te egkeen ka nahaani niyu. Egpangaween niyu naan de ka an-anayan ne nahaani niyu wey egliwanan te iyam ne eg-uma. 11 Eglemung a kaniyu wey kene ku sikaniyu eg-engkeran. 12 Egdumaan ku sikaniyu wey egkeyimu a ne Manama niyu wey egkeyimu kew degma ne keet-etawan ku. 13 Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne migpalihawang kaniyu puun te Ihiptu eyew kene kew e egkeuripen. Impalihawang kud sikaniyu purisu kene kew e kengeyilew.[fn]

6 “ ‘And there's well_being in your(pl) nation and you(pl) sleep nothing_to_worry_about. I will_send_away the fierce animals there in your(pl) land and I cause_ you(pl) _to_be_away from war/battle. 7 And you(pl) instead be_the (one)_to_chase your(pl) enemies and kill(pl) them with your(pl) swords. 8 Five of you(pl), can_kill one hundred (100), and one hundred (100) of you(pl), can_kill ten thousand (10,000). 9 I will_bless you(pl), I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_become_abundant and to_become_many, and I will_fulfill my agreement with you(pl). 10 And you(pl) won't eat_all what_ you(pl) _harvested. You(pl) are just to remove your(pl) first harvest and replace with new harvest. 11 I will_live_among you(pl) and I won't leave you(pl). 12 I will_accompany you(pl) and I will_become your(pl) God and you(pl) will_become my people also. 13 I (am) the Lord God who caused_ you(pl) _to_leave from Ihiptu in_order that you(pl) won't become_slaves anymore. I caused_ you(pl) _to_go_out therefore don't be ashamed(pl).[fn]

Me dusa te seeye se kene ne matinumanen

Punishments for those who are_ not _obedient

(Diy 28:15‑68)

(Deu 28:15‑68)

14 [xr]“ ‘Piru ke kene kew egpammineg keddi wey ke kene niyu egtumanen ka langun ne me suhu ku, 15 wey ke kene niyu eg-ikulen ka me balaud ku, wey egsupaken niyu ka kasabutan ku kaniyu, 16 due eggimuwen ku kaniyu—egtigkawen ku sikaniyu egginalati, egpareraluwen, wey egpalusungan te mangune-kune ne iyan egpuunan ne kene kew e egpakameleg-meleg, wey egmaggase kew e. Ne warad e meupiya ne egpangkusan te pegpamula niyu su iyan man e egpangeen te eg-uma ka me kuntere niyu. 17 Egbalaharen kud sikaniyu wey egdereetan kew te me kuntere niyu. Ne iyan e egmandu kaniyu seeye se eg-ehet kaniyu wey egpamallahuy kew re due minsan ware egtalukun kaniyu.

14 [xr]“ ‘But if you(pl) don't listen to me or you(pl) won't fulfill all my commands, 15 or you(pl) won't follow laws, and you(pl) will_disobey my agreement with you(incl), 16 there's something that I will_do to you(pl)—I will_suddenly terrifies you(pl), cause_to_be_sick, and cause_to_have_ terrible _fever which the reason you(pl) can't see clearly, and that would_cause_ you(pl) _to_be_skinny. And your(pl) planting has no_good_result because the one_to_eat the harvest are your(pl) enemies. 17 I will_abandon you(pl) and you(pl) be_destroyed by your(pl) enemies. And the one to_rule you(pl) are those who fight you(pl) and you(pl) will_ just _run even if no_(one) is chasing you(pl).

18 “ ‘Ne emun ke kene kew pad iya man-e egpammineg keddi, egdusaan ku sikaniyu egpatamtamani[fn] tenged te me sale niyu. 19 Egdereetan ku ka impeggasal niyu ne karesen niyu wey kene ku egpeuranen, eyew egpangehal e ne subla ka tane niyu. 20 Ware karuan te peglasey-lasey niyu su deisek naan de ka eg-uma te tane niyu wey kenad degma egpamehas ka me kayu niyu.

18 “ ‘And if you(pl) still don't listen to me again, I will_punish you(pl) severely[fn] due to your(pl) sins. 19 I will_destroy the might/power that_ you(pl) _are_boasting_for and I won't cause_the_rain_to_pour, so that your(pl) land/soil will_become_ very _hard. 20 Your(pl) hard_working has no use because your(pl) land will_produce only little and your(pl) trees won't bear_fruit also.

21 “ ‘Ne emun ke egsupak kew pad iya man-e wey kene egpammineg keddi, egtimulan ku pad iya man-e ka legpad ku. 22 Egpalusuran ku sikaniyu te mabbulut ne me mahintalunan, wey egpangimatayan dan ka me anak niyu wey ka me ayam niyu, wey egdeisek kew naan de, wey warad eetawen te me dalan niyu.

21 “ ‘And if you(pl) indeed disobey me again and won't listen to me, I will_punish you(pl) severely again. 22 I will_cause_ the fierce wild_animals _to_attack you(pl), and they will_kill your(pl) children and your(pl) domestic_animals, and you(pl) become_few only, and your(pl) paths has no_ people _anymore.

23 “ ‘Emun ke kene kew pad iya man-e egpammineg keddi wey egpabulus kew ka egsupak keddi, 24 sikeddiey e ka eg-uney-uney egkuntere kaniyu wey egdusaan ku sikaniyu egpatamtamani. 25 Egpalusuran ku sikaniyu te me kuntere niyu wey egpalegparan kandan su insupak niyu ma ka kasabutan ta. Minsan pad ke egpangeles kew diye te me siyudad niyu, egmareraluwen ku ma iya man-e sikaniyu te masumpit, wey egkarakep kew e man-e te me kuntere niyu. 26 Kene ne eleg ka egkakeen niyu, sikan naa ka sabeka naan de ne hilutuanan te paan ka egkeyilutuan te sapulu ne malitan, wey egba-baaren dan naan de ka paan. Egpakakeen kew iya piru kene kew egkabbulung.

23 “ ‘If you(pl) still won't listen to me again and you(pl) continue disobeying me, 24 I myself personally fight with you(pl) and I will_punish you(pl) severely. 25 I will_cause_ your(pl) enemies _to_attack you(pl) and cause_to_be punish by them because you(pl) disobeyed our(incl) agreement. Even if you(pl) hide(pl) in your(pl) cities, I will_ indeed _cause you(pl) to become sick(pl) terrible, and you(pl) will_be_caught again by your(pl) enemies. 26 Your(pl) food is not enough, that's why only one oven can be_used_to_bake by ten women, and they will_divide the bread. You(pl) can_eat but you(pl) won't be_full.

27 “ ‘Ne emun ke kene kew pad iya man-e egpammineg keddi wey ke egsupak kew red iya keddi, 28 sikeddiey e ka eg-uney-uney egkuntere kaniyu tenged te langet ku wey egdusaan ku sikaniyu egpatamtamani. 29 Egkabitil kew wey egkapehes kew e ne egkeen te me anak niyu. 30 Egpangguhusen ku ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan, wey ka me altar ne egtutungan te insinsu. Ne igpangantug ku ka nammatey ne lawa niyu diye te diyus-diyus niyu ne kene eggeheyinawa, wey egbalaharen kud e sikaniyu. 31 Egpatamtamanan ku te eglundus ka me siyudad niyu wey warad eetawen te me matulus ne simbaanan niyu, wey kene ku igkeupii ka me meemut ne lansi te igmanubad niyu. 32 Egdereetan ku ka inged niyu wey egkengeinu-inu naan de ka me kuntere niyu ne eg-ahew te inged niyu. 33 Ne egpegsugsuwayen ku sikaniyu diye te duma ne me nasud su egpalusuran ku sikaniyu. Warad eetawen te tane niyu wey egkallundus e ka me siyudad niyu. 34-35 Taheed te naddakep kew wey neuyan te me kuntere niyu wey nalundus pad ka inged niyu, egpekeyimeley pad ka tane niyu, su te timpu ne mig-ugpe kew pad te tane niyu, intrabahu niyu seini minsan te leg-un ne kene seini egtrabahuwen. Piru kuntee, egpekeyimeley en iya seini.

27 “ ‘And if you(pl) still won't listen to me again or if you(pl) disobey me, 28 I myself personally fight with you(pl) due to my anger and I will_punish you(pl) severely. 29 You(pl) will_be_in_famine and you(pl) will_be_forced to eat your(pl) children. 30 I will_destroy(pl) sacrificing_place on the mountains, and the altars for burning the incense. I will_put_on your(pl) dead bodies on false_gods that won't breathe, and I will_reject/ignore you(pl). 31 I will_tear_down your(pl) cities severely and your(pl) holy worship_places won't have people anymore, and I don't want the fragrance of your(pl) sacrifices. 32 I will_destroy your(pl) place and your(pl) enemies who take_away your(pl) place would just be_amazed. 33 And I will_scatter you(pl) there on other nations because I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_be_attacked. Your(pl) land won't have people anymore and your(pl) cities will_be_torn_down. 34-35 While you(pl) were_captured (ones) and taken by your(pl) enemies and your(pl) cities were_torn_down, your(pl) land can rest yet, because at that time that you(pl) were_ still _living in your(pl) land, you(pl) worked_on it even on the year that it won't be_worked_on. But now/today, it can truly rest.

36 “ ‘Ne seeye se ware nammatey kaniyu diye te inged te me kuntere niyu, egpeumaan ku te mangune-kune ne liyas eyew minsan ke egpakarineg de sikandan te dewun ne egkengeulug, egpamallahuy e sikandan iling te due egpanlupug kandan ne eg-uyan te kampilan, minsan ware iya egpanlupug kandan. 37 Egmekegsangkub kew e ka egpallahuy iling te etew ne egpallahuy te kampilan, minsan ke ware eglupug kaniyu, wey kene kew egpaka-atu te me kuntere niyu. 38 Te katammanan, egpamatey kew diye te duma ne nasud wey iglebeng kew diye te tane te me kuntere niyu. 39 Ne ka egkasame kaniyu, egkabaas-baas egpatey diye te tane te me kuntere niyu tenged te me sale niyu wey te sale te kabuybuyahan niyu.

36 “ ‘And those of you(pl) who didn't die there in the place of your(pl) enemies, I will_cause_ terrible fear _to_come/possess even if they just hear leaves falling, they will_run like someone_is_chasing them who brings a sword, even if there's_no_(one) chasing them. 37 You(pl) will_bump_to_each_other in running like a person who runs_away from a sword, even if no_(one) is chasing you(pl), and you(pl) won't be_able_to_fight your(pl) enemies. 38 At the end, you(pl) will_die there in other nation and you(pl) will_be_buried(pl) there in the land of your(pl) enemies. 39 And the who remain of you(pl), die gradually there in the land of your(pl) enemies due to your(pl) sins and the sins of your(pl) elder(s).

40-41 “ ‘Tenged te peg-akal niyu wey pegsupak keddi, egkuntereen ku sikaniyu wey igpeuripen te me kuntere niyu. Piru ke egpangguhud kew te me sale niyu wey te me sale te kabuybuyahan niyu, wey kene kew egpakehal te me ulu niyu, wey egdawaten niyu ka igparusa kaniyu, 42 egtumanen ku ka kasabutan ku ki Hakub, ki Isaak wey ki Abraham wey egtantanuran ku ka tane niyu. 43 Piru egpaaween ku pad sikaniyu due ne tane eyew egpekeyimeley pad seini wey eyew egkaneem-neem niyu pad ka pegparusa ku kaniyu tenged te pegsawile niyu te me suhu ku wey te me tulumanen ku. 44 Piru minsan pad ke diye kew te tane te me kuntere niyu, kene ku red sikaniyu eg-engkeran wey ke eg-ang-anggaan naa. Kene ku sikaniyu egguleen, su egkasupak ku ka kasabutan ku kaniyu su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 45 Te iling due ne paahi, egtumanen ku ka kasabutan ku diye te kaap-apuan niyu te pegpalihawang ku kandan puun te Ihiptu eyew egkakita te me nasud ka karesen ku. Inggimu ku seini kandan eyew egkeyimu a ne Manama ran. Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.’ ”

40-41 “ ‘Due to your(pl) betraying and disobeying me, I will_fight with you(pl) and I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_become_slaves of your(pl) enemies. But if you(pl) tell your(pl) sins and the sins of your(pl) elder(s), and you(pl) won't cause_ your(pl) heads _to_be_hard, and you(pl) will_receive my punishment to you(pl), 42 I will_fulfill my agreement with Hakub, Isaak and Abraham and I will_keep_remembering your(pl) land. 43 But I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_leave yet on your(pl) land so_that it can rest yet and so_that you(pl) can taste my punishment to you(pl) due to your(pl) casting_away of my commands and rituals/regulations. 44 But even if you(pl) are still there in the land of your(pl) enemies, I won't leave or reject/mistreat you(pl). I won't kill_ you(pl) _all, because I could_disobey my agreement with_you(pl) because I (am) the Lord your(pl) God. 45 On that way, I will_fulfill my agreement with your(pl) ancestors when I caused_ them _to_go_out from Ihiptu in_order that the nations will_see my power. I did this to them so_that I will_become their God. I (am) the Lord God.’ ”

46 Seeye ka langun ne nalein-lein ne me balaud wey me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne imbehey rin te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne impataha rin ki Muwisis diye te Bubungan ne Sinay.

46 Those are all the different laws and commands of the Lord God that he gave to the descendants of Israil that he informed to Muwisis there in the Mount Sinay.

Ka halad ne iglekat te me saad

The offering for redeeming promises

271 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Muwisis, 2 “Kahii nu ka kabuhalan ni Israil: Emun ke due etew ne ighalad eyew te pegtuman te saad, egkalekat ded sika te iling kayi ne paahi: 3 Emun ke lukes ne migdaruwe e ne pulu (20) peendiye te hen-em ne pulu (60) ka idad, egkalekat sikandin te me 570 ne gramu ne pelata sumale te timbangan te me talagpanubad diye te Balungbalung. 4 Ke malitan sikandin, me 340 ne gramu ne pelata ka kentiddad te iglekat kandin. 5 Ne emun ke lukes sikandin ne miglalimme e peendiye te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne leg-un, egkalekat sikandin te me 228 ne gramu ne pelata. Ne emun ke malitan, 114 ne gramu ka iglekat. 6 Ne emun ke senge-bulan pad sikandin peendiye te lalimma ne leg-un, me lalimma ne pulu wey pitu (57) ne gramu ne pelata ka iglekat. Ne emun ke malitan, me tatelu ne pulu wey hep-at (34) ne gramu ka iglekat. 7 Ne emun ke hen-em e ne pulu (60) ka idad te lukes wey ke subla pad due, egkalekat sikandin te me 171 ne gramu ne pelata. Ne emun ke malitan, me 114 ne gramu ka iglekat.

271 And Muwisis was_told by the Lord God, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil: When there's a person that will_be_offered in_order to fulfill what's_promise, that could be_redeemed yet in this way: 3 If it's a male who turned_twenty (20) to sixty (60) years_old, he/she could be_redeemed with about 570 grams of silver according to the weigh of the sacrificers there in the Tent. 4 If she's a woman, about 340 grams of silver the price to redeem her. 5 And if he is a male that turned_five already up_to twenty (20) years_old, he can be_redeemed with about 228 grams of silver. And if (she's) a woman, about 114 grams the thing_to_redeem. 6 And if s/he turned_one month up_to five years_old, about fifty-seven (57) grams of silver the_thing_to_redeem. And if (she's) a woman, about thirty-four (34) grams the thing_to_redeem. 7 And if the male turned_sixty (60) years_old or more than that, he can be_redeemed with about 171 grams of silver. And if (she's) a woman, about 114 grams the thing_to_redeem.

8 “Ke due etew ne ware egkeyimu wey migpanaad sikandin ne egbehey piru kene egpakabehey, keilangan ne eg-uyanen sikandin diye te talagpanubad. Ne ka talagpanubad e ka egkahi ke pila ka igbehey rin sumale te egkeyimu rin.

8 “If there's a person that has nothing and he promised to give but can't give, it's_necessary that he will_be_taken there to the sacrificer. And the sacrificer will_say how much he will_give according to what he can afford(Lit can_do).

9 “Ke iyan din insaad ka mananap eyew igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka sika ne mananap, kandin e te Magbebaye ne Manama. 10 Keilangan ne kene din seini egsaliyuwan wey ke egliwanan naa, minsan pad ke meupiya wey ke mareet naa ka igliwan din. Emun ke egliwanan din ma te lein ne mananap, egkaamul e nasi ne daruwa ne mananap ka igkabehey rin te Manama. 11 Emun ke in-isip ne malindit ka mananap ne insaad din diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kene egkaayun ne igpakahalad, keilangan ne eg-uyanen din seini diye te talagpanubad. 12 Ne egkentidaran din seini wey kenad egkabalbalawan ka seeye ne kentiddad—meupiya ma ka mananap wey se mareet. 13 Piru ke egkeupian ka kamuney ne eggawien ka mananap din, egtimulan din te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu ka bali due.

9 “If what_ he _promised is an animal in_order to sacrifice there to the Lord God, that animal, will_be_owned by the Lord God. 10 It's_necessary that he won't replace it or exchange_it, even if what_ he _replaces is good or bad/ugly. If he replaces (it) with other animal, then both of the two animals will_be_given to the Lord God. 11 If the animal that he promised to the Lord God is considered dirty and not possible to offer, it's_necessary that he takes it there to the sacrificer. 12 And he takes_a_price it and that price won't be_changed—the animal maybe good or bad/ugly. 13 But if the owner wants to take_back his animal, he will_add twenty (20) percent the price of it.

14 “Ne emun ke due eghalad te baley rin diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, egpitawen pad te talagpanubad ka baley ke meupiya naan pad seini wey ke mareet e, ne egkentidaran e seini te talagpanubad wey kenad egkabalbalawan ka kentiddad due. 15 Ne emun ke eggawien ded te kamuney ka baley rin, keilangan ne egbayaran din ka kentiddad te baley wey egtimulan din pad te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu. Ne egkaawi din e ka baley rin.

14 “And if there's someone_who_offers his house to the Lord God, the sacrificer will_check the house if it is still good or bad/ugly already, and the sacrificer takes_a_price for_it and its price won't be changed anymore. 15 And if the owner takes_back his house, he must pay the price of the house and he will_add twenty (20) percent of its price. And he can get_back his house.

16 “Ke due eghalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te tane ne inggaat kandin, keilangan ne igpeiling din ka kentiddad te mig-uma te tane. Te tagse lalimma ne pulu (50) ne gantang te impamula ne sibada, lalimma ne pulu (50) ne pelata ka bali. 17 Ke ighalad din ka kamet din, pegkeimpus de te Leg-un te Kaligwangan, kenad egkabalbalawan ka kentiddad dutu taman te eggingume e man-e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. 18 Piru ke eglihad e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan ne human din pad ighalad ka kamet din, keilangan ne egseelen te talagpanubad ka kentiddad te sika ne tane sumale te kasuluhan te nasame ne me leg-un. Ne egsalinan din ka kentiddad dutu. 19 Ne emun ke eggawien ded te kamuney ka kamet ne inhalad din, keilangan ne egbayaran din ka kentiddad te kamet wey egtimulan din pad te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu. Ne egkaawi din e seini. 20 Piru ke kene din e eglekaten ka kamet din wey ke nabelegye din e naan e seini diye te lein ne etew, kene din e seini egkaawi. 21 Ne emun ke eggingume e ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan, kenad e seini egkaawi su kandin man e seini te Manama. Egpekeiling e seini te kamet ne imbehey diye te Manama wey iyan e egpakakamuney ka me talagpanubad.

16 “And if there's someone_who_offers to the Lord God a land that left_behind (to) him, it's_necessary that he makes_same the price with what's_harvested on the land. In every fifty (50) gantang of barley planted, the price is fifty (50) silver. 17 If he offers his field, after the Year of Being_Rescued, its price won't be changed until the Year of Being_Rescued comes again. 18 But if the Year of Being_Rescued past_by already before he offers his farm, the sacrificer must count the price of that land according to the number of the remaining years. And he will_deduct its price. 19 And if the owner takes_back his farm that s/he offered, it's_necessary that s/he pay the price of the field and s/he will_add twenty (20) percent. And s/he can take it back. 20 But if s/he will_ not _redeem his/her field or sell it already to other person, s/he can't take_ it _back anymore. 21 And if the Year of Being_Rescued comes already, this can't be_taken_back because it will_be_owned by God. This becomes_like the field given there to God and the ones_who_own_it (are) the sacrificers.

22 “Ke ighalad te etew ka kamet ne imbeli rin ne ware nalagkes te karatuan ne inggaat kandin, 23 egkentiddaran seini te talagpanubad sumale ke pila ne leg-un te kene pad egginguma ka Leg-un te Kaligwangan. Egbayaran te etew te sikan de ne aldew ke pila ka ingkentiddad te talagpanubad wey kandin e seini te Magbebaye ne Manama. 24 Te Leg-un te Kaligwangan, ig-uli diye te malehet ne kamuney ka tane ne nabeli te senge-etew su karatuan ma seini ne inggaat kandin.

22 “If a person offers a field that he bought which is not included of the wealth that's left_behind him/her, 23 the sacrificer takes_a_price of it according to the number (LIT how_many) of years before the Year of Being_Rescued comes. The person pays the price taken by the sacrificer on that day only and this will_be_owned by the Lord God. 24 On the Year of Being_Rescued, the land bought by other person be_returned to the real owner because it's wealth that left_behind for_him/her.

25 “Keilangan ne ka langun ne kentiddad te seeye se ighalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, egtimbangen diye te timbangan te me talagpanubad.

25 “It's_necessary that all the price of those sacrificed to the Lord God, be_weighed of a scale of the sacrificers.

26 “Piru ka an-anayan ne nati te mananap, kandin iya te Magbebaye ne Manama purisu kenad keilangan ne igpanubad pad kandin. 27 Piru ke in-isip ne malindit sika ne mananap, egkalekat din ded sika sumale te ingkentiddad te talagpanubad wey egtimulan din pad te daruwa ne pulu ne pursintu (20). Piru ke kene din eggawien, igbelegye e sika sumale te ingkentiddad te talagpanubad.

26 “But the first kid/calf of an animal, it is really owned by the Lord God therefore it is no_longer necessary that it_will_be_sacrificed to him. 27 But if that animal is considered dirty, he can redeem it according to the said_price by the sacrificer and he will_add twenty (20) percent. But if he won't take_it_back, that will_be_sold according to the said_price by the sacrificer.

28 [xr]“Ware minsan nekey ne imbehey e diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkaayun ded ne igbelegye wey ke egbeliyen naa, etew ma wey se mananap ne karatuan ne inggaat. Ighalad iya sika te Magbebaye ne Manama. 29 Ka etew ne imbehey e diye te Manama eyew eggimatayan, kenad e egkaawi su keilangan ne eggimatayan iya sikandin.

28 [xr]“Not anything that's given to the Lord God can be sold or be bought, person or animal that's wealth that's left_behind. That's really be_offered to the Lord God. 29 The person who is given to God in_order to be_killed, (he) won't be_taken_back because (he) needs to be_killed indeed.

30 [xr]“Kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama ka langun ne igkasapulu ne egpuun te eg-uma te tane, nahaani puun te tane wey ke behas naa te me kayu; ighalad iya seini te Magbebaye ne Manama. 31 Ke due eglibed egbeli te minsan nekey ne igkasapulu din, keilangan ne egbayaran din ka kentiddad dutu wey egtimulan din te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne pursintu. 32 Emun ke egseel kew te me baka wey me karniru niyu, ka tagse igkasapulu, ihalad niyu iya diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 33 Keilangan ne kene din seini ug-ugsiyen ke meupiya naa seini wey ke mareet. Kene man-e egkaayun ne egsaliyuwan din seini. Ke egsaliyuwan din iya seini, egkaamul e nasi ne daruwa ne ayam igkabehey diye te Manama wey kenad seini egkaawi.”

30 [xr]“The Lord God owns all the tenth of what's produced of the land, harvested from the land or fruit of the trees; this will_be_offered indeed to the Lord God. 31 If there's someone_buying again whatever of his tenth, he needs to pay its price and he adds_it twenty (20) percent. 32 If you(pl) count your(pl) cattle and sheeps, the every tenth, offer(pl) (it) indeed to the Lord God. 33 He must not inquire if it is good or bad/ugly. He can't replace it also. If he really replaces it, both of the two animals will_be_given to God and this can't be_taken_back.”

34 Sika ka me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis diye te Bubungan ne Sinay eyew igpatuman te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

34 That's the commands of the Lord God to Muwisis there on the Mount Sinay in_order to cause_to_be_fulfilled by descendants of Israil.
